articleTitle: Implementation of Mersenne primes solution algorithm based on CUDA
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the lucas-lehmer's serial algorithm, this article analyses throughly and extracts the parallelism existing in the algorithm. While the core calculation can be achieved by using the parallelized FFT (Fast Fourier Transformation), the program will be optimized under CUDA platform basing on the hardware architecture of GPU. And the results showed that performance has been greatly improved by implementing the LUCAS algorithm on GPU, compared with implementing this algorithm on serial CPU.

articleTitle: A method to segment moving human cast shadow based on wavelet multi-resolution features
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, texture analysis method is proposed to segment and removal the human's shadow, shadows always produced by the light. The method is composed of three step: firstly, using the Gaussian mixture model extract the foreground and background from the Human motion sequences, secondly, using wavelet decomposition to extract texture features and color features of the foreground and background and established the eigenvector that based on the pixels, finally, using SVM classified the eigenvector and if the foreground's eigenvector and background's eigenvector are the same, so the pixel is the shadow. The results showed that using the texture analysis method segment shadows clearly and it can do well at various environmental, for example the illumination changes or color deviation.

articleTitle: A discussion on network-based teaching in the information age
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the growing popularity of wired and wireless Internet, network-based teaching is receiving more and more attention. Networking technology delivers a wide range of vital broadband capabilities, making Internet access affordable in a face-to-face classroom and a virtual classroom. This article elaborates on the features and advantages of network-based teaching and sets forth the role of a teacher, helping educational teachers maximize application functionality using an integrated wired and wireless infrastructure to improve the quality of teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Research of PBL teaching in the non computer science C language teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As C Programming Language is a basic and required language course in vast majority of non-computer science engineering students, but the learning is difficult and the pass rate is low. A idea of using PBL teaching methods is presented by the research of teaching in non-computer science. This may improve the effect of C language teaching, and promote the students' learning initiative. Through the practical teaching, it is found that it is more suitable for PBL teaching in C Programming Language lessons, not just in the classroom, so on the lab course. It effectively improves the students' ability to understand the program, the algorithm analysis and design ability, and the ability to write program by using this method.

articleTitle: Research on medium-sized coaches power device matching simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In view of the the current backward technology in the production and development of the domestic coach, to medium-sized coach as the research object, embarks from the reality, full consideration of this type of all kinds of requirements, the reasonable selection of engine type, establish the vehicle dynamic simulation model, the simulation results showed that the type of engine matching the medium-sized coach has the maximum climbing capability for 33.4%, top speed is 121 km/h, direct file speeds up to 100 km/h time is 31.5 s, and has good fuel economy. The research results to optimize the bus chassis layout, improve quality, performance and fuel economy has certain directive significance.

articleTitle: Intelligent operation and control of refrigeration craft in cold storage
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the difference between intelligent and non-intelligent system, and analyze some problems in the development and research of auto-control system in the cold storage. These problems involve engineering survey, predictive control of technical parameters, control reliability of machinery equipment, local control and global control. And the methods of artificial neural networks, genetic algorithm and least square are put forward to resolve them.

articleTitle: Research on nsBench' application in computer network teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper focuses on the current problems of NS2's application in the computer network teaching, and introduces a drag-and-drop GUI nsBench which makes NS-2 simulation development and analysis faster and easier for students and researchers without losing the flexibility or expressiveness gained by writing a script. It is beneficial for student to directly understand the principles of network protocol. Thus, the teaching quality can be improved and an application example is provided.

articleTitle: Study and simulation of switched reluctance drive multifunctional integration control system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: SRD has better application in future. We used SRD into hybrid electric vehicle and study integration of starting, running, steering and charging. A 6/4 SRD simulation model can be built by Matlab/Simulink. The characteristics of all stages of the vehicle are described well from this model and also proved the possibility of the control method.

articleTitle: Investigation of a plastic injected container of PCM for temperature rapid-balancing and long-maintaining
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this study, a Phase Change Material (PCM) container made of plastic by injection molding process has been designed in a suitable structure to store PCMs in combination with a vacuum layer acting as an excellent insulated outer cover. The target of this design is to create a rapid temperature balancing container which can firstly absorb heat from the stored substance to change its temperature within several minutes into a desired value, set by the melting temperature and type of used PCMs, and then keep that temperature last longer as the absorbed heat is later released. Models in different shape using a commercial PCM (called PW-63) with melting temperature of 63°C have been made and tested carefully in laboratory. The best results, derived from the multi-layer structure, have shown that average temperature of boiled water (stored substance) reached the desired range of 55 ~ 65°C within only about 15 minutes and this temperature range lasted within nearly 5 hours. This time is even much longer for lower temperature desired value. This is a big advantage compared with vacuum container without PCM (in which the desired range was reached after about 4 hours but lasted for only more than 2 hours), which is normally considered a very good device for isolating storage. With this good performance, the plastic multi-layer PCM container can become a good solution for stainless steel PCM container in heat transfer enhancement in latent heat storage applications using PCMs. It also brings along other advantages compared with stainless steel container such as lighter weight, cheaper, faster and easier mass-production by means of plastic injection process.

articleTitle: The research on RTCP feedback mechanism with network tomography
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Network Tomography technology based on RTCP feedback for network monitoring and management is significant. The current RTCP feedback mechanism is defined in RFC3550. In this paper, the RTCP Extended Report (XR) feedback mechanism has been studied. The paper analyses the relationship between the feedback interval and RTCP packet size and the size of the multicast session, points out the shortage of the current feedback mechanism, and puts forward animproved encoding method. Based on the RTCP unicast feedback model, using reasonable encoding XR packets can reduce the feedback bandwidth and promote the feedback rate.

articleTitle: Study on investigative model of instruction for the science of law — View from project class of Civil Procedural Law
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The model of investigative instruction is commonly applied in various subjects in colleges and has achieved certain gains. The project class of science of Civil Procedural Law as an investigative model of instruction is as well a positive attempt of law major in this area. Project class has its both theoretical and practical evidence as an investigative model of instruction. Corresponding results can be gained by exploring the running modes of project class of Civil Procedural Law.

articleTitle: The exploration of distance teaching cloud platform under the integration of three networks — Taking Zhejiang Radio and TV University as an example
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The integration of three networks breaks the boundaries among the telecommunication networks, radio and TV networks and the Internet, and it provides the technical support for the construction of national lifelong learning society and the development of modern distance education. The article first introduces the background of constructing distance learning cloud platform under the integration of three networks of Zhejiang Radio and TV University, then analyzes the innovative significance of the integration of three networks in modern distance education, and makes a specific technology project of distance learning cloud platform. Finally, based on the examples, the article discusses the successful application of the sub-platform under the integration of three networks, which offers further evidence for the feasibility of the construction of distance teaching cloud platform under the integration of three networks.

articleTitle: Research on the safety awareness training software for commercial vehicles drivers
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The feasibility for safety awareness training on commercial vehicle drivers with the application of automotive driving simulator was analyzed in this study, the virtual reality based safety awareness training methodology was also proposed. The reference and specific contents for training courses design was firstly illustrated. The explanation of main architecture planning and implementation methods was two important parts in this study. The implementation effect of this software was then presented. The results of feedbacks from the users who were in the practical application of the system indicate that this software system can improve the safety awareness in driving. The prospect for future research and application direction were finally discussed.

articleTitle: Design of software engineering knowledge system base on knowledge topic
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On basis of analyze history and status of software engineering education, this paper establishes a software engineering knowledge system based on knowledge topic. The knowledge system has knowledge areas of computing essentials, software construction technologies, software process practice, software requirement and modeling, software design, software testing, and software management, etc. It is a knowledge system with Chinese characteristics and helps to improve teaching quality of the software engineering specialty.

articleTitle: Analysis of laplacian distribution model for virtual channel in distributed video coding
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Distributed source coding theory has long promised a new method of encoding video that is much lower in complexity than conventional video methods. In the distributed framework, the decoder is usually tasked with modeling the correlation noise and exploiting the statistics. In this paper, we first analyze the suitability of laplacian distribution in correlation noise model (CNM), which is the key part of DVC, and then we propose a novel distribution model for correlation noise. The result shows that laplacian distribution model couldn't reflect motion intensity very well and our proposed model performs better in Rate Distortion (RD).

articleTitle: Building two-stage assessment system for project teaching of Hydraulic and Pneumatic course
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Evaluation is the last but not least part for project teaching. A reasonable and effective evaluation system of project teaching not only can evaluate students' grades precisely but also can enhance students' learning interest and cultivate students' comprehensive ability. Based on the teaching reform of recent years, two-stage assessment system is proposed. This system includes self-evaluation and expert assessment. In the new system, items of evaluation tables are optimized. That the teachers themselves do not take part in the evaluation improves operability and accuracy of evaluation.

articleTitle: Exploiture and design of the on-line contribution and search system in the editorial department
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of science and network technology, the work of the editorial department is facing many questions. In order to solve these questions, journal of Chinese People's Armed Police Force Academy designed the on-line contribution and search system. The design of this system will help improving manuscript normative, curbing academic misconduct, strengthening the manuscript confidentiality, improving the efficiency of editorial work and the ability of information service.

articleTitle: A new software development architecture based on open environment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: At present, software design and development have many problems. For example, a mass of codes and resources have been designed. At the same time, software cost is more and more expensive, and software development cycle is more and more long. But software requirement can't still be enough fulfilled. To solve this problem, this paper proposed a new software development architecture based on open environment to reduce the software cost and the software development cycle.

articleTitle: Joint multiple CFOs and channel estimation for uplink OFDMA systems without noise statistics
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, an H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> based method is proposed to jointly estimate the multiple carrier frequency offsets (CFOs) and the channel impulse responses (CIRs) for uplink orthogonal frequency division multiplexing access (OFDMA) systems in the unknown noise. The design criterion of the proposed algorithm is to guarantee that the effect of worst-case disturbances on the CFOs estimation errors is smaller than a prescribed disturbance level. Since any knowledge of the disturbance does not be required, the proposed estimator can achieve a good CFOs and channel estimation performance in the non-Gaussian noise. Simulation results show that the proposed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> method can combat inter-carrier interference (ICI) introduced by multiple CFOs effectively, and improve the robustness performance of uplink OFDMA systems against non-Gaussian noise.

articleTitle: The study of RFID system based on CEP
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of RFID technology, the demands of a relevant software system have been rising in recent years. Complex Event Processing (CEP) is a technique for analyzing streams of event data in real-time. Because the raw RFID data is unreliable, CEP can play a critical role in RFID system. In this paper we propose a high performance complex event detection algorithm of performing CEP directly over unreliable RFID event streams by incorporating cleansing requirements into complex event specifications.

articleTitle: A coverage-guaranteed nodes scheduling algorithm in clusters for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to balance the nodes' energy consumption, prolong the lifetime of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), this paper combined cluster and node scheduling, proposed a coverage-guaranteed nodes scheduling algorithm in clusters for WSNs (CGNSC). In this algorithm, clusters are set up at first, then every node in every cluster judges whether itself is a redundant node according to follow conditions: the first one, it has more than 3 neighbor nodes whose distance to itself are less than nodes' monitor radius R; the other one, it can be circle covered by the neighbor nodes satisfying the first condition. If any node satisfies the two conditions above, it is a redundant one which must turn into sleep state immediately. Simulations in Matlab 7.1 indicate that, this algorithm can decrease the energy consumption of WSNs, and the schedule efficiency has an affinity with node density and node monitor radius.

articleTitle: Study for heterogeneous data integration technology of mine safety monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Remote monitoring, browsing and query of coal mine safety monitoring system information are the general trend of information technology development in coal industry. After analyzing conversion and transmission technology of heterogeneous data based on the system heterogeneous data source, finally, this paper presents a design scheme of heterogeneous data integration of OPC technology based mine safety monitoring system. From the test results, we know system is stable and can achieve good effect. It is significant to promote the information technology development in coal industry.

articleTitle: The software design and implementation of automatic coagulation analyzer based on C#
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The article designs the detection method of automatic coagulation based on C# software, to achieve the parameter tests of Thrombus and Hemostatic. The article focuses on structure of the coagulation analyzer and the specific functions of the software design. Then it gives the communication protocol between upper and lower computer, and user interface design and implementation. Furthermore, the article uses prothrombin time testing experiment as an example to design the experimental steps. The test results show that the software can test the experiment, and the software interface is friendly.

articleTitle: The research of C language programming intelligent scoring technology based on the semantic similarity
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As some problems exists in C language programming intelligent scoring technology, like its intelligence is poor and its determine is not accurately. A new method based on semantic similarity score is designed. The static combed with dynaic semantic understanding are used in it, so the score are more humane, more close to the results of manual scoring, also the determination accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: Location-based mobile instant messaging system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nowadays wireless Mobile positioning and IM (Instant Messaging) have been widely applied worldwide, but by far there are no public researches or applications which combine the two above together. In this paper we present a new approach of location service system which realizes location-based mobile IM chatting functions. We design and develop this system on the platform of J2ME/Servlet, first apply LL-TOA (the uplink time of arrival) of base station for positioning the mobile phone, and then employ the WTK (J2ME Wireless Toolkit) to display the interface and achieve the IM function based on the user's location. This system provides a brand-new experience of location and communicating services, and brings a high economic and market prospect.

articleTitle: Constructing the “Outstanding Engineers” teaching system, strengthening students' creative ability training
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Universities are the training base of specialized persons, College students' innovative ability training is an important goal of professional training. Oriented by students' practical ability and creative ability, the vehicle engineering specialty of HYIT insists in facing enterprises' needs, constructs the “Outstanding Engineers” teaching system to improve the students' creative ability and cultivating innovative professionals.

articleTitle: Application of multi-thread serial communication based on Win32 API functions in GPS tracking ship
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: GPS tracking ship is an automatic equipment used to measure water-depth, which is based on the GPS navigational signals, and the system needs real-time and efficient data acquisition through serial ports. The technology of multi-thread serial communication is applied to meet the requirements of the system. In this paper, the application of multi-thread and serial communication based on Win32 API functions is introduced. Meanwhile, a new programming method is developed, considering the specific feature of the system. With the multi-thread serial communication, the program operates steadily in Windows XP system, and has a considerable practical value in application.

articleTitle: A sufficient and necessary condition for a complete residuated lattice is meet continuous
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper gives a sufficient and necessary condition for that a complete residuated lattice is meet continuous through investigating the interrelationship between the categories of convergence spaces, topological spaces, L-semi-topological spaces, and L-valued preorders.

articleTitle: On the inquiry learning of college English based on multimedia network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Multimedia network technology is driving our society to an overall information age. How to use multimedia network technology to improve English especially English inquiry learning to adapt to the demands of curriculum reform has already been an urgent topic. This paper firstly points out the definition and characteristics of inquiry learning, and then mainly analyzes the implementation steps for inquiry learning of college English and the advantages multimedia network technology brings to English inquiry learning. All of this proves that English inquiry learning with the help of multimedia network technology is feasible and necessary.

articleTitle: Path planning algorithm for fiber placement based on boundaries of tow
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at realizing fiber placement path planning in a certain S-shaped inlet, a path planning algorithm based on boundaries of tow and an algorithm for calculating quantity of fiber tow are proposed to machine the dust in accordance with the original design. It is proved that placement in the normal direction is difficult when the pressure of the roller is oriented towards the normal direction at the trajectory point by analyzing normal and tangential placement of trajectory point and contact model between the roller and the mould surface. A placement path calculating method, treating isometric offset of curves in the surface as its core idea, is proposed by combining the algorithms of isometric-placement and uniform-angle-placement in the scope of placement angle designed originally. The efficiency of fiber placement equipment can be increased with method above. The applicability of this method is verified by applying it to plan placement path of a certain S-shaped inlet.

articleTitle: Preliminary study on cluster methods for geometric shape based on correlation graph
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On study for geographic information science, description and measurement for shape of spatial objects is a very important research subject. But current methods used in this field all have some limitations. In this paper the authors discuss a new method to solve the problem better. The authors also put forward a new association matrix-Angular Matrix, which can represent geometric shape in a better way. Preliminary experiment shows that this method can express characteristics of geometric shape better with desirable calculation efficiency.

articleTitle: A solution to indoor power line input impedance and transfer function
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Indoor power line communication with the economy, convenience and other benefits has been got a growing number of applications. So it has the important theoretical research value to solve indoor power line input impedance and transfer function with an easy and accurate way. Based on transmission-line theory, and taking multi-node power line network equivalent phantom as the research object, we calculate the equivalent input impedance of circuit and analyze the transfer function of network with transmitted parameter matrix. Being simulated and verified, the digital conclusion we got from this paper is accurate and correct, which means the method being used is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Performance prediction of T-DMB system based on hierarchical modulation and transponder
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to provide high quality video service on large-size display in the Terrestrial Digital Multimedia Broadcasting (T-DMB), this paper adopts the hierarchical modulation and the transponder technique. The hierarchical modulation is used to increase the data rate, while the backwards compatible is guaranteed. For expanding the coverage of the T-DMB, the antenna transponder is applied. Meanwhile, the system model is built based on Matlab. The simulation results show that the DMB system with a proposed method can have good performance in the complex channel as well as T-DMB.

articleTitle: Detection of gas concentration in the mine based on the principle of infra-red spectrum
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the environment in mines and the infrared spectrum technique advantage, It is adopted widely to apply the principle of infra-red spectrum by counting the coefficient of methane gas and the gas concentration curve, then transferring the methane gas to light signal, at last achieving the goals to detect the gas concentration based on the infra-red spectrum.

articleTitle: The law of large numbers of ρ mixing sequence
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this chapter, we will introduce the theorem of Complete convergence for weighted sums of ρ mixing sequences. Through the research we will find the former result have become the special case.

articleTitle: Automatic measurement system of dam perpendicular based on CCD
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The automatic measurement system of dam perpendicular is design for the dam safety monitoring requirements. The system is mainly composed of the light source module, system hardware and system software. Using ARM7 as the core of the system, ARM7 drives CCD through certain time sequence. The parallel light which is made by myself projet the dam plumb line to the CCD, then CCD output video analog voltage. The voltage signal will be passed back to the ARM7 after be modulated. Digital signal will be collect and processed to obtain corresponding displacement by ARM7. Then through the displacement and angle relation easily calculate the tilt angle data. Tilt angle data will be sent to the PC through the network interface. According to the data, the PC makes forecasts about dam deformation. The staff can real-time observe the dam deformation and does not need frequently go into the dam internal. It will provide convenience for dam safety monitoring.

articleTitle: A study of image registration algorithm based on radial-energy curve method
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Image registration is one of key technologies of image fusion, and the level of registration accuracy directly determines the quality of fusion results. Different images and applications have different registration algorithms. According to the characteristics and applications of image to find the appropriate registration algorithm is the key to solve image fusion problem. This paper analyzes the key issues of frequency registration algorithm and puts forward a registration algorithm based on Radial-energy Curve method in frequency domain. Experiments show that the algorithm effectively improve the accuracy and speed of registration, and registration results better meet the image fusion for motion estimation requirements.

articleTitle: The study and implementation on the security data transmission for on-line examination system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: [Purpose] To study the security problems on the online examination which is applicable in the distance education such as open university in the process of the data transmission. And use the various passwords' algorithms to encrypt the data transmission and integrate into the processs of the transmission. [Method] Design the security transmission scheme for data mixed encryption under the b/s and c/s mode coexistence, the three levels of bureaucracy, the three server system, and redevelop with Openssl. [Result] Examples prove : To use the various passwords' algorithms to mix and encript the data and combine the encryption technology and transmission technology can achieve the expected effect on security transmission. [Conclusion] Achieve the safe and transparent data transmission through the web servers in the on-line examination system.

articleTitle: A descending suffix tree-based pattern matching algorithm for intrusion detection
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Pattern matching is an important detecting method of a misuse intrusion detection system. With the increase in the number of rules, the performance of pattern matching algorithm has been a gradually decline and has been a bottleneck. A new type of pattern matching based on suffix tree is proposed. The method mines rule's data structure and prunes rule set based suffix tree, the model size of the search space has been reduced. Experiments show, compared to the conventional pattern matching method, it is an effective method to reduce the time of pattern matching, and improves the detection efficiency of intrusion detection systems.

articleTitle: Hydraulic model experimental research of JUBA Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The research of Metamorphosis hydraulic model experiment which is designed on the base of gravity similarity and turbulent resistance similarity into JUBA Hydropower Station shows the structure layout and design size of JUBA Hydropower Station are reasonable and overflow capacity of sluice can meet the requirements. The sediment control effects of the upstream sand barrier under different flow actions are obvious, through the river dredging regulation can increase 0.21m waterhead of the station, the flow pattern of station at upstream and downstream is not good; through model experimental research propose decreasing the bottom elevation of the power station tailrace channel can increase the waterhead, shunt wall is set between the power station and the sluice at upstream, increase the length and height of the shunt wall at downstream to improve the flow pattern at the upstream and downstream of the hydropower station.

Author Keywords: flow pattern of upstream and downstream

articleTitle: The obtaining and using of online educational resources
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Ubiquitous network, has involved all walks of life. In the education sector, online educational resources for educational purposes have provided a variety of resources. This paper introduces the concept of online educational resources, characteristics and access ways.

Author Keywords: the concept of online educational resources

articleTitle: Research and analysis of Chinese software industry
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The software industry is the basis of the information technology revolution, it has a strong penetrating victory, almost can be combined with all the traditional industries, can greatly promote the transformation of traditional industries and improvement of equipment, so as to promote industrial upgrading, it has become an important force in promoting world economic growth and social development. Rob development initiative, set up in a good position in the global software industry chain, countries all over the world already use software technology as their focus of global competition and strategic high ground were developed based on national development objectives and situation of software industry development strategy, adopted a package of policy measures, in practice gradually formed a development road suited to their national characteristics.

articleTitle: The new field in urban underground space design: Research on Jinmandi Underground Commercial Street in Changsha
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the theories on environmental psychology, this paper analyze the main reasons why people dislike underground business space by taken the Jinmandi Underground Commercial Street as an example, and then propose some new thoughts in the plan of underground space. These thoughts have been determined by the process of people's feeling and psychological demands rather than the old form determined by the function.

articleTitle: A study of port-vicinity industry cluster development of Liaoning coastal economic belt
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Liaoning coastal economic belt development has risen to national strategy. Port-vicinity industry cluster of Liaoning coastal economic belt include the port group of Dalian port and Yingkou port as the center and the surrounding logistics industry, the port-vicinity industry, modem service system for the port economic. Port-vicinity industry cluster of Liaoning coastal economic belt have already begun to take shape and been supported by the national and provincial government. But there are some areas in need of improvement. In order to solve the problems, this paper puts forward play the government leading role, create favorable development environment for the port-vicinity industry development; develop environmental protection industry, promote circulation economy construction; optimize harbor configuration, improve the whole service function; support by the construction of industry cluster, improve the competitiveness of the industry.

articleTitle: An algorithm to find the largest adjacent repeated pattern based on Suffix Tree
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper analyses the features of the adjacent repeated patterns with Suffix Tree, and proposes an algorithm based on Suffix Tree through constructing Suffix Tree again to find the largest adjacent repeated pattern. The comparable and analyzable experiment shows that this algorithm can find the largest repeated patterns which are effective and true.

articleTitle: Reflections on computer engineering graduate cultivating
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To cultivate national qualified talents, institutions of higher learning should adhere to an open policy and make innovations in their function and objective of academic training; they should produce talents to meet the needs of the latest development in science, technology, culture, and economy. Under current situation, the curriculum of graduate system needs to be reformed in order to train the academic and applied graduates. Innovation ability of scientific research and operative ability are important parts of computer engineering graduate education. A cultivation mode for computer engineering graduate is explored from three aspects: practice ability of scientific research, innovative consciousness and ability, and international perspective. The methods of teaching are analyzed. The influencing factors on the quality of thesis are also discussed in detail.

articleTitle: "Cogeneration" research and practice of teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the "cogeneration" curriculum characteristics, combined with the teaching practice, the teaching difficulty undertakes an analysis, put forward the teaching methods and suggestions. Hope that through this curriculum teaching, the students after graduation design and work to achieve good effect, to improve the quality of teaching, to deepen the understanding of curriculum knowledge system.

articleTitle: Research on energy of an office building equipped high permeability with Low-E window in Xinxiang
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Energy-saving of high permeability with Low-E window in Xinxiang was studied. The software of DeST was used to simulate the air-conditioning system and heating system load under the office building of Xinxiang equipped ordinary glass and high permeability with Low-E window. The results showed that high permeability with Low-E window was fitted in Xinxiang. Annual cooling, heat load and annual cooling consumption, heat loss by high permeability with Low-E window compared with ordinary glass, down 10%, 26%, 3%, 41%. Great potential for energy saving.

articleTitle: Design of image acquisition and storage system based on ARM and embedded
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Traditional image acquisition system has the faults of complex, bulky and inconvenient to carry. The embedded image processing system integrates all the functions of image capturing, displaying and processing as well as takes the advantages of small size and low power consumption. According to the need of modern security monitoring system, a kind of image acquisition system based on ARM and Linux was designed. The system takes S3C2410(ARM9) as the core to construct the image acquisition and processing system with USB camera, monitor and memory, and builds necessary peripherals and communication interfaces to complete the design of the hardware platform. Then drivers were composed and embedded Linux operating system was transplanted, eventually the functions of image data collection, display and storage were realized. The test results show that images acquisition were clear and the system turns out to meet the requirement.

articleTitle: Optimal design of video decoder based on PowerPC 405
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to improve the comprehensive performance of portable media player video decoding, adopts the mpeg-4 video decoder in software and hardware co-design. Through the division of software and hardware, the study is the IP core optimized design and implementation in two-dimensional inverse discrete cosine transform, motion compensation, color space conversion. It builds a video decoding model of hardware and software co-design based on hard-core PowerPC 405. As the core for Xilinx FPGA chip, the study builds SOPC test. The results show that the CIF video sequences are supported the real-time decoding at the operating frequency only 100 MHz. This system achieves real-time video playback in low power consumption, high reliability and flexibility.

articleTitle: Analyzing exchanges between principals and teachers in primary and middle school
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Exchanges between principals and teachers in primary and middle schools fall into lower-quality exchanges and high-quality exchanges, with the former referred to as exchange relationships based on employment contract, and the latter as social exchanges focusing on respect and trust. Empirical study shows that in primary and middle schools, both lower-quality and high-quality exchanges are commonly seen. This is not only a need of education and teaching task and education career in primary and middle schools, and a need of principals and teachers themselves.

articleTitle: Simulation study on hydraulic control system of high-speed transplanter with SIMSAE
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The hydraulic control system model of the high-speed rice transplanter is constructed and simulated with SIMSAE sorftware. The actual working condition of the power-assisted steering and hydraulic copying shape are simulated to improve the stability and high efficiency of the designed hydraulic system. The hydraulic control system has been used in practice with one type high-speed rice transplanter. After a period of testing, the stability, operation flexibility and comfort of this machine are good in the paddy fields.

articleTitle: Study of blind equalization techniques based on the variable step-size CMA
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Blind equalization technique is one of the popular researching topics in the fields of digital communication nowadays, CMA is the basic algorithm of Bussgang series in blind equalization techniques. Because the step sizes effect on the capability of the CMA, the paper combines the variable step sizes algorithm, thus the new method come out which are blind equalization algorithm based on variable step-sizes. Simulation is done to evaluate their capability.

articleTitle: A design of the wireless detector of temperature, humidity and light intensity
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article mainly illustrate how the P89V51RD2 SCM (Single-Chip Microcomputer) works. As the master control MCU, this type of SCM can make LCD(Liquid crystal display) screen show the temperature, humidity and light intensity from all different paths. We use 4*4 keyboard buttons type in message to control the device. Meanwhile, the master control and subordinate control use cluster communication, which makes it possible to enhance the reliability of data transmission. The detecting system we researched, can make the device detect the temperature, humidity and light intensity. Moreover, it also has other functions, such as data transmission, alarm in both sound and light, long distance alert and so forth.

articleTitle: The nonlinearity simulation study on Electrical Hydrostatic Actuator
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces a new type of actuator, namely Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator (EHA)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. According to the engineering, we choose the asymmetric hydraulic cylinder, establish the mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous motor and EHA, and adopt the MATLAB proceeds to imitate the true research. To solve the problem of nonlinear system, we adopt PID control method.

articleTitle: The urban motor's parking algorithmic
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nowadays, there are so many motors in China but the distribution of parking lots and the parking planning grow slowly, which can't meet the demand of parking and cause a huge waste of resources even. This paper analyses the present parking planning and the parking lots' distribution, then given Assign problem algorithm of parking planning, using Hungarian algorithm to solve the problem, and it is workable.

articleTitle: Nonconforming H1-Galerkin mixed finite element method for nonlinear sine-Gordon equations
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>-Galerkin mixed finite element approximate scheme is proposed with nonconforming quasi-Wilson element for a class of nonlinear sine-Gordon equations. by use of a special property of quasi-Wilson element, i.e. its consistency error is one order higher than the interpolation error, the corresponding optimal error estimates are derived without the generalized elliptic projection which is necessary for classical error estimates of most finite element methods. The scheme is not necessary to satisfy LBB consistency condition.

articleTitle: Research of creating experiment on automatic control
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is crucial for educational personnel to develop the designing and innovative experiments when it comes to cultivate high-level students to society. The ability from study to practice is base task. This paper develop designing experiments on which existing experiment boxes of automatic control are based, including classic control technology and intelligent control technology. The methods of in certain experiments not only can help students to understand the key points of the theory in class and verify so, but also enhance ability of combining theory with practice. Especially to those controlled objects which are difficult to set up mathematical models accurately, students could design new control algorithms that apply to control objects in predestinate norms and to solve the actual problem.

articleTitle: The application of data mining technology in college teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the characteristics of data mining techniques, data mining techniques are introduced into college teaching. By using various aspects of student information as example, this paper makes an analysis about the application of data mining in college teaching and concludes that data mining technology can help teachers to coordinate various kinds of relationships between teaching and learning, can play a guiding role in improving the management level of college teaching.

articleTitle: Development and use of an MCU experimental development board
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The MCU experimental development board is a kind of experiment teaching devices of MCU application system designs, which is combined with course practice teaching characteristics related with MCU according to the open experimental teaching requirements in order to meet students' requirements of finishing experimental design and the independent practice outside the laboratory. It shows that the experimental development board plays an active and effective role in strengthening the engineering practice, improving the quality of teaching and helping students broaden their design ideas and other aspects.

articleTitle: An embedded communication network system based on quantum cryptography communication
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A set of embedded communication network system is constructed according to the reality requirement of quantum cryptography communication to achieve dynamic data transmission. The software and hardware synergy design method is adopted to construct network communications system based on MicroBlaze with EDK and FPGA board as embedded Web server. Furthermore, Gauss random number IP core is designed to generate random number. Such system could be used for high speed and long-distance data transmission on two PC machines and FPGA board to achieve data coordination in quantum cryptography communication.

articleTitle: The research on the effects of Computer Assisted Language Learning on English teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the use of computer technologies in many fields, Computer Assisted Language Learning (CALL) has been playing an increasingly important role in the teaching of English. Multimedia do show their great potential and advantages in English teaching, bringing great convenience and power to English lessons, especially in enhancing the knowledge input and making the English classes interesting, lively. However, the above-mentioned advantages of using multimedia are based on the premise that multimedia are properly used. In the paper, good and bad effects of Computer Assisted Language Learning on English teaching are analyzed so that English teachers can make full use of computer in there teaching.

articleTitle: All digital wideband polar transmitter
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A novel architecture of all-digital polar transmitters is presented, which replaces high dynamic range analog circuits with high speed digital circuits and thus offers lower cost and higher performance compared to those of conventional analog transmitters. The proposed transmitter is mainly composed of an all digital PLL for phase modulation, and 1bit low pass ΣΔ modulator for amplitude modulation and Digital Power Amplifier arrays. The design is modeled and analyzed in MATLAB and realized based on TSMC 65nm CMOS process.

articleTitle: Experimental research on frost resistance of concrete under the action of de-icing salt
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The de-icing salt is widely utilized in Northeast China for its removal of snow and ice. However, the remain of frozen salt from the de-icing salt on concrete roads can lead to erosion. In this paper, frost resistance of concrete under the action of the de-icing salt analysis was carried out, in which concrete freeze-thaw under the action of different types of de-icing salt were researched, and de-icing salt on the different strength concrete function of freeze-thaw were also researched. The analysis of the test data will show that the de-icing salt on concrete's mechanism of action is the same, environmental protection type de-icing salt on surface corrosion is relatively small; corrosion of the de-icing salt on concrete is related with its strength, the strengther the salt content is, the smaller corrosion it is. It will have a guiding significancebe on road design in Northeast China and frost resistance of concrete under the action of de-icing salt analysis.

articleTitle: On the adaptability of LTE services in mobile satellite communications systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper we mainly discuss the adaptability of LTE services in satellite communications systems. Four groups of LTE services are introduced, including the service aspects and transport requirements. Meanwhile several satellite systems are also listed in this paper. Based on these parameters and conditions, the adaptability of LTE services in mobile satellite communications systems is preliminarily discussed in terms of transmission data rate and delay. It can be shown that most LTE services are adaptable to the broadband satellite systems, while less adaptable to the narrowband ones.

articleTitle: GIS-based landslide trend analysis in Lanzhou city
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Lanzhou city is the well-known debris flow areas in the upper reaches of the Yellow River due to terrain steep and broken, a new very active tectonic movement, concentrated rainfall, and the unreasonable activities of human being. This paper analyze the debris flow trend of the valley areas in Lanzhou city based on the degree of development determined by debris flow morphology to build a model for the evaluation of debris flow, then integrated the entropy theory into the assessment model. Finally, the insufficiencies of assessment model have been pointed out.

articleTitle: Land transfer information platform construction and utilize
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article rsearched China's rural land information technology issues and land transfer information platform construction. It analysised the main reason and content of land transfer information platform building. The article indicates the usage of the platform system functions and work processes, to introduce the platform's operating procedures and operational mechanisms, analysis of problems in the construction of the platform and put forword solution of construct platform. Indicating every region should establish land transfer information platform and land transfer information service center in county, township and village levels, to provide an information platform for land transfer, to effective communication of information of land transfer and to to better facilitate the development of the city.

articleTitle: Adaptive multiple feedback interference cancellation scheme for CMMB radio repeaters
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a multiple feedback interference cancellation scheme based on the Partitioned Block Frequency-Domain LMS algorithm for a CMMB (China Mobile Multimedia Broadcasting) radio repeater when the isolation between the transmitting and receiving antennas is much larger than the gain of the radio repeater to provide a larger coverage range. If the large feedback signals received at the receiving antenna can't be suppressed by the repeater, the repeater will get into a vicious circle of sustained enlargement until it goes into self-oscillation. The performance evaluation of the designed scheme is illustrated with simulation results.

articleTitle: A process-guide model for task management
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Task management(TM) is the automation of a business process for supporting multimedia content in whole or part. To achieve the function of TM, the multimedia business process must be abstracted from the real world and described by a kind of formal method. The result is process model. This paper presents a novel approach, called PGM, for modeling and implementing the process model using a process-guide model(PGM). The PGM constitutes a self-contained piece of multimedia content that indivisibly unites three of the content's aspects, namely the media aspect, the semantic aspect, and the functional aspect. The model provides means for the integration of ontological knowledge within a PGM. A formal definition is proposed for PGM.

articleTitle: Control of the gateway security configuration policy
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Today's Internet is more diversified in content, but severely congested. After decades of development, the Internet has profoundly affected our social life. However, filled with many reactionary, violent, pornographic and other unhealthy information, the Internet has became the breeding ground for various social problems, which poses a severe challenge for Network security. This article describes how to filter illegal web pages to achieve a civilized, safe and healthy network environment.

articleTitle: Design and realization of all optical network based on MPLS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With its good transparency, wavelength routing characteristics, compatibility and scalability, all-optical networks have become the first choice of next-generation high-speed network. Taking Henan as a platform and according with the requirements of improving the system transmission rate, this paper will give a reasonable and practical MPLS all-optical network scheme which focuses on the optical transmission and exchange process. This scheme can reduce the nodes processing time and increase the system transmission rate.

articleTitle: Innovating teaching methods of communication circuits
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Communication circuits is a course of theoretical, practicality and comprehensive. This paper explores the methods of establishing engineering-oriented course architecture, including problem-based classroom teaching, multi-level practice teaching and curriculum designing. The goal of the discussion is to improve the ability of students' continuous self-learning, and developing students' hands-on experience as well as skills in problem solving.

articleTitle: Review of vehicle-road vertical coupling
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to research deeply the real road and vehicle status under the vehicle-road vertical coupling, previous researches are summarized in the paper. The research includes 4 main aspects: impact analysis of road surface characteristics to vehicle vibration, road model and coupling impact analysis to road surface under vehicle-road coupling, vehicle-road coupling building and analysis, and vehicle model building and optimization under vehicle-road coupling. Based on the study results, the possible development directions are proposed, which lay the foundation for the future research.

articleTitle: Simulation and implementation of convolution interleave in digital audio broadcasting (DAB) transmission system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a convolution interleaving and de-interleaving design method in Verilog based on RS codes of the digital audio broadcasting system (DAB) is presented. Interleaving technology can improve the performance of digital radio system, and also widely applied to various digital broadcasting systems. By using dual-RAM instead of FIFO in hardware design, the paper implements the above mentioned method based on ALTERA Cyclone III FPGA platform.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional device simulation of polysilicon thin film transistors
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electrical characteristics of polysilicon thin-film transistors (poly-Si TFTs) are strongly affected by density of trap states in the energy bandgap. Based on the single exponential deep state density, two-dimensional simulation is used to construct an n-channel poly-Si TFT and simulate its DC and AC characteristics. Subthreshold swing, threshold voltage and gate capacitances are included. Compact models are derived that can describe the unique behaviors of the aforementioned parameters based on the observation of simulation results.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a knowledge management prototype system of NII
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Neusoft Institute of Information (NII) is a college which focuses its education on IT and IT-related majors. In order to manage and to evolve the curriculums efficiently, a prototype of knowledge management system is designed and implemented, which consists of four modules: basic information maintenance, curriculum management, intelligent service module, statistic analysis module. The prototype system works well in adjusting the curriculum schedule, generating different types of curriculum quickly and automatically, finding the relationship of course titles. The system can establish logical links among courses and recommend the selective courses to student according to the usage of the titles.

articleTitle: Security decision analysis based on A. Shamir's (t, n) threshold secret sharing scheme
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Decentralized storage for the key can help improving its security. This essay is based on A. Shamir's threshold key sharing scheme, focus on the influence (the key, subtle and vague) on the security and ease of use for t\n value's selection, added with the third index of the Yager Fuzzy Theory, and combined with the exact value's complementary judgment matrix, to build a preferred method for the selected alternatives of the strategic decision scheme in the threshold key sharing scheme. The last part of the essay illustrates the feasibility and effectiveness of this method by example.

articleTitle: Research on power communication network real-time based on OPNET simulator
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the OPNET modeling technology is adopted to study the end-to-end real-time performance of service data stream in power communication network in detail. PTN network technology is used to establish PTN test network simulation model of power communication network, and analyze characteristics of data flow in power communication network, message transmission process and packet end-to-end delay. Specific research on end-to-end delay of data stream in different network configuration scence is did, pointing out that the sended data packet size, transmit interval, link background utilization, protocols of higher layer, the number of terminals are the main impact-factors of the real-time performance in power communication network, giving a detail analysis result, and putting forward a helpful scheme for reducing the data packet end-to-end delay.

articleTitle: Study on service-oriented modeling techniques in coordination procurement of cluster supply chain
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As productive forces developing rapidly, “cluster supply chain” is proposed as a new management pattern to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) win in the increasingly fierce competition. Facing complex requirements, it is necessary to build an IT system to support them. Modeling is the basic and the most important part in building a system. This paper combines the advantages of agent and Web service based on the common ground between them. According to certain rules, agent models map to Web service models to complete enterprise collaborative modeling in cluster supply chain.

articleTitle: The research and implement of space jump technology in virtual model room system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper aims to analysis the function of Anchor panel point and its applications in virtual model room for different situations. The research of virtual model room jump technology is for the jump from virtual model room to individual model and from individual model to virtual model room. A new method of smooth jump among the scenes of nested model space is implemented to make the observers feeling like stay in a real model room.

articleTitle: A preliminary discussion of the effect computer-based corpora have on modern lexicography
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Computer technology has radically changed the work of dictionary compilation and brought about a revolution in the writing of dictionaries. Computer-based corpora have an important effect on work of modern lexicography. The article has discussed the shortcomings and disadvantage of pre-electronic corpora in lexicography. It has exposited the effect of computer-based corpora on modern lexicography and the obvious changes and the merits of dictionary writing on the basis of computer-based corpora with exemplification. In conclusion, besides the impact mentioned, it is sure that there are some significant potential influence existing there waiting for further exploration and use.

articleTitle: Design and simulation analysis for mounting system of hybrid vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: By means of the incentive analysis on hybrid vehicle power assembly, mounting parameters of power assembly mounting system, such as centroid position, inertial parameters, were ascertained. The form which the rubber mounted in the front while the hydraulic in the after, was ascertained to be used by designing on amount, type, install and stiffness of mounting system. The simulation model of mounting system was established by ADAMS. And through the six step mode analysis in frequency domain, the accuracy and rationality of the model are proved.

articleTitle: A comprehensive index mechanism based on road network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at effectively store and inquire moving object's continuously movement with time, this article use FNR-tree and MON-tree indexing structure as ideological basis, drawing on the experience of their advantages to design a integrated indexing mechanism CRS which can support inquiring the past, present and future location of the moving objects in the road network.

articleTitle: Probe into the construction of mobile learning resources
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of mobile communication technology and intelligent terminals, mobile learning as new type of learning style is recognized and accepted by an increasing number of users. Effective implementation of mobile learning mainly relies on the construction of learning resources, which relates to the learning process and learning effect. How to construct mobile learning resources in a reasonable and effective way has become an urgent problem to be solved at present. This article makes analysis on the construction of mobile learning software resources (including knowledge and human resources) from the non-technical perspective.

articleTitle: Reform and research on the automation experiment teaching with the network condition
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper discussed the content and methodology reform for experiment teaching, in which the existing problems, such as “Experiment techniques and the related facilities are behind the development of advanced technology”, or “The experiment means does not meet the need in fostering creative ability of university students”, are in focused discussion. As we know, in the experiment teaching of universities, especially for those engineering colleges, the above mentioned problem issues do exist. As a solution the paper proposed an automation experiment teaching system equipped with the advanced techniques and facilities. This advanced, flexible and engineering oriented system supplies the students with an open experiment platform, and also the reform practice for the content and methodology of experiment teaching was performed. A several years practice shows that, the reform obviously improved the manipulative ability, engineering practice ability and creative ability for the college students, and also the reform promoted the progress of the experiment teaching, achieving notable results for teaching issues.

articleTitle: Design and implement of 3G mobile police system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Existing police information system can not meet the mobility, urgency, emergency characteristics of public security industry. Based on the analysis of data processing and Google maps, this paper deals with the design and implement of 3G mobile police system. The system is developed on Android phone mobile development platform and uses mvc+dao design pattern. The system provides the functions, including information search, information collection, file upload, GPS location. Also the combination of client-side programming and server-side programming techniques is used and analyzed.

articleTitle: An efficient multiview video coding plan based on heterogeneous computing system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Starting from brief introduction to fast developing Multi-view Video Coding technology and Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) of General-purpose computing on graphics processing units (GPGPU), we designed an Heterogeneous computing system plan with cooperation of CPU and parallel GPU to accelerate the MVC coding process. To take advantage of GPGPU, parallel MVC motion estimation approach on CUDA was interpreted. For further optimize the system efficiency, a cooperating mode between CPU and GPU are designed.

articleTitle: Design a general-purpose network teaching platform based on blended learning theory
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Considering classroom teaching and online learning as a whole, the activities of teachers and students in the network teaching platform are designed, based on blended learning theory, activity theory and constructivism learning theory. The network teaching platform emphasizes activity and task as its cores, ensuring learning resources and building a learning community. Based on activity theory model, this paper presents a model of learning activity, designs learner activity index and teacher activity index in the platform.

articleTitle: The integrated design of SWH systems in high-rise buildings for hot-summer and warm-winter climates
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a study on the integrated design of solar hot water systems in high-rise buildings for hot-summer and warm-winter climates. The design process was described in detail through a case study in which a high-rise apartment will be built in a southern city (Nanning) of China. This paper also describes how to select an appropriate solar hot water system and auxiliary heating system based on the analysis of the local climate. Suggestions for the integration design in a high-rise building were discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: DS combination method based on the fusion of evidences pretreatment and rules modification
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To suppress the counterintuitive and invalid conclusions produced by the D-S theory of evidence with highly conflicting evidence, a modified evidence approach based on the improvement of both evidence sources and combination rules is proposed. Such a method comprehensively utilizes the advantages of DS theory and additive strategy. First, reliability measurements are applied to generate the weights of evidence sources based on the Pearson correlation coefficient. After that, the conflicting coefficient is apportioned to focal elements based on the weights, which gives reasonable corrections for the fused results. Finally, the improved evidence sources are fused by the modified combination rules, which fully utilize the conflicting information. Examples provided demonstrate the efficiency and rationality of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Inspiration of educational information ecology to construct education information system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article is a summary of research performed in substantiation the philosophical-methodological basis of education information ecology. The research aims are: to give guideline for designing and implementing education information system to promote education effect and its efficiency by constructing better ecology. Research methods: the analysis and evaluation of ecological capacity, the reflection on its adjustability and controllability. Education information ecology is a new perspective and it offers a solution for potential insufficient, unbalance or unduly growth capacity. In order to evaluate the overall effect of this methodology, an approach inspired by Pareto Optimum is given.

articleTitle: Research on function of minimum arrangement plan layout in mechanical teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Arrangement layout of experiment and information subset had been studied by correlated random plan arrangement. The problems in many applied region had been found, arrangement plan, and environmental statistics. In all applications, minimum arrangement plan can be selected and different location and times. In minimum arrangement plan layout, the feasible layout program would be taken when the layout domain and time are discrete from the layout goal and expected result. The main problem is how to solve the minimum arrangement plan layout idea. This is the algorithm DS plan theory problem. In order to apply the DS layout in computer experiments, in many cases, the layout space is not possible to calculate accurately. In order to improve the efficient experiment of arrangement plan, the DS algorithm is developed to take advantage of robustness power of plan algorithm. The test results show that layout idea and construction are very efficient for solving the mistake.

articleTitle: Multi-function vegetation recovery techniques on the land for coal gangue dump in Fushun mining area
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the researches of site quality evaluation and plants community succession investigation on land for coal gangue dump (LCGD) in Fushun mining area, the multi-function vegetation recovery techniques were put into effect on LCGD in Fushun mining area. Firstly the standard fields were chosen and the soil environmental factors were investigated. Then the vegetation population distribution was systematically investigated and analyzed so that the suited vegetation populations for recovery were selected and planted on the standard fields. By tests, the key recovery techniques were generalized including artificial planting grass, grass conservation and reforestation. Finally it was found that the afforestation on LCGD improved the ecological environment in Fushun mining area. The improved effects were introduced and discussed. The research results were not only practical meaningful for recovery and recultivation of LCGD in Fushun mining area, but also theoretical meaningful for vegetation recovery of LCGD in other mining areas in China.

articleTitle: The international training project practice in the independent institute — By using ZUCC as an example
