Secondly, we select four typical clustering algorithms and carry out simulation experiments to compare their clustering quality from both accuracy and efficiency. The work in this paper can give a valuable reference for incremental clustering research.

articleTitle: Image encryption based on bit-plane decomposition and random scrambling
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To aim at the positions interchange of pixels and their gray values change at the same time, we presented a random scrambling algorithm based on bit-planes of image. At first, we decomposed a gray image into several bit-plane images. Then we shuffled them by a random scrambling algorithm separately. Lastly, we merged the scrambled bit-plane images according to their original levels on bit-planes and gained an encrypted image. Experimental results show that the algorithm can not only scramble an image effectively, but also change its histogram apparently. The proposed algorithm has better efficiency and properties than the general random scrambling method, and has more stable scrambling degree than the classical method - Arnold transform.

articleTitle: Design of brushless DC motor control system based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to achieve the precise control of brushless DC motor better, the system utilizes powerful digital signal processing capabilities and rich on-chip peripheral resources of Ti's 32-bit processor TMS320F2812. combining with Pulse Width Modulation tecnology and Proportion Integration Differentiation closed-loop control algorithm based on feedback, designs efficient three-phase full-bridge inverter driver circuit and achieves a reliable control system of brushless DC motor based on Digital Signal Processors platform. Stable, reliable and universal portability performance will make the system has good market prospects and application value.

articleTitle: Study on anti-slip regulation of quarter automobile based on PID control
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A PID control algorithm for Anti-slip Regulation of quarter automobile with slip ratio as the control object has been presented on butt surface. Drive simulation model of quarter automobile, butt surface model and PID control strategy model are established by the MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation tests of butt surface with PID control slip ratio are designed to gain curve change of vehicle speed, driving wheel velocity and slip ratio on different adhesion coefficient surface. The graph proves that the PID control reduces jumpiness range of driving wheel velocity. Curtailment rate of slip ratio error is 98.72%~85.48%. Curtailment rate of starting drive distance is 33.54%. Curtailment rate of starting drive time is 28.85%. Slip ratio is changing in the best predetermine range. The results show that the ASR system can improve starting drive efficiency, automobile tractive ability, maneuverability and stability by the PID control.

articleTitle: A DCT-based dual watermarking algorithm for three-dimensional mesh models
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Robust digital watermarking of three-dimensional models is a effective means to copyright protection, which was studied in recent years, this paper proposed a DCT-based dual watermarking algorithm for Three-Dimensional mesh models, Semi-fragile watermark signal 1 was used to model tampering detection and localization, which was transformed the angel between vectors(from center of gravity to each vertex) and Z Axis; Fingerprint was selected in this paper as the robustness watermark signal 2, which identified author's copyright information. The experimental results showed that the watermarking algorithm can resist all sorts of geometry attack, cutting, and noise, moreover, it has a better watermark transparency.

articleTitle: Research on multi-rate in wireless sensor network based on real platform
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In Wireless sensor network, data is oriented toward the center node together, which leads to funnel effect. From the data transfer rate angle, we put forward multi-rate application in wireless sensor network, make use of different abilities of data processing and characteristics between different data transfer rate, consider the distance or hops that node away from central node and the load around its interference region, distribute nodes' data transfer rate in network reasonably. Multi-rate application in network can weaken the funnel effect and improve the system capacity, throughput, network fairness to some extent. This study is based on real platform, we have done large number of experiments, data statistics, relative analysis to prove the feasibility and validity of the method.

articleTitle: Make best use of social networks via more valuable friend recommendations
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The human factors behind how a user gets in touch with the others are complex especially in twitter-like social networks, which unlike Facebook-like social networks, are gradually showing great power in information propagation. In an effective friend recommendation, the identification of factors that influence links creation between users is essential. This paper makes a full study of the human factors in social networks and takes into account both the users' need of similar friends and diversified friends. This paper, focusing on Twitter-like social networks, enumerates several of those intuitive and connotative criteria in establishing friendship on-line and then designs a recommendation system that fit Twitter-like social networks to help improve the user experience and help user benefit from the architecture and resources from social networks. The recommendation mechanism is developed based on the incorporation of heterophily value and homophily value in establishing friendship into hybrid content and collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm.

articleTitle: A study of cloud education environment design and model construction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, cloud computing as a new type of network technology, Its development speed is very rapidly. In this paper, it construct a functional model of the cloud education from design of the cloud education. It build a virtual desktop that use Ulteo open source technology, and research in more field of modern education technology based on.

articleTitle: A novel bootstrapped switch
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A novel bootstrapped switch is introduced in this paper. At first, the mathematics built in the bootstrapped switch is discussed Secondly, the prototype of the bootstrapped switch is described. At last, the transistor-level circuit of the bootstrapped switch is given. The performance of the bootstrapped switch is tested indirectly by stimulating a sampling and holding circuit containing the bootstrapped switch. The stimulated results show that the bootstrapped switch has a performance with SFDR more than 89dBc, and SNR bigger than 79dB.

articleTitle: Introduction of forward error correction and its application
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nowadays, forward error correction (FEC) is widely used in communication systems for error detection and correction. This paper is a brief introduction about FECs. We firstly introduced the basic principles of FECs and how it works. Different types of FECs are used for different conditions. We compared some of the most widely used FEC codes, for example, linear block code, cyclic codes, CRC code, BCH code, convolutional code, and explained their benefits and drawbacks. Based on these, we focused on the FEC applications both in Internet - the WAN, and in wireless communications - the Broadcast. At last, we did some research on the latest development of FECs.

articleTitle: Toward an extended behavioral intention model for e-learning: Using learning and teaching styles as individual differences
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: E-learning has continued to gain attention in enterprises and universities. As higher education deploys more e-learning systems, it is important for researchers to evaluate the performance of these systems. With the growing trend toward web-based learning systems, behavioral intention models (such as TAM, TPB, TAM2, UTAUT) seem particularly helpful to examine whether and why people use e-learning technologies. Although a number of studies have presented factors that influence the adoption of e-learning, few studies have investigated the moderating effects of cognitive-oriented individual differences. Previous studies have presented various perspectives on individual difference that have focused on demographic variables, such as age, gender, education, and individual experience. Our theoretical model focuses on cognitive-oriented individual differences to synthesize relevant characteristics of users and systems. This study extends the TAM model, the most frequently adopted behavioral intention theory, by considering cognitive-oriented individual differences (e.g., learning and teaching styles) and presenting a new theoretical framework to examine the acceptance of e-learning technologies.

articleTitle: Study and application of non-linear time series prediction in ground source heat pump system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents the calculation of economic indicators which can reflect the geothermal energy utilization of ground source heat pump system. We forecast the technical and economic indicators based on the non-liner time-series data from ground source heat pump and building integrated systems. The paper selects SMOreg and M5P two different non-liner algorithms for forecasting. Through comparing the predictable results from two algorithms, the experimental results show that SMOreg algorithm has higher accuracy when predicting the indicators. In addition, we select more data to experiment for further verifying the forecast accuracy of SMOreg algorithm.

articleTitle: Time-lapse photography applied to educational videos
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Time-lapse is an effective tool for learners to cognize processes that evolve too slowly to be perceived in real-time. As film photography is a comprehensive art, we present methods for making educational time-lapse videos from two aspects, film technology and artistic design. After analyzing the properties of time-lapse, we propose to use digital single lens reflex (DSLR) camera or video camcorder that has a built-in intervalometer for time-lapse flim clips, explore their settings such as shutter speed and interval, and advantages respectively in order to realize a predetermined artistic idea. Finally some time-lapse photography parameters are present for reference.

articleTitle: Fast SIFT algorithm based on Sobel edge detector
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The SIFT (Scale Invariant Feature Transform) algorithm is an approach for extracting distinctive invariant features from images. It is widely used in image matching. Since SIFT detector detects the extreme points through the whole scale space, it often selects keypoints that have no value and reduces the efficiency of the algorithm. This paper proposes a fast SIFT algorithm based on Sobel edge detector. Sobel edge detector is applied to generate an edge group scale space and SIFT detector detects the extreme point under the constraint of the edge group scale space. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm decreases the redundancy of keypoints and speeds up the implementation while the matching rate between different images maintains at a high level. As the threshold of Sobel detector increases, number of keypoints decreases and matching rate gets higher.

articleTitle: Research of intrusion detection based on genetic clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The presented intrusion detection algorithm based on clustering need to know the cluster number before it works in clustering process. Therefore, a new detection algorithm, the Network Anomaly Intrusion Detection based on Genetic Clustering (NAIDGC) algorithm is proposed in this paper. The cluster centers are binary encoded. The sum of the Euclidean distances of the points from their respective cluster centers is adopted as the similarity metric. The optimal cluster centers are chosen by the genetic algorithm. Hence, self-identification of invasions is achieved. The experimental results demonstrate that this method can detect intrusion data efficiently in the network environment.

articleTitle: Optimization design and parametric drawing of Amorphous Alloy Transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Amorphous Alloy Transformer CAD which includes the electromagnetic optimization design and parametric drawing, is researched and worked out in order to solve problems of high design cost and long design cycle. While this software system has an instantiate test, users speak highly of the software because it could reduce the designing cost of 5% ~ 10%, economize expenses of millions and save time from 10 days to 10 minutes.

articleTitle: Prevention research of cracking WPA-PSK key based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Along with the advancing times and the technological development, WLAN technology has been widely applied in our daily work. Apart from the convenience it has brought, it has also triggered several problems. Aimed at WPA encryption method widely used in wireless network, and under the GPU-based highspeed cracking WPA method verified previously, this paper proposes a new defense strategy, analyzes the feasibility of this strategy, carries out simulation experiment to validate the defense strategy, proving that this policy can greatly improve the security of WPA encryption. It has certain significance in guiding the development of wireless networks.

articleTitle: Frequency synchronization in MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper gives a summary of the principles, key techniques and state of the art of frequency synchronization in multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. The system model of frequency synchronization in MIMO systems is given and some assumptions are made first, and the principles and state of the art of the estimation and compensation of carrier frequency offsets (CFOs) are discussed for co-located MIMO and distributed MIMO systems, respectively. By analyzing the disadvantages of the existing research, we present some open issues worth of studying and some promising research interest. The results of analysis show that there has been adequate intensive study on the CFO estimation for co-located MIMO systems while the CFO estimation for distributed MIMO systems and the CFO compensation for MIMO-OFDM (orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) systems appear incomplete and still need further research.

articleTitle: An improved binarization algorithm of QR code image
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The nonuniform illumination QR code image would present all white or all black error areas after global binarization processing. Pseudo-boundary would appear in the processing of local binarization, and the calculation would take long time. This paper puts forward an improved background gray-level based binarization algorithm for the nonuniform illumination QR code image. Firstly, doing sub-block processing according to the size of the QR code image. On this basis, using gray-level estimation formula for computing the gray-level value of each block. Secondly, using joint interpolation algorithm to build the background gray-level image. Then using the background gray-level image to adapt the original image to get the corrected image. Finally, using the Otsu algorithm for the corrected image binarization. Experiments show that the algorithm can do effective correction to uneven illumination QR code image, get a good binary image.

articleTitle: An algorithm for Doppler shift and Doppler rate estimation based on pilot symbols
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To achieve fast carrier synchronization in low SNR circumstances for burst transmission satellite mobile communication systems, we present a joint-estimation algorithm for Doppler shift and Doppler rate based on pilot symbols. The algorithm selects finite Doppler rate test values, figures out several sets of Doppler shift and Doppler rate using existing low-complexity frequency estimation algorithm, and gets the final estimation result according to ML criterion. The simulation results show that this algorithm has low SNR threshold, and its estimation performance is close to Cramer-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB). The algorithm's computational complexity is much lower than ML algorithm, and it is very suitable for practical application.

articleTitle: A packet-scheduling strategy for heterogeneous traffic of Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we give classification for various traffics in Internet of Things according to such features as packet length and importance, and propose priority-based scheduling strategy for efficient packet transmission. Detailed theoretical analysis based on one-server queuing theory is provided to show the superiority of short-packet-first non-preemptive strategy over other strategies. And by simulation experiments in NS2, we verify the effectiveness of our method in term of such performance metrics as end-to-end delay, packet delivery ratio and processing overhead.

articleTitle: Research on web data integration framework based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the sharing of information resources among universities, web data integration framework is proposed. The analysis of the current using situtation of the network information resource as well as the characteristics of various types of information resources of the university website, the paper presents the several ways for data integration according to the characteristics of the different resources, sets the data source selection strategy.

articleTitle: Study and application of PBL in control system course
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Project Based Learning (PBL) is a project oriented as well as student centered teaching method which has been widely used in Europe and America. This paper analyzed the necessity, advantages, methods, process and problems. The emphasis is given to PBL so that they can learn to become autonomous, skilled and explore their own potential as well as improve team work spirit and that can be applied to a wide range of students and subject matters. We have conducted in-depth research on the PBL theory and put it into teaching practice in crane control system. Through our practice we conclude PBL play important role in encouraging collaborative and cooperative learning among students and their peers.

articleTitle: Realization of intelligence monitoring system based on remote sensor technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of living standards, people's demands on security also grow with each passing day. In order to achieve safety monitoring on important places or valuables, a new intelligence monitoring system was designed and implemented. It took the wireless sensor technology and the embedded control technology as the foundation. At the same time, it realized the wireless remote communication with GSM mobile communication technology. The structure, function and working principle of the wireless remote monitoring system were introduced. The hardware and software of the system were all designed and realized. It achieved wireless remote monitoring on important places and valuables finally. Experimental results show that the wireless remote monitoring system works well and has the stable data collection and transmission quality. It has a high value for practical application.

articleTitle: A new method of transforming fuzzy set into vague set and its application
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: How to create vague environment is the precondition of the application based on vague set in recommender systems of electric commerce and so on. According to fuzzy statistics, fuzzy set data of commodity attributes are easy to get to. So, it is worth to research on the method of transforming Fuzzy set into Vague set. This paper presents a new method of transforming Fuzzy set into Vague set, and apply its in recommender systems of electric commerce based on content. The experimental results show that this method is effective and practical, which can not only improve the accuracy of commodity recommended but also provide a new idea of the application of vague set.

articleTitle: Spacial development characteristics of small towns under the background of urban-rural integration: A case study of Qingyang town
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is about the space development characteristics of Qingyang town under the background of urban-rural integration. Through the analysis of urbanization strategies and urban planning in Qingyang, its spacial development characteristics of transportation, township and industries are concluded. And the importance of Qingyang's urbanization strategies and urban planning is explained.

articleTitle: An analysis of the advantages of on-line advertising and design problems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On-line advertising has obvious advantages over traditional media advertising, but equally obvious is the quality problem reflected by its design. This paper makes an analysis of the advantages of on-line advertising, probes the problems in its design and their reasons, and offers some suggestions for the existing design problems.

articleTitle: QoE-based Busy Time management structure for data services
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In Data Network operation, Busy Time is the point which is difficult for Service Providers (SPs) to control user's Quality of Experience (QoE). As the most important Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for data services, Busy Time Throughputs (BTT) per call becomes the focus in network optimization. In view of this situation, this paper puts forward a QoE-based Busy Time management structure, which could detect the Busy Time in real-time adaptively and evaluate QoE at relevant period to find out whether the QoE is effected by the decline of BTT per call. Replace the traditional experience-based Busy Time judgment, by the effective measurement and management of Busy Time, SPs can carry out relative policies on network in corresponding time and improve the average QoE value. At the end of this paper, typical data network WCDMA is taken as an example to validate the availability and efficiency of this structure by improving the QoE evaluation.

articleTitle: The relations between Riemann integrability and the existence of the primitive functions
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: From the three types of integrable functions starting to discuss the relations between Riemann integrability and the existence of the primitive functions, leading a corresponding conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on power quality monitoring system based on DSP and GPRS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper the research is based on DSP and GPRS of electric power quality monitoring system : the TI company high-speed DSP chip on TMS320F2812 is used for data processing, analysis and storage; a high-speed GPRS communication module G24 produced by the MOTOROLA company is used for remote wireless data communication, andRS232 serial communication is used to achieve data information communication between upper monitor. TMS320F2812 digital signal processing chip is taken as the core in this paper, the mutual inductor is used to collect the grid signal, then the resistance to aliasing filter circuit composed of four order infinite gain low pass filter circuit is used to filter the collected signals, after filtering, the signals are sent to conversion chip AD7656 for module transformation; also by using phase lock times frequency characteristics of the circuit, a synchronous sampling signal is sent to A/D conversion chip, and makes the measured signal sampling signal and synchronization effect. Through the AD7656 the output signal, and the output signal can be received and digital signal processor (DSP) analyzed with.

articleTitle: Research on differentiated teaching of finance course for various majors
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The current financial industry has already become a widely covered service industry closely combined with daily life. In this context, the master of certain financial knowledge is not only obligatory to a finance majored student, but also necessary to other students majored in category of finance and economic. But for different majored students, the requirements for financial knowledge are various as the professional characteristics and talents training targets are different. This asks for the teachers adopt differentiated teaching methods on the basis of students' professional characteristics and demands.

articleTitle: Improving custom system using Spansion Linux Flash File System
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: NOR flash memory has been widely used in embedded systems due to its advanced features such as code Execute in Place (XIP), high reliability and fast read performance. With the falling price of microprocessors and SDRAM and the increasing capacity of NOR flash, it is desirable to obtain a file system that can improve system robustness, deliver fast read and write performance as well as lowering development cost and shortening time to market. Spansion Linux Flash File System (SLFSS), a Linux File System Solution based on Spansion Block Driver (SPBD), enables the use of the latest flash technology without compromising, in fact enhancing, device and system liability. It provides an optimal open-source solution that meets aforementioned expectations on the current market. Experimental results show SLFSS proves 20%~60% write performance improvement compared to popular Linux open source flash file system solutions (LFFS) for the typical test cases described in the paper. Finally, suggestion on how to further improve SLFFS performance has been made to conclude the paper.

articleTitle: The Graded College English Teaching Guided by the theory of “i+1”
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The effective teaching mode and students' communicative competence have become the major concerns of college English teaching and research. This paper attempts to explore the Graded College English Teaching under the theory of “i+1”.

articleTitle: The establishment and application of a bio-paleogeographic information system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper designed and established a full-featured bio-paleogeography information system of paleontology, and input the existing fossils' data of the Late Triassic bivalve in Tibetan area. An analysis module based on ArcGIS Engine was developed, which tried to use the ecological attributes of paleontology as a new method of quantitative analysis to reconstruct paleogeography.

articleTitle: Attribute discretization algorithm for data stream based on hierarchical clustering and information entropy
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Attribute discretization is one of the basis pre-treatment methods for data stream mining. For the reason that the attribute discretization algorithm cannot be applied with the highspeed data stream directly, we firstly build a synopsis structure for data stream, then proposed an attribute discretization algorithm based on a synopsis structure, finally, the simulation experiment results show that the method has achieved the problem of data stream attribute discretization.

articleTitle: A video digital watermarking algorithm based on DCT domain
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: 21st Century, The rapid development of information superhighway, such as Internet and mobile communication network. Digital audio and video products are easy to tamper and to copy in large-scale with low-cost. great dissemination capabilities of the Internet gave copyright protection poses a serious impact. For large-scale audio-video products distribution, MPEG-2 Audio-visual products, as verify the carrier, Network audio and video products trading platform is built, the platform has the ability to track the source of piracy. the platform has three core functions. Including home copy generated and encrypted, audio-visual products User copy generated aud encrypted audio-visual products to track pirates. Among them, the digital fingerprint technology the user to copy audio and video products throughout the production, distribution and tracking process. The first, digital works assigned unique identification information. this fingerprint encoded information embedded in digital works, so that different users get different copies of data.

articleTitle: A novel method of measuring quantity of coal dust charge
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The main influencing factors and law of dust electrical charge are analyzed through the dust charge theoretical model in the electric field, based on the dust charge theoretical model combined with the mine dust charge properties. A device is designed for measurement of the dust charge. Through the study of the law of dust's charge-mass ratio in different charge voltages and particle sizes, the feasibility of this device is demonstrated and applied to dust charge, which lays the foundation for further research.

articleTitle: Designing modified digital down conversion using modern digital signal processing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper the method of designing circuit using modern digital signal processing is introduced. A digital down conversion (DDC) in digital IF receiver is designed based on modern DSP technology. a digital down converter (DDC) is used to convert between IF and baseband. These systems implemented interpolators and decimators and low pass filters that remove undesirable spectral imaging and protect against aliasing. A modified CIC in DDC which is called as ISOP_CIC is designed.

articleTitle: Joint channel estimation, equalization, and symbol detection for underwater communication
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Reliable, high data rate, acoustic communication in a time-varying multipath shallow water environment is a recent research area. This paper is concerned with the challenging and timely problem of joint channel estimation, equalization, and symbol detection for underwater communication in the presence of frequency selective and very rapidly time varying channels. The resulting algorithm is based on space alternating generalized expectation maximization(SAGE) technique. In order to reduce the computational complexity of the algorithm, discrete Fourier basis expansion channel model are employed to represent the rapidly time-varying fading channel by the discrete basis coefficients. Numerical results show that the basis expansion represents the time-varying channel very effectively and the proposed algorithm has excellent symbol error rate and channel estimation performance.

Author Keywords: Joint channel estimation and symbol detection

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the energy distribution characteristics in the far-field of the single-mode annular core optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The far-field intensity distribution characteristics of fundamental mode of the annular core optical fibers (ACF) are calculated theoretically based on the weak waveguide approximation in this paper. The simulation results demonstrate that provided the parameters of the ACF are designed properly, the ACF can realize single-mode operation. Besides, the beam will concentrate to the principal maximum position to form a central bright spot indicating great enhancement for the energy focusability of beam, which is valuable for the energy-demand applications in the far-field. These theoretical results possess great significance in designing and manufacturing ACF.

articleTitle: Implementation of time-domain interleaver based on FPGA in DTTB
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A FPGA design of time-domain convolutional interleaver in Chinese Digital Television Terrestrial Broadcasting (DTTB) system is proposed. Synchronous Dynamic Random Access Memory (SDRAM) is adopted in the design. Due to the large interleave-width, an overlarge interleaving unit is divided into some sub interleaving units. The result of the simulation is presented. Owing to the burst mode of SDRAM, the processing speed is lifted and the cost is cut down greatly.

articleTitle: Network topology and firm innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Drawing on a network perspective on interorganizational learning, we argue that a firm can produce more innovations and enjoy better performance if it builds reasonable network topology that provides access to new knowledge developed by other organizations. This study develops a research model that links the properties of knowledge and the features of a firm's knowledge network topology to predict innovation performance. This research chooses questionnaire survey and gets 206 availability records. Using SPSS15.0 and LISREL8.51 software tools, the results show that the network topology has significant, positive or negative effects on firm innovation performance. This model may help decision makers of those types of organizations to effectively turn knowledge into actions by matching their firms' knowledge network topology to the particular properties of the knowledge that is going to be communicated.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of micro-tube device in thermal performance for high power LED cooling system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper reports a micro-tube tank device and FEM simulation using the RGB-based LED design to improve the thermal management of a high power LED arrays. An LED cooling system, using a micro-tube water-cooling device, was successfully designed and simulated. A water-cooling container in the high power LED array gave more efficient convection and the heat created by the LEDs was easily removed in the experiments. It was shown that micro-tube water-cooling systems rendered an improvement in thermal management that effectively decreases the thermal resistance and provides very good thermal dissipation. In addition, both simulation and experimental results show that the LED module with a water-cooling tube exhibits better thermal performances than the others. Accordingly, the results of experiment and simulation demonstrated that a micro-tube water-cooling system is very effective in heat dissipation in LEDs and the fabrication of practical micro-water tube cooling devices for mixing light LEDs was feasible and useful.

articleTitle: Methodology based on economics of new system logic analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Due to the introduction of transaction costs, property rights and institutional aspects of the new institutional economics advocates to look at and analyze the economic life, must be combined with the reality of the institutional environment, the level of transaction costs as the criterion by defining property rights to promote economic growth and efficiency improved. The internal logic of new institutional economics methodology can be simply summed up the man of the people under the constraints of the institutional environment, people born on the system level with the stigma of system is a variety of organizations, including families, businesses and countries, a variety of the organization is combination of various tissues of different people in system under constraint of the relationship between contractual relationship or contractual relationship that is contractual relationship between the members of society, that they both enjoy the right to bear some responsibility for contractual relationship the establishment of the inevitable transaction costs in order to save transaction costs, we must define property rights, because the transaction is not goods, but the rights, property boundaries clear that the premise of market trading, while the definition of property rights border market transactions, the results of system changes is the interaction between system with various organizations, including the structure of property rights and technical structure of the interaction, in addition, ideology of government action and people have a significant impact of institutional change.

articleTitle: Analysis on response of suspender sudden failure of through arch bridge
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For the search on the response of bridge structure at the moment when one suspender of the through arch bridge sudden failure, based on the previous study for the vibration of the structural with continuous distribution characteristics, the paper derived bridge structure vibration equation which under the impact of a broken cable, and using finite element analysis software, simulates and calculates the response of bridge structure of short-length, medium-length, long-length three kinds of suspender, respectively, at the moment of one suspender sudden broken. Compares and analyzes the maximum of internal force and displacement of arch rib of the remaining suspenders, stress and variable quantity of displacement of floor system, discovers the unfavourable mechanical region when the different suspender broken.

articleTitle: The research on the integration of information technology and the University Physics
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the modern information technology, the University Physics integrate with information technology. Under that condition, this paper puts forward a new teaching mode called independent investigative cooperating mode, which enables the college students realize their study targets on knowledge, ability and emotion.

articleTitle: Generic construction for convertible nominative signatures
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nominative signature is an useful cryptographic primitive to limit the publicly verifiable property of ordinary digital signature. In a nominative signature scheme, a nominator and a nominee jointly generate a signature in such a way that only the nominee can check the validity of the signature and further convince a third party of the fact. An extended concept, convertible nominative signature, equips the nominee with the additional ability to convert a nominative signature into a publicly verifiable one. In this paper, we propose a generic construction for convertible nominative signature. Our construction is based on selectively convertible undeniable signature and collision-resistant hash function. Next, we prove our construction is secure assuming the security of the underlying building blocks. Finally, we can apply our generic construction to obtain the first provable secure convertible nominative signature in the standard model.

articleTitle: Measurement and evaluation on China's optimum macro tax burden
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Macroscopic Tax Burden in China is a hot topic in the field of public finance. In this paper, the author try to measure China's tax burden level based on the OECD measurement scale, and then use the OLS model to estimate the optimum tax rate. Although there're still some defects, we can summarize some conclusions.

articleTitle: Spatially distributed energy-based opportunistic cooperative spectrum sensing in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cognitive Radio Networks (CRN), as a promising technology to increase the underutilized fixed allocated spectrum usage, encounters many new practical challenges. Spectrum sensing is one of the key functionalities in CRN. Spatially distributed cooperative spectrum sensing can effectively solve the hidden primary user problem. However, the number of CRs in the cooperation is dynamically changing over time. We study the impact of this dynamic on the spatially distributed cooperative spectrum sensing performance. The dynamic performances are analyzed. The CRN fusion center does lose its sensing performance significantly if the CRN system size is limited too aggressively due to the dynamic spectrum management concerns. Hence, CRN not only is required to dynamically adapt to its surrounding environment but also has to adapt the corresponding sensing parameters due to the dynamic size aspect of the system. The closed-form performance expressions obtained in this paper provide the analytically tractable framework for efficient system design optimization.

articleTitle: Design on the network platform of experiment for Assembly Language and Programming
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Assembly Language and Programming is a course highly depending on practice. Practice teaching is an aid for teacher's classroom teaching. Aiming at the limitation of the practice teaching, a network platform of experiment for Assembly Language and Programming is designed. Via this platform, students can do experiments anytime and anywhere after class, which effectively extends the regular practice teaching. The questions encountered by students during their experiments are answered timely. The communication between the teacher and students has been enhanced. The enthusiasm of students' programming has been stimulated. The teaching effectiveness has been noticeably improved.

articleTitle: Research on missile remote control data link simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to establish the experiment foundation for the key technologies of remote control, Remote Control Data Link (RCDL) simulation based on LAN was studied. In this study, a data package protocol was designed; the high-accuracy time-recorder method in the software timing was used to emulate the delay; the bandwidth was simulated with an accurate traffic control technology. According to simulation effect, the simulation method is effective.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of a stability reverse AODV routing protocol
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As mobile ad hoc networks of mobile nodes in the topology changes frequently lead to the data transmission link was broken. In view of this situation, the analysis of R-AODV routing protocol on the basis that the R-AODV routing protocol deficiencies, Then for this deficiency in the R-AODV routing protocol to join the line stability and the formation of a new routing protocol SR-AODV. Finally, through NS simulation experiments to compare AODV routing protocol, R-AODV routing protocol, SR-AODV routing protocol packet arrival rate, end to end delay, etc., indicating that SR-AODV routing protocol than the R-AODV routing protocol and AODV routing protocol more advantages.

articleTitle: Research on cleaning technology of steel pipe based on AFM
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper propounds a new point that Abrasive Flow Machining is first applied in cleaning the leftover such as copper and nylon on the abdominal wall of steel pipe. Effect of the pressure differences between exit and entrance on the cleaning of the abdominal wall of steel pipe is discussed in detail and the suitable technique parameters of AFM are selected. And then an application sample in steel pipe is presented. Experiments indicated that AFM reaches the requirement of technology and can be applied in many kinds of caliber pipes.

Author Keywords: the abdominal wall of steel pipe

articleTitle: An empirical study on the effect of oil shocks on China's industrial economy
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Oil is extensive involved in industry chain, it is obvious that the oil price shocks could affect all aspects of our production and life through the industry-chains' transmission. Based on the nature of the shocks, we would decompose them into four different types, analyze the transmission mechanisms on some typical industries which in Chinese industry-chain. According to the researches about the influences on typical industries brought by these different shocks, we could find that: because of the various transformation or transference abilities of oil price on industry-chain, different industries in the chain would encounter different impacts; especially the supply oil shocks on the typical sectors are greater than others.

articleTitle: Impact of user grouping on joint network/channel coding
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we will present a joint network/channel decoding algorithm JNCD. This algorithm is used especially on cellular network. In our study, we consider a small network that consists of two transmitters (Mobile Station MS), one relay and one receiver (Base Station BS). We will consider the uplink between MS1, MS2 and BS. The performances of this system will be compared to another system which doesn't use network coding. In our work, we will study the impact of grouping of senders when we use JNCD. Thus, we will consider three cases, firstly, we treat the case when the two MS cross the same transmission channel, secondly, when one user cross a bad transmission channel, and finally, when one user cross a channel that is supposed to be good.

articleTitle: On cooperative learning in college English based on the web platform
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the coming of information era, information process in education featured by internet and multi-media technology becomes the breakthrough of present teaching model reform. Cooperative learning uses internet as a media and takes the form of a learning group to fulfill a learning task together. The paper aims to probe into the connotation of cooperative learning and its basic elements, web-based autonomous learning's influence on cooperative learning and web-based college English CL's active role in language acquisition as well. It also illustrates some existing problems in conducting CL based on the internet, thus discovering a brand-new teaching mode characterized by the combination of web, teaching and cooperative learning.

articleTitle: Application of least square method in intelligent selection of refrigerating compressors
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The traditional methods used to select refrigerating compressors have errors, such as consulting values from charts or estimating values subjectively. It leads to selecting the models of compressors inaccurately. During the course of model selection for compressor, too many parameters are concerned, which leads to a large amount of work and calculation. Method of minimum squares can be used to imitate the performance curves of compressor. It makes selecting compressor without chart and only concerned with condensation temperature and evaporation temperature, which greatly improves the speed and quality of selecting compressor.

articleTitle: Research on enhancing university ideological education staff enthusiasm
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In daily work, the university instructors play important constituents of teacher and management troop. counselor carries out political and ideological education as the backbone of the students in the daily work of management and education organizers, directors and perpetrators. How to improve the counselors to achieve reasonable structure, excellent quality, stable professional team with ensuring its teem viability, which is the most important guarantee that to enhance the effectiveness of the full-time counselors, and full development of students and promote healthy growth, to emphasize the quality of the training. The university instructors are enhanced to thinking, from the environment and the individual to explore two aspects to enhance the vitality and effective way to counselors on professional perspective.

articleTitle: CDLChecker: A WS-CDL analysis tool
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a tool for the analysis of WS-CDL, which gives a global view on the collaboration among a collection of services involving multiple different organizations for independent processes. This tool is named by CDLChecker with providing three functionalities. The first one is the simulation of real WS-CDL programs. The CDLChecker can simulate the execution of WSCDL programs involving Web services provided by the third-party, where external variable definitions are resolved by an XML parser we designed. The second one is to validate the constraints specified in WS-CDL specification. The static and dynamic constraints are specified by abstract machines from B method, and the corresponding validation algorithm is integrated into this tool. The last part of this tool can verify the user-related properties of service choreography, such as channel absence and channel redundancy. The back-end verification engine we used here is the Spin model checker.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of Information Communication System for School Affairs
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Information Communication for School Affairs (ICSA) is a kind of measure for promoting democratic management and facilitating Constructing of Harmony Campus (CHC). Starting from the desire of CHC, the relationship between ICSA and CHC is discussed, and the design and key technology for achievement of Information Communication System for School Affairs (ICSSA) are elaborated.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of learner models in online peer assessment to support learning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Most literature has shown that online peer assessment could improve students' learning in programming. However, how to help them reflect more detail about their knowledge and difficulties is challenge. Learner models can represent students' state in the learning process. Therefore, the study explores the design and implementation of learner models in online peer assessment to help students reflect their learning. A conceptual framework of learner model is proposed, which analyzes the learning process from two dimensions. The two-dimension learner model is open to not only students themselves but also peers. The results hope to advance the theoretical study and the application to opening the learner model to support learning programming.

articleTitle: A design for wireless access control system based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: ZigBee technology brings about the application of wireless communication and data transformation technology in transformation system due to its low cost and low power consumption. This paper presents a solution of access control system base on the ZigBee technology under IEEE802.15.4 standards with the transformation system. The solution of ZigBee is presented mainly adopting RF chip MC13192 with ATMega128, and its hardware circuits and structure and working principle are given too. the proposed method is fit for wireless transformation system for its flexibility, big capacity, extensibility and easily connecting to network.

articleTitle: Application of queue and multi-thread in short message traceability system of broilers products quality
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to improve the level of quality safety management of broilers products, combining theory of agricultural products traceability with technology of short message of mobile phone, traceability system of broilers products quality was developed in integrated development environment of Microsoft Visual Studio 2008 by using 8 port GSM Modem as hardware device. Dedicated to the deficiencies in real-time characteristic, concurrency and other performance of short message applications controlled by GSM Modem, on the basis of queuing theory model, multi-port queue model, multi-threading, thread pool and dynamic database connection pool technology adopted in the system increases the speed and the efficiency of the short message receiving and sending, and improve the overall performance of the system, consequently satisfy consumers' traceability demand of broilers products.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of controlled rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new approach to the experimental investigation of the steady-state stability of controlled rectifiers based on the measurement of the angle between sequential ignitions of the valves is discussed. The statistical treatment of the experimental data shows a special dependence on the deviation of the firing impulses and the amplifier gain factor. Such dependence provides a physical definition for the rectifier stability and its boundaries. The experimental investigation of the increasing of the impulse deviation with an increase of the gain factor has shown that the physical reason for such deviation change and rectifier instability is an increase of a varying component in the control voltage of the firing system input. Analyzing the data about the well-known forms of the rectifier's instability-harmonic, ripple, and low-frequency-it can be concluded that the physical reason for the stability loss is the same: increase of alternating component in the firing control voltage. In conclusion, a new classification of rectifier instability forms is discussed.

articleTitle: Item teaching method in the SQLsever2005 program design
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is based on the item teaching method, discusses the application in the "SQLsever2005 program design" course teaching. and furtherfully analyze influence on the teaching method reform for the whole of the teaching reform of higher vocational colleges, I put forward my some Suggestions.

articleTitle: A model of personalized computing based on probability methods
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The current computing technology consider too much people's demands of computing performance and resource, and accidentally ignore people's special individual requirements of personalized service. To solve the problem, this paper proposed a new personalized computing model. The model predict users individual needs with probability theory, and according to users personalized features to get computing resources and dynamic configuration parameters of computing environment, by through a virtual machine computing environment. At last, the model has realized the target to meet user requirements of personalized computing service.

articleTitle: The Bovine Serum Albumin role's in analyzing the its of soil fungus
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to analyze the Bovine Serum Albumin role's in ITS-PCR technique. We observed the improvement of ITS-PCR application through added BSA in PCR systems. The result shown: In fungi ITS-PCR analysis process, adding BSA should improve the ITS-PCR amplification effect notably and reduce the amount of Taq enzymes, the best use concentration of BSA of 2 μ g/μ l. This suggested: the BSA adding to improve soil fungus ITS-PCR analysis method was feasible; The study provided the basis for applying BSA in soil fungus ITS-PCR analysis technology.

articleTitle: College counselors talk to the educational effect
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Analysis and discussion of the education counselors and students talk at the theoretical level, especially the talk of the importance of education, characteristics and principle pounded. That the talk of the importance of education reflected in the help to improve the quality and efficiency of the ideological and political education work, to establish a harmonious relationship between teachers and students, and help to promote stability and development of institutions of higher learning. Talk of education has four main characteristics of the times, interactive, stage and differences. Counselor education in the talk to uphold the equal respect, honest, reasonable to both the principles of the stock of the situation. Talk to importance of education, the characteristics and principles of a comprehensive exposition of the basis, mainly through questionnaires and interviews and other methods to provide detailed data to support the writing of this article. From the counselor to talk principles, modalities, methods, artistic aspects of a fairly detailed, objective analysis of the counselors and students talk the cause of the problem of education.

articleTitle: Research on the method of multi-level linkage in virtual forest simulation information
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Most forest simulation systems developed for a specific research objectives only use a growth model or simulation technology to simulate the single-granularity forest. It is very time consuming to recalculate growth model for the transformation between different granularity forest scenes. In order to realize the rapid transformation between different granularity forest scenes, this paper presents a method of multilevel linkage in virtual forest simulation information. This method builds the associations of different granularity forest scenes. It can realize continuous transformation from large granularity forest scenes to small granularity forest scenes, and vice versa. The experiment result shows that this method can effectively reduce the transformation time between different granularity forest scenes, and accelerate the rendering speed of large-scale forest scene.

articleTitle: A study of Hunan University of Science and Technology on developing green campus construction in new campus
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Green society is the society that human and nature develop together harmoniously. It is a concrete manifestation of sustainable development society. Green campus is an important component of green society. Building a green campus not only benefits the school's standard management and sustainable development, but also is the practice of the Party's inherent requirement of the Scientific Development and is to meet the actual needs of China's national conditions. This article firstly introduces the topography and the geomorphology of the new campus of Hunan University of Technology and Science, secondly analysises on the feasibility of carrying out green construction, thirdly focuses on water source heat pump air conditioning system, ecological sewage disposal system and drinking water system. Finally, it advises some effective measures to improve those, and makes some effective forecasts for reference.

Author Keywords: water source heat pump air conditioning system

articleTitle: ForCES transaction mechanism research based on Petri net model
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Open programmable network architecture which based on ForCES is one of the important research on the develop of next-generation network equipment. In this paper, we have studied the transaction management in ForCES channel. First, we have detail introduced the distributed transaction management structure and process in ForCES router. And second, we have built the Petri net model of the communicate between CE and FEs based on reliable multicast. And last, we have analyzed some performance parameters in this model.

articleTitle: The analysis and implementation of UDP-based cross-platform data transmission
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The analysis and implementation of UDP-based cross-platform data shows that the advantages of UDP protocol are better understood and it's the best places of application. Further, master the knowledge of data transmission and the operation to XML file. By parsing an XML document, which will extract the data stored, and then packaged in these data through the UDP protocol, send data to the receiving program, After the receiving program receives the data, the data in the package open, extract original data, and then use these data to generate relevant content of the XML file, in the end output. In addition, the article also reflects the advantage of Java language: cross-platform.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis between undergraduates' interpersonal relationship and computer games
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Through carrying out an investigation among undergraduates in Wenzhou city by “Comprehensive Diagnosis Scale of Interpersonal Relationship”, we discuss the interrelation and the factors between undergraduates' interpersonal relationship and computer games. It is shown that it is not optimistic for undergraduates' interpersonal relationship on the whole. It is distinctly related with the time spent in playing games, the types of games and the actual interactive behavior during the games. Moreover, it can lessen the interpersonal relationship problems when they play the computer games moderately. On the contrary, those who play games overtime, or play role-play games, action and adventure games too much resulting in too less interactive behavior during the games will have much more problems relating to interpersonal relationship.

articleTitle: The measurement performance of multi-path gas ultrasonic flowmeter in the non-ideal flow field
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The experiments on an ultrasonic flowmeter with 100mm diameter were carried out, including reference experiments, upstream 90° single bend and double bends experiments with different upstream straight pipe lengths. The results were analyzed and discussed from the viewpoint of flow field distribution based on numerical simulation. The results show that when the upstream and downstream straight pipe length is certain, the meter factor increases at first and stays unchanged basically with the flow increased. The linearity is mainly affected by low flow. The 90° single bend and double bends in front of the flowmeter disturbs the flow field distribution after the bend. The flow field behind the double bends is more complex so the flow measurement performance of the flowmeter is more affected. In order to ensure the relative error of the average meter factor less than ± 0.5%, the minimum straight pipe length in front of the flowmeter is respectively 20D and 30D under the installation of 90° single bend and double bends.

articleTitle: The analysis of benchmark circuit output surge applied in smart meters chip
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When benchmark circuit of the smart meters chip is driving large, capacitive load output becomes instability. In order to solve this problem, a new method is proposed to reduce or even eliminate the output oscillation of benchmark circuit, which is based on an equivalent model of circuit and the closed loop negative feedback circuit oscillation principle of the oscillator. This method has been validated by simulating based on Cadence software and 0.5μm CMOS technique.

articleTitle: A new extending orthogonal space-time block coding
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The extending orthogonal space-time block code is constituted by identical orthogonal space-time block code (OSTBC). However, the channel fading coefficient of each branch of each OSTBC is not taken into consideration. For this problem, an improved extending orthogonal space-time block code is proposed. Analysis shows that the system performance is enhanced, and the computational complexity is also greatly reduced with only a few bits increasing of feedback information. Simulation supports the conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on the coupling role of school-enterprise cooperation in education and ideological and political education
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To face with the new situation of ideological and political education, prate effectively the coupling role of school-enterprise cooperation and the ideological and political education, not only conductive to teaching students from theory to practice over teaching, but also increase the actual weight of better job for the graduate students. This article describes the concept of school-enterprise cooperation in education and the current new situation of ideological and political education, analyzing the coupling role of school-enterprise cooperation in education and ideological and political education, with investigating the practice gains and urgent problem in education of school-enterprise cooperation coupled with the ideological and political education.

articleTitle: Experimental study on edge effects of bending forming of sheet metal using plasma arc
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When flexible forming of sheet metal using plasma arc scanning along a straight line, we find that the forming edge appears warping deformation and the bending angle varies along the scanning path, the phenomenas are defined as edge effects, which will reduce the accuracy of forming of sheet metal seriously. The edge effects and its formation laws that appear in negative bending and positive bending were experimental studied in the paper. The results showed that the middle position of the edge warps away from plasma arc and there is a visible pit on the bilateral planes of the edge of negative bending, the middle position of edge warps towards to plasma arc and there is a visible tuber on the bilateral planes of the edge of positive bending, the bending angles along the scanning path are inconsistent because of the warping edge. Finally, the influence of the edge effects on the circular surface forming was analyzed.

articleTitle: How the CRC algorithm in Xmodem protocol implementation in FPGA
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Xmodem protocol requires a CRC to ensure the data correct. There are many implementations of the CRC algorithm. Based on the hardware circuit, this paper studies the typical LFSR circuit, the implementation of the single-byte and multi-byte parallel circuit, and then achieves synthesis design using VHDL language.

articleTitle: Measurement of the undergraduate's learning ability
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the basis of literature analysis and open questionnaires and interview, the theoretical model of undergraduate's learning ability was ascertained. 1215 undergraduates were tested. The questionnaire of undergraduate's learning ability was developed by item analysis, exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis. 50 items of questionnaires have been reserved, including four factors, i.e., analytic capacity and productive capacity, knowledge capacity and transfer capacity, executive capacity, and enhancement capacity. The questionnaire was proved to be of good reliability and validity so it is suitable for testing the characteristics of learning ability.

articleTitle: A new structure for high speed access
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article presents a new bloom structure which is calculable and reduces the total number of access to traditional hash schemes. Traditional schemes promote the use of multiple-choice hashing, such as d-random and d-left. However, it costs some times in choice when flows stored which translates much more times of access and it makes the scheme incalculable. In this paper, we propose a new structure which just spends certain times of access in choice and is calculable. The multilevel hash table scheme we propose gets a good consequence in the case where we spend a little more resource but much less total numbers of access than traditional schemes.

articleTitle: A novel method for getting online audio packets
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: How to get online audio packets quickly from network traffic is important to online audio surveillance and management. This paper presents a fast obtaining online audio packets algorithm. When the online audio stream appears, this algorithm could easily get all its following packets from network traffic only by doing xor and shift operation on IP address and Port filed of a packet. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has better performance in higher network traffic.

articleTitle: The debugging and operation of UASB & SBR process in treatment alcohol wastewater
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the character of alcohol wastewater in some corporation, this article introduces sewage treatment processes, technique principles and characteristics about UASB & SBR process, and discusses the effect and problem in debugging and operation. The results show that the process operates flexible, has good stability, and has high removal effect to COD, BOD and SS, which appear the process is unique and has broad application prospect.

articleTitle: A study on influences of abnormal moisture transport on Southwest China
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The airflow trajectory model based on Lagrange method (HYSPLITv4.9) was applied to diagnose weather and climate. By simulating three dimension trajectory of the target area and using the airflow trajectory pattern based on Lagrange method, time-dependent curve of air mass and height dependent curve of specific humidity of the same air were drawn and the effect of moisture transport on Southwest China was analyzed concretely.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of unified identity management system based on SAML
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Firstly it discusses the necessity of unified identity management in this paper. Then it analyses several major kinds of realization technology and application models of unified identity authentication at the present stage. And then in this paper it has proposed and realized one kind of management system of unified identity based on SAML on the basis, and also explained the main points of the unified authentication module and the single sign-on module of the system. The system can provide the functions of the unified identity management and the single sign-on to the current application system instead of carrying on a large number of modifications to the system, and it's easy to be used and convenient for upgrading the application system of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research of a intelligent traffic model based on Ad Hoc network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On presenter most last and medium-size cities were in very serious trouble of traffic jams. If we can distribute the road resource reasonably, gathering the traffic information of congestion roads and the quasi-congestion road dynamically, that can assist the drivers to make the right judgments. Thus the drivers can avoid the congestion roads and achieve the purpose of ease the traffic congestion fundamentally. What be discussed in this paper is to establish an intelligent model of traffic based on Ad Hoc network. Vehicles can obtained the road information in the Ad Hoc network timely and make right judgment and decisions. At the same time the parking lot information can also be obtained in the Ad Hoc network. and the drivers can select the optimal parking place.

articleTitle: The research of electric car battery monitoring system based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In view of the work characteristics of EV batteries, a set of ARM-based monitoring system for EV batteries was designed in this subject. This system was used to realize the functions of real-time monitoring, charge and discharge control, patrolling, temperature detection and pre-alarm for cell and the entire set of EV lithium ion batteries, so it extended battery life, improved the energy efficiency and operating reliability.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of edge effect in plasma arc forming of sheet metal
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Edge effect was found in plasma arc forming process of sheet metal, which reduces the forming accuracy of sheet metal seriously. In order to reveal the forming mechanism and forming laws of the edge effect. A numerical model on forming of sheet metal using plasma arc with scanning along a straight line was established and the forming mechanism and forming laws of the edge effect were studied. The results showed that the upper material and the lower material of the edge were produced shrinkage along the scanning path and both shrinkage were different. The size relationship of the two shrinkage determines the direction of edge warp. The difference of the two shrinkage affects the warpage of the edge.
