In the comprehensive effect of shrinkage and warpage, the non scanning region in the both sides of the scanning path appears bulge or depression. The numerical analysis results were agree well with the experimental results. The conclusions provide a theoretical basis to reduce the effect of the edge effect on the accuracy of the sheet metal forming.

articleTitle: The integrated design of SWH systems in high-rise buildings for hot-summer and warm-winter climates: Analysis of heat-collecting performanc of the integrated solar system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a case study in which solar heat-collecting performance of the integrated solar hot-water system was discussed with numerical simulation. The solar system is integrated into a high-rise residential building. Calculation results show that a combination of solar collectors installed on the roof and wall can produce enough hot water which could meet design requirement. Furthermore, the calculation using annual average data was compared to that using monthly average data. It was found that there is a great difference in the required solar heat-collecting area every month.

Author Keywords: Hot summer and warm winter climates

articleTitle: Logic program in the multi-negotiations
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article is based on several rounds of negotiation between the two Agents, introducing three or more parties in the negotiation. Between the two Agents, it's hard for the Agents to obtain the optimal solution at the same time. But if there is a third Agent to take part in the negotiation, May make the all parties in the negotiations to obtain the optimal solution or suboptimal solution. So, in each rounds of the negotiation, one of the parties in the negotiation may need to give up the optimal solution. This paper takes the order of the literal in the receive set and give up set by the separate way. The Agents, according to their own expectations of priority, decide which Agent to trade.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a network teaching platform for remote education
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to reduce the stress of the teaching, encourage students to self-study, improve teaching efficiency and facilitate teaching and management, a network teaching platform for remote education is designed and implemented. It makes the most use of OOP (Object-oriented Programming) and adopts B/S architecture. It combines observer pattern and MVC pattern to implement all functions of network teaching platform based on web, including personal management, course, test, homework, statistics and Q&A modules et al.

articleTitle: Introducing phase correlation into the course of signals and systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Phase correlation has been widely used in many areas, such as, time delay estimation, motion estimation for video coding, and image registration. The fundamental of phase correlation is some basic properties of the Fourier Transform. It is proposed in this paper to introduce phase correlation into the course of signals and systems, and it is suggested that phase correlation be taught just on finishing the following properties of the Fourier Transform: linearity, time shifting, frequency shifting, scaling and symmetry. In this paper, phase correlation is proved as one property (called as phase correlation property) of the Fourier Transform, and examples are used to demonstrate the efficiency of the time delay estimation method based on the phase correlation property, even when noises exist in the delayed version of the original signal. Some problems for homework are also provided. These contents were first taught experimentally in two classes including 73 students, at Yangtze University in the Spring of 2010, and the results are satisfactory.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of MES framework in Pangang Group
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In consideration of the characteristics of MES construction of steelmaking, hot rolling and cold rolling, this paper presents constructing MES framework for rapid construction of MES application system. MES framework is realized by multi-layer C/S mode, respectively, client system, interface agent, application server. Client system performs authority control of user operation, component upgrade, etc. Interface agent provides network access transparency. Application server performs authority control, data subscribe /publish, Object-relational mapping, database access, component management, etc. Constructing MES application system with framework enables maximum code reuse, significantly improves development efficiency of MES system and boosts stability and maintainability of MES application system.

articleTitle: 2D simulation of flow around two parallel square cylinders
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is concerned with a mathematical model for numerical simulation of 2D flow around two parallel square cylinders. The governing water equations are solved by a implicit bidiagonal numerical scheme, based on the MacCormack's predictor-corrector technique. The mathematical model is used to numerically compute the water flow around two parallel square cylinders in a rectangular open channel, which shows that the proposed method is accurate, reliable and effective.

Author Keywords: flow around two parallel square cylinders

articleTitle: Dynamic programming algorithm for generating two-staged homogenous strip cutting patterns
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The cutting cost of general two-staged patterns is relatively high when the unit cutting cost is expensive. A dynamic programming algorithm for generating two-staged homogenous strip cutting patterns is presented in this paper. It can obviously reduce the number of cuts to maximize the pattern value. The algorithm determines the strip layout on the plate optimally at the first stage. The strips of the same homogenous block are cut jointly into pieces at the second stage. The experimental computational indicates that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of welded hollow spherical joints interpenetrated by circular steel pipe
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In large-scale grid structure, the load bearing capacity of welded hollow spherical can be increased effectively by transfixing main steel pipe through the hollow spherical, and now this method has been applied in engineering. In order to investigate the change laws of the capacity of spherical interpenetrated by main steel pipe, and explore the calculation method of spherical joint, ANSYS program was used in this paper to simulate spherical joint. Taking the diameter of hollow ball and the diameter of circular steel pipe as variables, the change laws of the load bearing capacity and the stress of the hollow spherical were investigated, and the degree of the axial force transfixion coefficient influenced by the diameter of circular steel pipe was also discussed. The conclusion can be referred for design of welded hollow spherial joint interpenetrated by steel pipe.

articleTitle: Identity-based new secure SP management mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Today service fraud in value added service market have turned to be a major problem in the Internet, such as SMS spam, deceiving money using SMS and price fraud. In this paper an enhanced Service Provider (SP) secure management method using identity-based solution is proposed. In this system, service subscription, payment and other sensitive information related messages must be signed by a user or SP. So the system obtains non-repudiation of subscription and billing, and the SP forced and reverse subscription can be avoided. By using a special feature of ID-based solution, this method can easily control SP.

articleTitle: The strength feature and the cause of sea clutter under different atmosphere duct
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper simulated and analyzed the atmospheric refraction environment on Dartmouth Canada in 1993. Two data files with different strength duct are used to analyze sea clutter strength feature. Moreover, the mechanism of sea clutter is discussed through the ray tracing and the propagation loss. The main results and contributions are as following: (1) The experiments on Dartmouth exits evaporation duct were made; (2) That sea clutter strength in the stronger duct is larger than that in the weaker duct is obtained; (3) It is found that the electromagnetic wave ray propagate farther, the propagation loss are smaller in the stronger duct environment, which are the causes of sea clutter strength feature.

articleTitle: Suppressing the block effect of fractal image compression by smoothing locally with quasi-X shape template
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new method of suppressing the block effect brought about by fractal image compression is proposed by means of introducing quasi-X shape template into the process of smoothing image locally on the reconstructed color image compressed by the fractal method based on iterated function system. The effects of the two different kinds of smooth templates, quasi-X shape and traditional square are compared with each other. It is found that the mosaic effect can be suppressed effectively with the help of quasi-X shape template in the process of smoothing image locally under the condition that certain objective image quality measured by the PSNR value is guaranteed. At the same time, the compression ratio is improved by means of getting rid of the position parameters of range blocks as one kind of redundancy when adopting the method of fractal image compression during the process of compressing color image, taking the fact that range blocks are stored in encoding file successively into account.

articleTitle: Shotgun photoelectric positioning of the optical system hardware and software design
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Shotgun photoelectric positioning technology is a key technology of virtual reality training system for clay target shooter. It was used to detect the 3D spatial attitude of the shotgun. To realize the testing of spatial attitude of shotgun the combinative methods of simulating gun, high-speed camera, and double beam splitting thin films are used, then to obtain gun's 3D coordinates the calculation is performed by means of the light spot center position solved by MATLAB software and the model established by the optical system. Consequently the problems of low measurement accuracy, narrow range and sensitive to magnetic fields are solved.

Author Keywords: virtual reality training system for clay target shooter

articleTitle: The analysis and repair on bituminous pavement main damages of highway
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the traffic load heavy, traffic flow channel, traffic density increases trends, many highway performances have been gradually began to decay, such as road damages, carrying capacity, anti-slide sharply worsen. Highway cannot provide for vehicles, safe, comfortable, fast operation environment. Therefore, timely to highway maintenance and repair, make its use to recover and improve the performance, extend the use fixed number of year, this way not only for highway management department provides the huge economic efficiency, but also for the convenience of travel, highway users to promote social material circulation is ensured. The main damages of bituminous pavement are analyzed, such as crack, hole-slot, frost boiling and so on.

articleTitle: Reflection on process evaluation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The research literature of process evaluation, which was either published in core periodicals or some research projects in recent years, was hackled. The process evaluation was summarized and analyzed in its object, content, methods and tools, etc. We think that when the practitioners make the process evaluation, at first, their evaluation objects should include teachers and students who should be actively participate in the evaluation. The evaluation should promote the comprehensive growth of students and professional development of teachers. Secondly, the evaluation should take a variety of forms, and be as possible as simple and convenient to operate. It also should strengthen the reflection from teachers and students. Finally, the research content, to which the process evaluation can be made to explore, is proposed.

articleTitle: Protocol mechanism against flood attacks in Ad Hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In Ad Hoc networks, some malicious nodes broadcast plenty of useless route request packets in order to occupy the resources. To prevent these flood attacks. This paper proposed a improved protocol mechanism including validity test and packets buffer. Then this mechanism has been implemented based on protocol AODV in Network Simulator (NS) and the simulation results show that our protocol can recognize the malicious nodes efficiently to decrease the routing cost and maintain a high delivery.

articleTitle: A Web entity activity recognition approach based on k-nearest neighbors classifier
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the traditional information extraction, this paper puts forward an approach to recognizing entity activity form Web. Entity activity which describes the behaviour or action information about the entity is valuable to recognize for search engine, business intelligence, data integration and so on. Since Web entity activities, as multi-relationships, are contained in unstructured text in the Web, recognizing entity activities is a difficult problem in current information extraction area. In this paper, we rigorously define the recognition task firstly and propose a novel recognition framework to extract entity activities form Web. Firstly, this paper proposes a k-nearest neighbors classifier based on sentence similarity to discover the sentences which contain web entity activity. Then, according to dependency parsing feature, we use a set of heuristic rules to extract the information from sentences. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of our proposed approach and it can adapt to multi-domains.

articleTitle: Inter-frame interleaved Bi-SOVA alogrithm for Underwater Acoustic Communication
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For divergence of the adaptive DFE leading to loss of data frames and affecting the performance of Turbo decoding in harsh UAC (Underwater Acoustic Communication) channel, inter-frame interleaved Bi-SOVA decoding algorithm was proposed. Inter-frame interleaved Bi-SOVA algorithm encodes and decodes the whole data packet (28 frames) to correct the lost frames, since it can distribute error bits randomly. For inter-frame interleaved Bi-SOVA decoding algorithm leading to large data storage and intolerable decoding delay, sliding window decoding technology and the golden prime interleaver are adopted to optimize data storage, meanwhile DMA technology of ADSP-21160 is applied to optimize decoding delay. According to the result of practical experiment, under the same size of data packet, inter-frame interleaved Bi-SOVA, compared to classical Bi-SOVA, doesn't increase data storage and decoding delay, meanwhile improve the decoding performance greatly. And it will correct 20% error frames under the best conditions.

articleTitle: Effect of the thickness of blue emitting layer on organic light-emitting devices
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Organic light-emitting devices based on the blue fluorescent 4,4'-bis(2,2'-diphenylvinyl)-1, 1'-biphenyl(DPVBi) and red phosphorescent tris(1-pheny-lisoquinolinolato-C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, N)iridium(III) [Ir(piq)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>] emitters were fabricated, with a structure of ITO/ NPB (40 nm)/ DPVBi (d)/ CBP: Ir(piq)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (15 nm, 6%)/Bphen (40 nm)/Mg:Ag (200 nm). The effect of the thickness variation of the DPVBi on the device performance was studied. The results showed that, the device with 5-nm DPVBi had relatively higher luminance and current efficiency, while the device performance was reduced as increasing the thickness of DPVBi. Moreover, as for the device with thicker DPVBi, stronger blue emission than red emission can be observed in the electroluminescent spectra.

articleTitle: Application of an algorithm for the computation of functional similarity in the research of protein interaction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The similarity among gene products based on gene ontology terminology is mainly measured through semantic similarity, which first computes the semantic similarity among gene ontology terminologies and then computes the similarity among gene products related to GO terminologies. Methods for computing the semantic similarity in the first step are either information-quantity-based or semantic-distance-based. The former category considers the information quantity of the nodes themselves while neglecting the structure of gene ontology; the later category neglects the semantic relations among the nodes in gene ontology and the uneven distribution of connections between nodes. This paper proposes a comprehensive approach where the similarity is first computed on the terminological level, inducing density-constraining and depth-constraining variables based on the microscopic structure (density and depth of the nodes) of the gene ontology nodes, then based on node properties and node-based instances, the comprehensive semantic similarity is computed. Published researches regarding the functional similarity in the second step are rare. Considering the defect of computing the functional similarity by averaging, a new weighted functional similarity algorithm is proposed. The effects of 4 algorithms: average-based, maximum-based, Wang and WSim are evaluated by means of ROC curve using the interaction data of human protein and fruit fly protein from the DIP database. Result of comparison proves that the proposed weighted algorithm is favorable.

articleTitle: Research on the application of watermark technology in digital works' electronic business
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper is about the application of watermark technology in digital works' electronic business, And it can make digital works not only exchange expediently but also form its copyright protection system. Firstly, we put forward the trading project of digital works' adopting watermark technology. Then on the base of Relation Model and the probability idea, this technology provided the digital works' copyright protection and tracing in transmitting after electronic trading, which is a new taste of digital watermark's application in the security of digital works' e-business.

articleTitle: Routing algorithm in FQn with a large number of faulty nodes
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper, we propose a routing algorithm in FQ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> with large number of faulty nodes under assumption that FQ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> is local k-sub-folded-hypercube-connectivity. Based on the algorithm, at least K = min(D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>(u), D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>(v)) disjoint paths can be found, and each has the length bounded by (d(U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>, V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>) + 3)2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>. u and v are the source and destination respectively. D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>(u) and D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>(v) represent the number of non-faulty neighbors of U and V respectively (not considering the internal non-faulty neighbors of U and V in U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub> and V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>). d(U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>, V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>) stands for the distance between two basic k-sub-folded-hypercube U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub> and V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>. This routing algorithm is distributed and local-information-based that each node in FQ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> knows only its neighbors' status but no global information is required. So it has strong sense and application in real life.

articleTitle: Research of dynamic base state method for spatio-temporal data model
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the analysis of existed base state with amendments data model, this paper proposed a dynamic base state method for spatio-temporal data model. By introducing the conception of dynamic base state and dynamic storage space, the data structure has been analyzed and retrieval process has been developed. Then, by comparison with existing models in our experiment, this method proved to be the most efficient method with the least disk space occupation.

articleTitle: The design of local bus interface unit based on PCI9054
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: PCI9054 is a general interface chip made by the PLX Company of USA, ARINC659 Bus Control Chip needs to communicate with processor through PCI9054 chip. The paper has introduced a general design method of PCI bus interface, has described the mechanism of the metastability and given conditions for reducing metastable produce, confirmed the design plan of local bus interface unit and programmed the design on FPGA using Verilog HDL language. This programme works stability, the transmission of data is accurately, has achieved high-speed communications with the PCI bus. Currently, the design of local bus interface unit has finished the verification of function and timing simulation, is able to support PCI9054 to access internal memory and registers of ARINC659 Bus Control Chip in the combined method of single-cycle and burst, and has passed verifying test in FPGA prototype system based on Xilinx.

articleTitle: High performance wireless LAN in 60 GHz band with MIMO transmission
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper investigates spatial interference for networks in 60 GHz band and presents a integrated 60GHz transmission module. It consists of a serial bus interface that encodes the channel selection, configures the analog parts and manages the power. Narrow beams are essential for overcoming higher path loss and can be implemented using compact electronically steerable antenna arrays. The proposed package utilizes mainstream manufacturing and automated assembly process, it paves the way for the market success of 60 GHz applications. Because low variation in phase shift across process and temperature implies, each element is set phase-shift without any calibration for variations. The direction spread measure is treated with information of the power distribution of the components.

articleTitle: The research on 3S integrated system technology in marine fishery and resources environment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper analyzed and explained the current status of information technology, as well as the principle, framework, technological processes, functions, and features of 3S integrated system in the field of marine fishery and resources environment. Furthermore, this paper discussed the application project of 3S integrated technology in marine fishery resources environment.

articleTitle: Well-posedness research of mobile learning devices
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, mobile technology is widely used in education, mobile learning devices updates fast. This has become a great challenge on designing mobile learning devices. FRAME model reveals the definition of mobile learning, describes the relationship between learners and equipment. In the FRAME model, the author brings the mathematical concept of well-posedness educational technology, describes the characteristics of learners and characterization-centered mobile learning device design methods, and proposes well-posedness of mobile learning devices based on learners' need.

articleTitle: Application of interval mathematics theory in used vehicle evaluation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the flourishing of used vehicle trade, the research of used vehicle evaluation means become a hot point. Taking the most representative production cost method as the example, the valid range of some evaluation parameters are given by application interval mathematics theory, then and a evaluation value for the vehicle owner's choice is obtained. This is a new road to evaluate used vehicle, which can make the evaluation means be more valid and more accurate, make the evaluation results be steady.

articleTitle: Image retrieval in data stream using principle component analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Image Retrieval in Data Stream is becoming very important in recent years with the development of internet and the focus on information security. In Data Stream, image retrieval is different from the traditional image retrieval in that, it requires high efficiency and network adaptive ability, while the traditional image retrieval does not have such hard requirements. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to retrieval image in data stream using Principle Component Analysis(PCA). By subdividing image into several blocks and extracting image principle features, our method can retrieval image very efficiently, this meets the needs of wide band width network traffic. Because the natural character of PCA, our method can be adaptive to the network traffic by simply modify a few parameters by an automatic way. Our experiments show that our approach has high Recall Rate and very low False Positive Rate.

articleTitle: Further interval oscillation theorems for second-order neutral equations with damping and distributed deviating arguments
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Further oscillation theorems of a class of second-order neutral equations are discussed. These theorems are discussed with the condition that f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(y(t)) is nonmonotonic. These theorems are of higher degree of generality and deal with the cases which are not covered by the known criteria. Particularly, these criteria extend and unify a number of existing results.

articleTitle: Applied exploration of information technology in school's health quality education
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The trend of education informatization exceeds the pace of reform in health quality education. The combination of multi-media technology and website technology is applied into the teaching and practice of health quality. Realizing multi-medizaion, resource globalization, teaching individuality, studying cooperation and education environment virtualization is a development trend of the school's health quality education. Therefore overall integration of information technology and health quality education should be found to promote the reform of teaching method and achieve the objective of changing the school's physical education to health quality education.

articleTitle: A mining algorithm based on time series association rules
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the concept lattice theory, this paper studies the cycle of association rule mining about the periodic fluctuations of time-series. First of all, do anti-season pretreatment to time-series, then give the algorithm of the generation of the cycle of association rules, and the pruning to the generated concept within algorithm improve the efficiency of the mining speed. And then we can use the given higher precision model to do anti-season changes calculation to those time series which dissatisfy anti-season pretreatment using the moving average method.

articleTitle: Research on the building and sharing mechanism of PE informationization and college PE resources
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article begins on the expanding of the college PE functions through the current situation of college PE, the building and development of PE informationization. It brings forward the content of the informationization of college PE resources; the mechanism of common construction of PE resources; the mechanism of quality control, so as to construct an operational system of standardization, modernization and systemization of college PE resources. And enhance the development of PE informationization.

articleTitle: Study on fuel oil temperature PID control system and simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Fuel oil viscosity is mainly affected by temperature, and however fuel oil temperature is a large inertia variable. Using PID control algorithm, may leads to certain over regulation in the control process. Based on the principle of thermodynamics and heat transfer, starting from establishing mathematical model of temperature control system, the fuel oil temperature PID control was studied in this paper. Further more, the control process MATLAB/Simulink simulation was carried out, with a resultant precise simulation figure. This provides a comparable reference to further improving for fuel oil temperature control process.

articleTitle: Study of investigating and improving negative space in an old urban block of Nanning city: Strategies for improving negative space
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the results of field investigation and literature analysis documented in our previous paper, this paper focuses on strategies to transform negative space to positive space in an old urban block called Water Street in a southern city (Nanning) of China. The following improving strategies were proposed: (1) the fundamental principle for space transformation is to preserve its original spatial features and building style as much as possible; (2) adjusting public traffic patterns, green belt levels, commercial sequence, and boundaries of buildings by modifying spatial layout and perfecting urban function structure; (3) improving the outdoor thermal environment, increasing the comfort level of outer environments of buildings, and creating pleasant outdoor spaces by tree-planting, solar shading structure, and other measures.

articleTitle: The optimization of large-scale SVM using nest template ant clustering in kernel space
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: If the training data sets are large-scale, the SVM models turn into large-scale quadratic programming problems and are hard to be effectively solved. That is the main reason why the learning efficiency of SVM is so low on large-scale data sets. According to the principle of SVM, the border support vectors play a decisive role on the SVM decision hyper-plane. The nest template ant clustering algorithm in kernel space is proposed. The algorithm is used to extract border support vectors from large-scale training datasets. When using the less border support vectors to train SVM, the scale of SVM is reduced and the training performance is improved. The algorithm has better adaptability than the kernel K-means algorithm. Experimental results on UCI datasets show that the algorithm is effective, and the classification accuracy of SVM is still maintained.

articleTitle: Chinese parsing model based on Constraint Dependency Grammar
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Constraint Dependency Grammar (CDG) is a formalism representing grammatical rules as constraints on dependency relations. It reduces the structural ambiguity via constraint-propagation without generating individual parse trees. In this paper, we propose a high quality parsing model for Chinese, which defines the phrase molecule lexicalizing the CDG at the word-level. Ternary constraints are used to improve the accuracy and efficiency of parsing.

articleTitle: The research on key technologies of 3G network for industrial applications
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As wireless technology matures, industry control network has been gradually entering the wireless era. In this paper, it mainly talks about the key technologies of applying 3G network into industrial applications. In the meanwhile, it gives a analyses about the feasibility of 3G network, and makes a discussion on the access point technology of 3G network. In order to explain the redundancy communication network and device data integration technology, this paper gives the detailed steps of designing and implementing a supervisory system. Data and message transmission is used for as redundancy communication and OPC is used as data integration technology. More, the supervisory system takes the gateway-technology for the access point of 3G network. At the end, this paper will give a experiment which the supervisory system interconnects with the WIA network and PROFIBUS network, the result shows that the supervisory system work stabile and reliably.

articleTitle: Adaptive notch filter based on LMS algorithm and its application in ground tilt data processing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The basic principles of adaptive notch filter are derived in detail in this paper. The possibility of gaining reference signal by the use of signal frequency estimation through the approach of adaptive notch filter is studied. The numerical experiments extracting the specific harmonic wave by using this notch filter show that when the frequency of the extracted composition is very close to that of the noise composition, the filtering effect of the adaptive notch filter will be obviously decreased, and the close range is 1e-3~1e-4. The idea of restraining various types of tides in sequence is proposed at first and it obtains the long-term trend of tides. The three types of ground tides are effectively filtered out respectively to pick-up the long-term trend of the tilt observed data. The research results show that the adaptive notch filter has a lower frequency-drift range and performs well in process of the observed data so that its application is promising in the signal process of surface-wave data, free oscillation wave data and earthquake precursor acquisition data.

articleTitle: Segmentation of sport image based on level set method
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In image analysis engineering, accurate statistics of sport image is one of the most important subjects. In this paper, image acquisition and processing system is designed to accomplish image preprocessing, image segmentation and statistics of sport image. Segmentation of sport images is successfully realized by means of a region-based level set method and then the sport image is computed precisely, which plays an important role in optimizing the growth conditions of sport image.

articleTitle: Research and improvement of feedback cancellation for CMMB on-channel repeater
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As CMMB network is single-frequency network (SFN), the feedback cancellation of digital on-channel repeater becomes an outstanding problems about network coverage. But the traditional digital on-channel repeater has more inter-symbol interference (ISI), so this paper puts forward an equalized digital on-channel repeater (DOCR), which can effectively correct the ISI, synchronization the input and output, and improve the isolation between the receiving antenna and transmitting antenna.

articleTitle: Ship pollution situation and control measures
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With constant change and development of shipping, shipping markets increasingly prosperous, seagoing ships more ship tonnage and increasing marine pollution problems are becoming more serious, in the operation of ships in the process, inevitably, directly or indirectly in a number of substances and energy into the marine environment, resulting in damage to the marine environment and marine pollution risks to human health. Explains ways and hazards of pollution from ships, analyzed the current situation of pollution from ships, made a number of measures to be taken to mitigate the pollution in the marine environment.

articleTitle: The modeling and simulation of PWM mode for permanent magnet brushless DC motor
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper builds the mathematical model of permanent magnet brushless DC motor(BLDCM), and adopts back electromotive force(EMF) of sensorless method to get rotor position information according to the requirements of the motor armature voltage signal with low harmonic requirements. Then the paper analyzes the impact that BLDCM adopts the PWM mode for the back EMF testing, at the same time builds the model and simulates in Pspice, and gives the motor armature voltage and current simulation waveforms for BLDCM in four different PWM mode. The simulation results show that the harmonic component of motor armature voltage is minimal in HPWM-LON modulation mode., so it is very important that selecting suitable PWM mode is stable operation for BLDCM. Therefore, it has very important role to select suitable PWM mode for stable operation of the BLDCM.

articleTitle: The activation, transformation, and updates of the abandoned mining area: Take the Quantai, Xuzhou mining area's concept design of landscape for example
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As the mineral resources are depleting, the environmental governance and the transformation and development of the old industrial bases of abandoned mining area have been the primary problems of resource-based cities' economic and social development. In this paper, we start with the background of Quantai, Jiawang mining area's Industrial Wasteland and the problems caused by its close, then analysis the advantage of conditions and the specific measures of the Industrial Wasteland's Redevelopment, combine today's domestic and international industrial wasteland's method of update and reconstruction. Finally, based on the construction of urban history and culture, we proposed the recovery plan of Quantai's abandoned mining area's landscape.

articleTitle: MIMO-OFDM scheme based on parity bit selected spreading
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a novel transmission scheme is developed to effectively combine parity bit selected spreading technique and MIMO-OFDM to obtain improved bit error rate performance in the presence of frequency selective fading channels with low system complexity. Unlike conventional MIMO-OFDMA, where users are separated in different frequency bands (subchannels), and each user is coded separately using STBC or SFBC, the proposed new scheme enables multi access by joint code design across multiple antennas, subcarriers, and users. Such system will benefit from the combined space and frequency domain freedom as well as multiuser diversity. Hence, better spectrum efficiency is achieved while improving bit error rate performance with respect to signal-to-interference ratio.

articleTitle: Performance analysis for spectrum sensing over fading reporting channels
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) technology is an emerging technology to improve the utilization of radio spectrum. Cooperative sensing is used to enhance the efficiency of the cognitive radio network (CRN). In this paper, we consider the probability of detection or false alarm under constant detection rate and constant false alarm rate scenarios over the imperfect reporting channels. We illustrate that all secondary users in the network don't achieve the optimal performance in cooperative spectrum sensing.

articleTitle: Joint properties of tilted angles of spin for 6061 aluminum alloys in friction stir welded experiments
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The applicability of friction stir welding to 6061 aluminum alloy with a cylinder-screw-shaped S45C steel spin has been investigated. Three different tilted angles of spin were designed in the friction stir welding experiments. Experimental results have shown that surface defects at spin tilted angle were not observed at the weld zone such as face, toe and root of the weld, and a concentric onion ring pattern with increasing tilted angle of spin appears to be faintly visible. The tensile strength of the butt joints of tilted angles of spin are found to be higher that that of the normal. Also, butt joints through tilted angles of spin are higher than that of substrate matrix, while the tensile strength of the normal was less that that of the substrate matrix. The proposed procedure was applied at butt joints of friction stir welding, and the implementation results demonstrated its feasibility and effectiveness to improve tensile tested experiments for developing robust friction stir welding.

articleTitle: Using collaborative reading annotation system with self-regulated learning mechanisms to promote reading performance in English
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Designing a collaborative reading annotation tool with functionalities for annotating a digital English article can accumulate and share the knowledge of readers who participate in reading learning processes in a web-based learning environment. The annotated content helps new readers understand articles and helps readers who have read an article obtain a deeper and broader understanding than when reading digital article without annotations. However, the self-regulated learning ability of individual learner on reading learning materials and contributing reading annotations becomes a key factor affecting learning performance of collaborative reading annotation. Thus, this work proposes a self-regulated learning assisted mechanism in a collaborative reading annotation system which can promote learners' reading annotation abilities in order to facilitate more high quality reading annotations generated by learners during performing reading annotation processes. The experimental results demonstrate that the reading comprehension performance and reading annotation abilities of the learners can be improved while using collaborative reading annotation system with self-regulated learning mechanism. Moreover, the reading comprehension performance and reading annotation abilities of the learners with high and low self-regulated learning abilities have significant difference.

articleTitle: Application of PID neural network in headbox multivariable decoupling control
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at the control problems of headbox in papermaking process, such as the nonlinearity and serious coupling relationship between pressure and liquid level, a kind of PID neural network decoupling controller is designed. The experience data of PID control is used to determine the initial value of the weight and make the controlled variables vary with the given values, which realizes the decoupling control of the multivariable system. The simulation results show that the PID neural network decoupling controller meets the requirements of the control performance index, which has high practical value.

articleTitle: The application of data warehouse in decision support system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The author of this paper expounds the decision supporting system in light with the data warehouse technology, and analyzes profoundly the systematic structure and disadvantages of traditional decision supporting system. On the basis, the author of this paper discusses the importance of applying data excavation technology to the decision supporting system with examples that can provide new measures to cultivating the decision supporting system with better performance.

articleTitle: A 3–14GHz ultra-wideband low-noise amplifier in 0.13μm CMOS using double-channel and global noise-cancellation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A 1.2V 3-14GHz ultra-wideband (UWB) CMOS low noise amplifier (LNA) is reported. By the utilization of double channel topology the input matching, flat gain as well as low noise is achieved simultaneously. The LNA obtains the maximum S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub> of 14.2dB in band. Maximum gain rippling is only 0.1dB across the desired broadband. IIP3 of -3dBm at 8GHz is obtained. The I/O reflection coefficient are both better than -10.2dB. The noise figure (NF) falls from 3.72dB to 1.46dB with frequency monotonically, and the power dissipation is merely 10.5mW.

articleTitle: Application of GPS/InSAR fusion technology in dynamic monitoring of mining subsidence in western mining areas
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a mining face of Tingnan mining subsidence basin in Shanxi Province was selected as experimental area. This article attempted to conduct the dynamic monitoring research to coal mining subsidence in western mining areas by use the method of combing D-InSAR and GPS technology. The observation points were installed on the main section and the three-dimensional coordinates of the points were measured by use the method of dynamic differential GPS. Meanwhile, the radar images of this subsidence area were processed by use the method of interferometry with daris software and interferogram of subsidence area was obtained. Through this study, the GPS monitoring data and the InSAR deformation data were integrated and the dynamic subsidence contours of experimental area were obtained. GPS/InSAR fusion technology provides a new technological mean to large-scale dynamic monitoring of coal mining subsidence in western mountainous mining areas and shows good applying prospect in coal mining subsidence monitoring and disaster warning.

articleTitle: The closing loop impulse current calculation of integrated deployment based on cyclized loop automatic search and layout show
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of the urban grid, there are increasing numbers of grid bidirectional power supply and Multi-power supply modes. Loop Closing operation in Distribution Network becomes more and more frequent. This paper focuses on loop closing operation in Distribution Network with impact current calculation methods. We make a research on cyclized loop automatic search; generate the deployment of the integrated model, closing loop layout show and the impact of the closing loop current calculation method. As a result, we come out the impact of current calculation methods in deployment of the integrated model. The method avoids the analysis based on the separate distribution network model, eliminates the error by transmission and distribution model of alternating iterations, and thus to ensure high accuracy.

articleTitle: Gradient model based P2P VoD content distribution policy
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: P2P based VoD (Video on Demand) system has low cost, high scalability and high video quality features, which make it become one of the most popular research hotspots and evolution trends. Content distribution policy is the key point of P2P VoD technology. Against the problems of data scheduling policy priority and node performance difference in content distribution, this paper researched the influence of scheduling policies for network performance information, the degree of content scarcity and broadcast emergency, and on the basis, the gradient model based data distribution policy is proposed. Through the utilization of distributed gradient model strategy, sender start strategy and receiver start strategy, each node interacts only with the part of nodes to reduce the conflict caused by the load balance. Experiment proved that our policy improves content delivery speeds and reduces the network load.

articleTitle: An access control model for multidomain collaborative environments based on shared permittions
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An access control model for multidomain collaborative environments based on shared permittions is presented. The model can realize secure resource sharing and interoperation among different domains. It classifies permissions of an administrative domain into two categories: private permissions that can only be accessed by subjects within the domain, and sharing permissions which can be shared by other domains. Security administrators can define constraints for a sharing permission according to its sensitivity. The enforcement of these constraints supports the least privilege principle among domains. The secure interoperation requirements among different domains can be expressed by the definition of inter-domain authorization policies. Finally, the authorization steps for different domains are given.

articleTitle: A study of the features of Internet language
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The wide spread of computers and the Internet makes Internet language an important language phenomenon, which has attracted the attention of linguists both at home and abroad. The development of information technology brings about the popularity of Internet Language. The net speech community promotes information exchange on line, creating a relatively free panel for netizens to express their emotion and exchange ideas. With its scientific language and social condition for its emergence, it takes on certain features.

articleTitle: Exploration on internationalizing software engineering education
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The internationalization of higher education has been a dominant trend of most universities, meanwhile the need of qualified international software engineers is pressing as the rapid development of software industry. The study on internationalizing software engineering education has been becoming an urgent issue to the universities in China. In this paper, the main problems on the way to internationalize software engineering education are analyzed. Based on these problems, the School of Software Engineering in Beijing Jiaotong University is making some exploration on pushing Chinese software engineering education internationalization, which is presented in the paper. The achievements may be taken as a reference and example to speed up the process of internationalization of software engineering education in China.

articleTitle: An analysis report of consumers' perceived risk in group purchase
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Group purchase is a burgeoning model of electronic commerce. Perceived risk is the subjective obstacle of consumers to attend group purchase. This report is mainly based on six dimensions: financial risk, performance risk, intimate risk, gregarious risk, physical risk and service risk. To make an analysis of consumers' perceived risk in online group purchase. To explore the concrete constitution and expression of these dimensions in online group purchase. To advance tactics from consumers and the organizers of group purchase to reduce the perceived risk.

articleTitle: A security-enhanced key authorization management scheme for trusted computing platform
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Secure storage is one of the important functionalities in trusted computing platform. The key management is one of the important technologies in secure storage. There is a key synchronization problem in the existing trusted key authorization management mechanism for Trusted Computing Platform. To solve the problem, we propose a security-enhanced trusted key authorization management scheme. The new scheme can effectively enhance the trust and security of the trusted storage through adding child key information in parent key.

articleTitle: The research of multi-agent intelligent management information system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Base on the Multi-Agent System with basic research and Multi-Agent Intelligent Management Information System for theory and application, to design a framework for intelligent management information system model thereby achieve this model's implementation strategy. Firstly, describe the principle of Agent technology and Agent system. Secondly, provide the method and process of Intelligent Management Information System realized by Agent technology through analysis for Intelligent Management Information System. Finally, starting from corporation's organization and process analysis establish Multi-Agent Intelligent Management Information System supported by Dynamic Enterprise Modeling (DEM), and develop how the system realize support of dynamic adjustment for the corporation's organization and business processes.

articleTitle: The analysis on the collective forest property rights institution reform with game theory
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The forestry development and the environment improvement are bound by a common cause. When the demand of improving the environment increases, the people pay more attention to the forestry development. In this text, I analyzed the reasons, content and performance of the reform of collective forest property rights institution with game theory, and concluded that devolving the using rights of forest land and property rights of timber trees to farmers though implementing reform of collective forest property rights institution would increases the production enthusiasm of farmers, and it is helpful to promote the coordinated development of forestry and improve the environment.

Author Keywords: Reform of Collective Forest Property Rights Institution

articleTitle: Network teaching platform and its applications in language learning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The initial concept of the campus network is defined as "network virtual schools", classified subject platforms are established on the campus network in lots of universities. The recent launch of the English language learning platform based on Moodle, along with the proposal of the concept of "establishing a virtual campus online foreign language college", enable the campus network hardware platform a real application, and thus a dynamic integration of English network teaching and English classroom teaching. This paper introduces the Moodle-based English language learning platform and hopes to provide a useful reference for the optimization of college English teaching.

articleTitle: An invitation transmission based MAC protocol for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper we present an invitation transmission based MAC protocol (I-MAC) for wireless sensor network. I-MAC adopts an invitation mechanism based on synchronized schedule to improve the utilization of medium thereby reducing the latency. Firstly I-MAC defines a child nodes-parent node pairs which has only one father node (f-node) and several son nodes (s-node). An invitation table is maintained in f-node. F-node fills the necessary information of invitation in the invitation-control packet so that each s-node knows who will be invited in next step. Secondly in I-MAC, f-node can invite multiple s-nodes to transmit their packets in SLEEP period. Therefore packets can be transmitted to sink faster than traditional MAC protocols. In other words, I-MAC reduces the latency of each hop. Our simulation results in ns-2 show that I-MAC achieves significant improvement in terms of end-to-end delivery delay. Furthermore, our simulation results shows I-MAC also increases network throughput without sacrificing energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on enhancing the university counselors vocational vitality
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In daily work, the university instructors play important constituents of teacher and management troop. counselor carries out political and ideological education as the backbone of the students in the daily work of management and education organizers, directors and perpetrators. How to improve the counselors to achieve reasonable structure, excellent quality, stable professional team with ensuring its teem viability, which is the most important guarantee that to enhance the effectiveness of the full-time counselors, and full development of students and promote healthy growth, to emphasize the quality of the training. The university instructors are enhanced to thinking, from the environment and the individual to explore two aspects to enhance the vitality and effective way to counselors on professional perspective.

articleTitle: Digital archives of video cases: Inherited learning in aboriginal artistry
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Jaw's harp is an important asset which functions as a message conveyer and affection expression in the past for indigenous Truku people in Taiwan. However, as the old generation gradually passes away, preserving this traditional musical instrument appears to be a more challenging and urgent task for the young generation. On the other hand, Digital Archives has become increasingly common in this era of science and technology that provides online access to archived digital datasets and documents in a systematic fashion. Therefore, in this study we employ Digital Archives as an approach to increase student's self-efficacy of making jaw harps, and to investigate the effect of the above approach. For this purpose a Web-based Traditional Instruments Workshops (WTIW) was designed for and implemented in a practicum course of making Taiwan indigenous Truku people's jaw's harp. The majority of participants possessed positive attitude and gave assurance to the teaching environment of WTIW. Therefore, digital archive appears to be an appropriate method to promote students' motivation to learn musical instruments making; thus, it contributes positively of preserving and inheriting indigenous jaw's harp culture.

articleTitle: Superconvergence and extrapolation analysis of ACM finite element methods for nonlinear viscoelasticity equation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, ACM finite element method is applied to the approximation of nonlinear viscoelasticity equation for the semi-discrete scheme. by the integral identity, averaging technique and interpolated post processing techniques, the superclose and the global superconvergence properties with order O(h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3.5</sup>) are derived. Furthermore, through constructing a suitable extrapolation scheme, higher accuracy of extrapolation solution is obtained. The results proposed in the paper are the same as that of the linear case in the previous literature.

articleTitle: Research advances in the Usability Evaluation for the computer games
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Evaluation is an essential step in the process of the design and development of a computer game system. By it, the defect of the system can be found immediately. So it directly decides the quality of a computer game. In the evaluation of the computer games, Usability Evaluation is a core content. Being lack of the relative theory and practice in China Mainland, introducing the quite perfect foreign study experience about the Usability Evaluation for the computer games is necessary. Aiming to arouse the domestic researchers' concern to the Usability Evaluation, this paper demonstrates the foreign research progresses about the conception of the usability of the computer game, methods of heuristics design, usability evaluation methods, the comparative studies and performance evaluation on the usability evaluation methods. Finally, the trend of the study of usability evaluation methods for the computer games is analyzed.

articleTitle: The failure distribution for service layer of communication networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Pioneers have done numerous studies on failure distribution of hardware and software. However, seldom research has been done for networks. Consequently the situations such as insufficient reliability testing and the unscientific reliability assessment usually happen during engineering application. This paper proposes a general method to determine failure distribution and relative parameter for service layer of communication networks, and analyses the different failure law for service layer of communication networks according to the performance test data in PingER database. The research shows that not all the failure distributions for service layer of communication networks obey the binomial ones. They are related to network performance parameters and failure criterions, while the binomial distribution is still the main form.

articleTitle: The statistics and analysis of packet traffic distribution characters in access network based on NetMagic platform
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Packet traffic has random characters and relates to different layers. This paper aims to analyze the statistics characters of real packets on service node interface (SNI) of access network, using complex Poisson distributed probability model to describe the characters of the number of received packets, and using tri-modal distributed probability model to describe the characters of the packet length. K-S fit tests are used to evaluate these models and achieve high accuracy results. Based on these models, a probability model of packet traffic is proposed. The methods can be extended to research higher layer network traffic characters.

articleTitle: Test technology of inner wall of tube based on CCD
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper presents a new method that computer vision technology based on CCD is applied in testing the inner wall of tube. The existing edge detection method is analyzed. The precise extraction algorithm of cracking edge location based on spatial moment is derived in detail. By using software algorithms, the precise edge location can reach sub-pixel level; the crack length of artillery bore can be measured accurately.

articleTitle: Influence of emitting waveforms' correlation on clutter suppression performance of MIMO radar
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at the constraints imposed on MIMO radar's clutter suppression performance by emitting waveforms' correlation, Based on the theoretical derivation of output SINR and improvement factor's expression, simulation results confirm that the proposed improvement factor can effectively promote the clutter suppression performance of airborne MIMO radar.

articleTitle: The implementation of an evaluation system of English phoneme pronunciation quality
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents an objective evaluation system of English phoneme pronunciation. This system gives an objective evaluation and feedback from students' pronunciation by analyzing the waveform and calculating the Mel Mel-Frequency Cepstrum Coefficients (MFCC) Euclidean distance between students' pronunciation and the standard pronunciation using the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm. This helps students learn English phonemes without any teacher involved.

articleTitle: The application of isolation technology in Area E of Guangdong Science Center
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the isolation characteristics of Area E in Guangdong Science Center, the new Shockproof objective is put forward. The isolation technology used in Area E of Guangdong Science Center is researched, including the application of isolation technology and superiority in China and abroad, isolation technology design, simulated earthquake investigation of shaking-table test, bearings of isolation and damping performance test, isolation bearing construction technology, isolation bearing deformation monitoring, which achieved the application of results and the resulting economic and social benefits. It also can provide a reference for similar projects.

articleTitle: Teachers' mediation in Computer- and Classroom-Based College English
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Transformation of the teaching model entails a fundamental change of teachers' role. This paper interprets the implementation of Computer- and Classroom-Based College English Teaching Model in Hebei University of Science and Technology, and then, based on the theories of mediation proposed by Feuerstein, Williams and Burden, analyses the teacher's role as a mediator. It aims to help College English teachers get involved in students' learning process effectively, develop their ability to use English, and at the same time guide them to learn how to learn with greater individuality, and promote their sustainability of English learning to the maximum extent.

Author Keywords: Computer- and Classroom-Based College English Teaching Mode

articleTitle: Research on the model of teachers knowledge sharing platform based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Knowledge management focuses on the process of knowledge creation, this paper try to make the knowledge creation process more rational and effective via a variety of management means, including the improvement of management systems, information systems, and the effective incentive mechanism. A sharing platform which building by spirit and essence of knowledge management, led to explicit knowledge and tacit knowledge of teachers exchange and knowledge innovation by means of information, in order to achieve innovation in traditional education, promote educational reform, enhance the teaching quality and create a more advantage competitive environments for teachers.

articleTitle: VTD: A monitoring index of transmission quality for streaming media
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Requirements are strict in Streaming media technology for network bandwidth, audio/video real-time data transmission and continuous playback. At the same time, the user also has a certain requirements in quality of service of streaming media application QoS(Quality of Service), and asks the system to provide a commitment for network bandwidth, end to end delay, physical jitter, packet error rate and other index. Therefore, how to build strong QoS management mechanisms to meet the requirements of users is imminent. However, its monitoring technology has no uniform standard to support. There are some limitations in the current indicators, so this paper proposes packet transmission time based on monitoring indicators calculated index of VTD (Video Timestamp Dithering), which is not only widely applied, but also timelier and accurate reflection of the network jitter.

articleTitle: Network coding gain estimation for reliable multicast in wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Recently, network coding has been applied to reliable multicast in wireless networks to improve the transmission efficiency. The expected value of network coding gain, i.e., the ratio of the average number of transmissions per packet when using the conventional non-coding transmission to that when using the coding-based transmission, is an important metric to understand the benefit from using network coding. It is notable, however, that the direct calculation of expected coding gain is computationally infeasible. This paper introduces an efficient estimation for the expected coding gain with much lower computation cost. A formula is also derived to bound the error from our estimation.

articleTitle: Research on trustworthy software composition architecture
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper analyzes the relationship between trustworthiness attributes and proposes models of trustworthiness attributes and their relationship, finally trustworthy software composition architecture (TSCA) is provided. According to TSCA, The paper brings out a trustworthy software evaluation method which based on hierarchical thinking and fuzzy estimation algorithm.

articleTitle: Fast mosaic for remote sensing images based on artificial immune network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper proposes a stitching algorithm of fast serial image mosaic for UAV remote sensing images based on artificial immune system. Firstly, it extracts the large edges using the method that based on Wavelet and Canny edge detector, and takes sequential similarity detection algorithm (SSDA) as similarity measure and uses artificial immune network algorithm to speed up the searching of the initial transformation parameters. Based on the result of the image matching, the two images are stitched. Simulation experimental results show that the algorithm presented in the paper greatly improves the operation speed, while the precision remains fine, so it can be applied in real-time mosaicking of serial images from UAV very well.

articleTitle: On oscillation of solutions of hyperbolic equations with continuous distributed deviating arguments
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, A class of hyperbolic nonlinear equations with continuous distributed deviating arguments is studied and new oscillation criteria are obtained. Our results are sharper than those known in the literature.

articleTitle: Study on risk assessment method of urban bridges in operation period
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to carry out risk management of urban bridges in operation period conveniently, a framework for risk assessment of urban bridges in operation period is proposed. This method consists of the risk accident database, the identification method of risk source, the method of risk estimation and risk evaluation. Based on the basic process of risk assessment, the risk assessment of a single-tower cable-stayed bridge in operation period located in Tianjin is carried out. The results show that the method proposed in this paper is practical and effective. When this bridge in operation period is affected by seismic load, structure damage is likely to happen. In order to ensure the safe use of this bridge, seismic design and operational monitoring should be enhanced.

articleTitle: The use of wavelet transform and Numerical Algorithm in application to the parameter properties of the ultrasonic nondestructive flaw detector
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: During the parameter properties tests of the ultrasonic nondestructive flaw detector, signal processing will be interfered by two factors, namely, interference from external devices and the random noise results from the collecting process by the card collection. In this parameter properties tests, it use wavelet transform. This is due to the fact that the former one's frequency division ability as well as its local analysis ability can efficiently eliminate random disturbance, thereby ensuring the high frequency component in the effective wave, and further we can restore the signal effectively through reconstruction. In the purpose of improving accuracy, the apply of the method of the Numerical Algorithm is recommended during the work next to data preprocessing. The application of curve-fitting makes testing results more accurate.

articleTitle: Transmission system parameters design of 1GF-170 type reverse stubble rotavator
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces basic parameters design of driveline and working process of type 1GF-170 reverse stubble rotavator. This machine adopts reverse stubble once completing rice and wheat straw stubble, buried stubble and rotary operation. According to the blade shaft speed and the gear teeth which rotary tiller required, reasonably calculate the transmission ratio. The rotavator drives smoothly, buries stubble effectively, and has a high efficiency, suitable for dual-purpose straw for the job of flood and drought.

articleTitle: The research on data analyzing and processing of solid ducted rocket test based on artificial neural network method
