publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the difficulty in judging the abnormal test data of solid ducted rocket, this paper introduces a data mining method based on artificial neural network to detect and recovery the abnormal parameters. The method has been verified with test data of a certain type of motor. The research shows that artificial neural network method is an efficient, reliable and novel approach for data analyzing and processing of solid ducted rocket test.

articleTitle: Economic model analysis on the relationship between regional logistics and regional economic in Huai'an
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the qualitative analysis of the relationship between Huai'an regional logistics and regional economic growth, the paper defines the measures of regional logistics and regional economic development level. The Granger causality test model is used to describe the relationship between regional logistics and economic growth in Huai'an. The result shows that in the long term, the relationship between regional logistics and regional economic growth is consistent with the results of qualitative analysis. That is, Huai'an GDP increment is proportional to the logistic increment. Research can provide quantity basis for the synergy analysis of regional logistic and economic.

articleTitle: Research and design of CRT controller based on CPLD
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The design of CRT controller is studied, which is applied in the Speech Interactive System based on ASIC. CRT controller based on CPLD is presented. MCU flexible read and write to RAM with CPLD. Meanwhile, the simulation is also given based on Maxplus II. The simulating results prove that the design can reach the demand of real time exchanging, and has integrality, reliability and good applications in the Speech Interactive System.

articleTitle: The research on measuring sensor for steel bars in reinforced concrete and its circuit
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the correspondence principle between Air Gap and Inductance, Inductive Capacitance and Resonant Frequency, this paper points out, the Magnetic resistance type transition element, which is made of iron core coil and resonant circuit, could get the Resonant Frequency from the Air Gap Length for Magnetic Path. According to this correspondence, SCM rates data and generates a correspondent form in finite points. Through look-up the form by Resonant Frequency in measuring, the length of Magnetic Path could be calculated by the way of linear-fitting. The length of Air Gap, which is got from different angles on Steel Bar by Probe Head, could work out the diameter and position of Steel Bars. The measuring method of Rating data, Look-up and Linear-fitting could solve the problem of Non-linear for Sensors.

articleTitle: The inspiration of the construction of the international agricultural information on the agricultural market information service in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The information service system of agricultural products market belongs to the system engineering. In the new century, informatization is necessary for developing modern agriculture and promoting the competitiveness of agricultural products. As a municipality under the Central Government, Chongqing has preliminarily established an information collection and release system for agricultural products. However, the construction of information service system for agricultural products market is confronted with a bottleneck because of the municipality's distinct geography and didactic structure. Therefore, it is a must for us to start from the reality and explore an information service system construction model for agricultural products market which fits the characteristics of economic development in different areas of Chongqing. Starting from the practice of Chongqing and the analysis of agricultural information construction in developed and developing countries, this article proposes several modes, such as the mutual-assistine information subsidy mode, the joint of agriculture and commerce, four-level agricultural information websites aided with village messager, to satisfy various demands of different districts.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control with phase plane-reference-models and its application in the deep sea stepping hydraulic control system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To run the deep sea stepping wheel steadily, the phase reference model adaptive control algorithm was presented. This algorithm obtained the reference phase models according to the step response data of this control system, and with the guidance of these models, the fuzzy controller calculated the corresponding control signal according to the error between the factual output and the reference models. Simulation showed that the control effect of this algorithm is comparatively ideal.

articleTitle: Research of current situation and countermeasures of campus network ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to look into the current situation of campus network ecosystem and establish a sound system, we carry out a survey about Wuhan Institute of Technology and find that there are some problems in university management and students themselves. This paper aims to put forward some suggestions for optimizing campus network ecosystem from the view of ecology. They are divided into five parts: network facilities, network information, network subject, network culture and network systems.

articleTitle: Fault diagnoses expert system for gathering and transptation process of coalbed methane based on CLIPS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper describes the necessity of the establishment of the fault diagnoses expert system for gathering and transportation process of coalbed methane. Fault symptom lists for gathering and transportation technology and automatic control process of coalbed methane are established. The knowledge base of fault diagnoses expert system for gathering and transportation process of coalbed methane makes use of production rules. The paper introduces the basic procedure of developing fault diagnoses export system using CLIPS in modularity organization mode, and the expert system embeds CLIPS in VC++ using DLL so that it can be called easily in the application.

articleTitle: A novel OTA with digitally controlled and linearly tunable transconductance
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An operational transconductance amplifier (OTA), where its transconductance gain can be digitally controlled and linearly tuned, is proposed in this paper. The realization method is achieved by biasing the two fully balanced differential pairs with class AB current mirror and the current division network (CDN). g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> of the proposed OTA can be linearly tuned by an external control current I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">adj</sub> and the digitally controlled current gain α in the range of 0 to 500uS. The input-voltage range of about 200mV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-p</sub> with less than 1.0% nonlinearity is obtained. The performance of the proposed OTA is discussed and confirmed through an application example and PSPICE simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on the testing system of the clay buffer based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The testing system of the clay buffer is based on virtual instrument LabVIEW and it can accomplish the quality test by collecting and processing the impacting signal. The work principle, the corresponding hardware and software of the test system are introduced, at the same time the buffering force and distance curve are given. In practice, this system is reliable and can effectively ensure the quality of the clay buffer.

articleTitle: The technology solution of interfaces for flight crews pre-preparation system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There are lots of production systems related to the air preparation, and the development and database design of these systems are different, including data of Flight Operation Control, Maintenance Engineering System, Flight Operations Quality Assurance systems. This paper discusses the solution to different system interfaces. The air preparation system includes two parts: Pre-preparation system and direct-preparation system. It increases an effective protection for company's flight safety.

articleTitle: On the application of multimedia and network in developing learners' written English competence
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper firstly overviews the advantages of the application of multimedia and network in English writing teaching. Based on the discussion on the implication of written English competence, the author suggests 4 effective ways to put multimedia and network into efficient use in developing learners' written English competence.

articleTitle: Construction of cylinder head vibration bolts test bench and stress analysis of the bolts
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper firstly established bolt test bench that simulates the stress condition of the cylinder head bolts when engine working. Studying the quantitative relationship between the vibration volume of test bench and tighten torque of bolts based on the vibration test, so that it obtained the load distribution law in different bolts, which provides some helpful experience in engine test. Then it solved the problem that the bolts were subjected to strength and changing load when it works by means of the structure design. Then a detailed stress analysis on the bolts that distributed in the engine cylinder head and test bench bolt were provided, which determined and checked the stress range of the cylinder head bolts and test bench.

articleTitle: Study on nondestructive measurement with electronic speckle pattern interferometry method
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, With the high-speed development of electronic computer technology, optic-electronical technique and image processing technology, Electronic Speckle Pattern Interferometry (ESPI for short) has become one of the most practical worthy techniques for speckle measuring methods. There are lots of advantages about it, such as uncomplicated operation, noncontacting, advanced automatic level, measurement on-line and extensive using. In this thesis, the physical quantity which directly reflects the situation of thermal deformation for the aluminum material can be obtained by using this method. Thus we can come to a conclusion that electronic speckle pattern interferometry is a new measuring method for extracting small-signal. It provides a powerfully theoretical and experimental platform for the study of automated, full-field and nondestructive measurement (NDE for short).

articleTitle: Research and comparison on the ID/locator separation network architecture
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Current Internet architecture is facing challenges from the IP layer such as host mobility, multi-homing and routing scalability. ID/locator separation is a new Internet architecture that eliminates the duality of the IP address semantics and thus solves the problems of the traditional IP network. In this paper we analyze the concept of ID/locator separation, as well as its benefits and challenges. We also discuss the design of the key components in the ID/locator separation architecture and study several Internet architecture designs that implement the ID/locator separation philosophy.

articleTitle: The evaluating of the questionnaire of clothing brands and construction of dimensions based on consumers' perception
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Clothing brand recognition is the integration perception of clothing brand functional attributes and affective properties formed by the consumers according to their own psychological characteristics, namely the overall feeling of the clothing brand. In order to construct the questionnaire of clothing brands, this paper formed the prediction questionnaire by using the method of interview and literature review. Through the analysis on an exploratory factor, the dimensions structure evaluation by consumers is made up of the quality of recognition, the value of recognition, the cognition degree, association, differentiation and loyalty of the brand. According to the analysis of reliability and verification, the consequence proved that the questionnaire of clothing brands on the basis of consumers' recognition has good reliability and validity.

articleTitle: Neuron identification by classification tree and particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive method, which is on the basis of hierarchical classification tree and particle swarm optimzation(PSO), is proposed to classify different neurons in the international benchmark samples. Firstly, the similarity, corresponding to the maximum and the minimum of each feature, is calculated to denote the characteristic of the neuron, and then this paper designs the rules of classification tree and utilizes PSO algorithm to optimizate crucial parameters in the classification tree. To show high performance and the effectiveness of this proposed algorithm, the successful percentage of discerning the neuron can achieve to 98.04%.

articleTitle: Design of emergency remote security monitoring and control system based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aim at the environment for the lack of power, the paper adopts S3C6410 to design emergency remote security monitoring and control system based on ARM processor, and introduces detailed hardware structure and software design. The system encodes the video of client by H.264.

articleTitle: Legal explore & analyse on computer and cyber crime
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The computer is an important symbol of mankind enters the information age and this phenomenon of the computer and cyber crime was studied deeply by scholars. The laws of many countries on how effective the punishment and prevention of computer crime requires a robust, the number and scope of the regulations, and even the proceedings, which is lagged far behind the reality of demand for computer crime in judicial practice. Computer and network crime in Chinese Criminal Law lack of judgment on the Elements and actual operability, so having some new problems to be solved.

articleTitle: Study on factors of effecting adsorption of Cr6+ in wastewater by bentonite
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The removal of chromium cations from artificial wastewater and actual effluent by Ca-bentonite and Na-exchanged bentonite was studied. The experimental results showed that the equilibrium time of adsorbing chromium cations were 1h. The quantity of adsorption decreases with the increase of initial concentration of chromium cations, pH and adsorption temperature. Na-exchanged bentonite sorbed higher amounts of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> than the natural bentonite, the removal rate of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> reached to 95%.

articleTitle: Application of CASS process in antibiotics wastewater treatment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the character of antibiotics wastewater in some corporation, this article introduces sewage treatment processes, technique principles and characteristics about CASS process, and discusses the effect and problem in debugging run. The results show that the process operates flexible, has good stability, and has high removal effect to COD, BOD and SS, which appear the process is unique and has broad application prospect.

articleTitle: A research on spatial structure of urban system in central plains economic region based on fractal theory
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Fractal study is one of the most important content in modern theoretic geography, and fractal dimension is an effective parameter which describes the structure of the urban system. For quantitative analysis of the fractal characteristics of urban system of Central Plains Economic Zone and by calculating the Hausdorff number, fractal characteristics of size distribution of urban system of Central Plains Economic Region is analyzed. By calculating the correlation dimension and the cluster dimension and from two aspects of spatial correlation of the city elements and the centripetalism of urban stochastic agglomeration, fractal characteristics of spatial structure of urban system in the Central Plains Economic Region is analyzed.

articleTitle: The blind source separation based on the compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For the problem of blind source separation (BSS) with the sparsity properties of the high frequency wavelet transform coefficients, the paper proposed a new method based on compressed sensing (CS) and K-means clustering algorithm. Compared with the traditional methods of blind source separation, simulation results demonstrated that the proposed method improves the quality of the recovered signal significantly, and improves the speed of separating and reconstruction obviously.

articleTitle: Centralization, standardization and refination on the electronic channel of the company
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The social informatization popularization, electronic self-service become development trend. Electronic channel development has become one of the core competitiveness of telecom operators. Three operators are already developing electronic channels. This article will focus on fine realization of electronic channel, and has strong practice and operability for electronic channel business development.

articleTitle: Application analyses of virtual technology in equipment teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that traditional experiment method and means are very difficult to satisfy the requirement of experiment teaching for complex and cunning breechblock due to the hardware rest riction, experiment time and student number, virtual technology is applied in teaching to supply good learning environment of openness, euroky and interactivity for student so that equipment teaching is more live and visual to increase teaching effect. Virtual technology reformes organization form of teaching content, changes instruction means, perfects teaching form and adapts needs of teaching informatization construction.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of universities' Academic affairs management system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to adapt to the new situations which occurred in universities educational management work, to better service for universities educational management work, and to consider the practical application, we have carried on the system design and development strictly abided the software engineering theory and the software life cycle. And our design and development experienced six software life phase, including requirement investigation, requirement analysis, design, coding, testing, and maintenance. The development of this system used the mature C/S model, adopted a more popular and mature Power Builder 6.5 as the foreground software. The background database application used Microsoft SQL Server 2003 which is simple and easy to use. Combined with the advantages of original educational management system, we designed and developed the system with forward-looking principle.

articleTitle: Digital discriminator circuit design based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For software radio applications and multi-band received signal processing characteristics, based on the analysis for analog discriminator circuit, Implementation method that analog circuit is substituted by the digital processor is discussed. The mathematical model of the system to convert analog to digital transmission function is researched. Through the functional simulation under the software program development environment of CCS, its effectiveness is verified. And the implementation method which changes analog to digital system is able to be used wildly.

articleTitle: Design and realization of remote-control terminal based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To guarantee unmanned machinery rooms work normally and safely and promote maintenance lever, the paper presents the remote-control terminal based on General Packet Radio Service(GPRS). The remote-control terminal can monitor temperature, humidity, fire, water leaching and burglar etc, and alarm the maintainer the accident/abnormal behavior. Especially, the remote-control terminal can control the air conditioner automatically without hardware changing of the air conditioner. The terminal can work with monitoring center to setup up a powerful monitor system. With the using of the terminal, the machinery rooms can be monitored and controlled in anywhere at anytime on any device. It makes the machinery rooms maintenance become easy and efficient.

articleTitle: Experimental optimization of parameter design for generation of hydrogen/oxygen mixtures by water electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this work, we report the study of the efficient hydrogen\oxygen generation on different stainless steel electrodes in the electrolytes (NaOH and HNO3). The eight control factors based on L18 arrays were conducted and the flow rate properties of the hydrogen\oxygen generation were evaluated in the experiments. Based on analysis of Taguchi method, the signal\noise ratio is utilized and the optimal settings have been identified. In addition, the flow rate behavior of hydrogen\oxygen generation by water electrolysis was studied by Ritter volumetric meters. The experimental results obtained show that Taguchi design is used not only for predicted optimal process parameters for achieving the desired quality but for process optimization.

articleTitle: Development of high quality educational game by information technology support
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The development of information technology provided the possibility for the innovation to education means. Educational game, as a new type of education means, is popular by learners with its "fun" form. The problem is that nowadays many people are partial to the understanding of education game and insufficient to education game resources and development function, and the poor design and implementation of the game education, and also the evaluation of education game is not enough. Under the condition of information technology, it is a priority to research the development of the high quality education game, and promote the improvement of the education quality.

articleTitle: Research on earth potential interference and anti-interference measures
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The cause and damage of earth potential interference are analyzed and studied in this paper, especially influence by nonuniform distribution of earth potential in power plant and transformer station, such as interference by impulse voltage caused by lightning current and big power frequency current, arc interference caused by earth short circuit in transformer station. On the basis of research on cause, approach and modus of interference, technology measures are proposed.

articleTitle: A new feature weighted self-adaptive FCM clustering algorithm for gene expression data
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When dealing with gene expression data, FCM algorithm has the following defects: sensitiveness to the initial cluster centers, need to input the cluster number preliminary and doesn't consider the different contributions of attributes of gene expression data and so on. Accordingly, this paper presents a new feature weighted self-adaptive FCM algorithm handling gene expression data. First introduce a dataset pre-processing algorithms, then determine weights of all features of gene expression data set based on message-entropy, finally introduce the features' weights into the objective function of FCM algorithm. Experimental results show that the new algorithm significantly improves the effectiveness of taxonomic notes for gene expression data.

articleTitle: Precision measure of microwave two-port networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the microwave network S parameters testing, often use power distributors, directional couplers and switch microwave components, these microwave components performance is often not the ideal. Therefore, the microwave components in a test system measurement S parameters there must be the measurement error. This paper setup the measure error model of microwave two-port networks, Study the method of S parameters measure error correct. And make use of computer technology to design the Microwave two-port networks's S parameters automatic test system, and related measurement program design, realization of precision measurements of the S parameters. Measure results have verified the method And the system is sound. Amplitude relative error of measure S parameters is 0.56% and phase relative error is 0.47%.

articleTitle: Preliminary studies on innovation of architectural design of Guangdong Science Center
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As the landmark building of Guangzhou, Guangdong Science Center with its unique architectural glamour attracts the world's attention. Combing with the project background of Guangdong Science Center, this paper described the characteristic of architectural design of Guangdong Science Center form the aspects of design concept, graphic design, profile design and architectural forms. Obviously, the excellent architectural design has played a crucial role in the corresponding functions of Guangdong Science Center.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a distributed system for transparent remote memory accessing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to improve the system memory utilization ratio and the I/O performance, we should implement distributed system of initiative to access remote memory by ways of extending swap's capacity and improving paging speed because of the transmission characteristics of high bandwidth and low latency in high-speed LAN. In this paper, we put forward the client-the server conversion strategy which makes each node's load balance through role judgment and service's switching in this system. The realization of the system for applications does not require any particular API and function library. Experiments show that, for a large disk access and the application of the page exchange, the system can effectively improve overall performance.

articleTitle: Research on naturalization trend of electronic schoolbag interface interaction based on ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The natural degree of electronic schoolbag interface interaction is decided to the key of electronic schoolbag's usability, applicability and usability. This paper discusses the development of electronic schoolbag and its evolution of interface interaction, according to the natural ergonomics theory of electronic schoolbag interface interaction, this paper expounds the natural the feature of the electronic schoolbag interface interaction and the naturalization's future development trendcy of electronic schoolbag interface interaction based on ergonomics.

articleTitle: An iterative approach for the solution of afractional differential equations
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An iterative method is introduced in this paper to reduce the complicity of numerical computation of the Riemann-Liouville fractional differential equations. By introducing exponential approximation and setting up a recursive formula, the computation complicity at each time step is reduced to a constant from O(h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>).

articleTitle: An idea to hybrid amplitude, frequency and phase modulation of digital signal
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to wave function x(t) = A cos(wt + φ), varying A, w, φ in the same symbol slot can make modulation more efficient and maybe more economic. QAFPM described in this paper is a new technique, which shows this idea. At that time, realization of QAFPM and comments on its advantage and disadvantage are also discussed in the last.

articleTitle: Design of guiding cable with ultra-fine cross-section, bending insensitive and high-strength characteristics
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: We proposed in this article a novel kind of guiding cable with ultra-fine cross-section. The cable is characterized by its bending-insensitive and high-strength properties. Bending-insensitive fibers are included in the cable. The fibers are coated with high-strength yarn layers, which were surrounded by the outer coating layer. The outer diameter of the cable is in the range of 0.25-0.45mm, and the tensile strength is 8kg-15kg. The minimum allowable bend radius is as low as 5 mm. And the cable could be used at the circumstance temperature of -60 °C~85 °C. The optical cable proposed in this paper can break the space and the environment limitations of conventional optical cable. The proposed optical cable has the qualities of ultra-fine outer cladding, high tensile strength, excellent bending-insensitive properties, and long length.

articleTitle: Experimental study on behavior of bricklaying strengthening ribs composite wall under low cyclic reversed loading
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Using one bricklaying strengthening ribs composite wall filled with straw-clay blocks as specimens, the behaviors about co-action on press and shear of the wall under vertical and horizontal load was tested under low cyclic reversed loading. Experimental studies were carried out to investigate failure process and patterns, bearing capacity, ductility, deformation, performance and stiffness. The results indicate that failure pattern of the wall is mainly shearing-type and the wall has a better seismic performance. The test results provide a basis for further theoretical analysis and design methods.

articleTitle: Design of the automatic acquisition system based on GPS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the communication system especially the free-space optical communication, the pointing direction adjustment system is strongly required because of the strongly transmission directionality of communication signals. Based on the GPS technology, the automatic acquisition system, with the control core of TMS320F2812, is established, and the horizontal and elevate reference angle are separately detected by magnetic field sensors KMZ51 and 3-axis acceleration sensor ADXL345. The acquisition principle for GPS and software flow chart is discussed in this paper. Finally, the experiment proved that this acquisition system could finish preconcerted function, and if it is equipped with wireless transmission, the system can be directly applied in the initial acquisition for free-space optical communication.

articleTitle: Wireless self-organizing emergency communication network based on network clustering and information ferry
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to improve service performance of large-scale emergency communication network and enhance network scalability and reliability, wireless self-organizing emergency communication network integrating clustering algorithm and information ferry is proposed. Research backgrounds and relevant works are introduced firstly. Then, design ideas, objectives and methods of proposed wireless self-organizing emergency communication network service enhancement schemes are expounded in detail, mainly including network clustering methods and information ferry mechanisms. Finally, technical merits of proposed scheme are concluded.

articleTitle: Optimized evaluation of varible weight on performance of computer engineering project investment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A kind of performance evaluation and rating method of project investment for computer engineering using property division based on connection degree according to set theory. The identity, difference and opposition of the value of the rating were analyzed. The connection degree division and variable weight mechanism of important value were integrated to build the variable weight optimized model based on the maximum connection degree as the criterion to determine grade-level evaluation. This method was applied into some computer engineering projects and proved efficiently.

articleTitle: A brief analysis on the seminar of professional construction for modern preschool educational technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In November 2010, the state council issued the law, called < some opinions on the current development of pre-school education >, the law emphasizes the special importance of preschool education. Educational Technology is a subject with the development of Information Technology. Most of time, our attention is paid to the combination between modern educational technology and primary school, middle school, college and so on. However, effective use of information technology has an enormous potential in improving the quality of preschool education. The article analyzes the background, matriculate and course offered on the professional construction of modern preschool educational technology.

articleTitle: A design of MathML web based formula search system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As one of the most important element in knowledge system, math formulas is playing an important role in web based remote teaching, information publication and academic exchange. However, in current situation, the difficulty of searching formulas is always upsetting. A formula search system is designed in this paper. It is able to implement online math formula input and precise search. The system uses JSP as UI development language, Oracle as background data base and MathML as the description language to math formulas. The design of the online formula edition module enables users to edit math formulas at will. The formulas in this system are stored as MathMLcodes, for which the query to math formulas can be realized by matching mathml codes.

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of the school-enterprise cooperation of the software service outsourcing talent training — An example of Xi'an University of Arts and Science
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of the software service outsourcing industry, enterprises are in the urgent need of the practical engineering talents. Taking the educational practice in Xi'an University of Arts and Science as an example, this paper presents four school-enterprise cooperating modes of software service outsourcing talent training, which not only significantly improves the employment rate of the graduates, but also encourages the enterprises to co-cultivate students with the colleges and universities.

articleTitle: A novel tracking algorithm for BOC(n, n) signals
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is well known that Binary Offset Carrier (BOC) modulated signal has been chosen for the next generation satellite navigation system. The work presented in this paper introduces an improved novel architecture for the tracking loop which is tailored for the alignment of a BOC(1,1) modulated signal. Compared with the architecture described in the work of Fine and Wilson (1999), the proposed one here is able to double tracking accuracy and keeping the overall complexity of the required taps. An unambiguous time-based algorithm for discriminator is introduced in this paper which makes this architecture more realistic.

articleTitle: Analysis of laws of drill string stick-slip vibration and soft-sorque control
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The drill string stick-slip vibration is a intensive destructiveness torsional vibration caused by twisting vibration and down hole drag. This phenomenon can be explained that the bit is motionless for some time, and when the torque on drill string is large enough, the bit suddenly rotate at a high-speed. In this thesis, drill string torsion model is established, drill string stick-slip vibration mechanical model is proposed and the equation of stick-slip vibration motion is analyzed. After this, the general laws of drill string stick-slip vibration are acquired and the control scheme of drill string soft-torque control system is proposed. Result of experiment shows that the soft-torque control method can make the actual speed of motor changed according to the torque, so as to decrease the motor torque fluctuations, eliminate stick-slip vibration and achieve the drill string soft-torque control.

articleTitle: Utilizing PBL for authorware learning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Authorware is the leading rich-media authoring tool for creating web and online learning. And it is too hard to learners who are beginning to learn developing multimedia materials with it. In order to facilitate learning and improve performance, we think that teachers should give effective preparation for instruction from designing B-Learning processes and constructing e-Learning environment. In this paper, we will discuss the advantages of Project-based Learning (PBL), put out our utilization of PBL for instruction, and it includes five stages: teachers state requirements for project, students design projects independently, students demonstrate plan of projects, students finish development of projects, teachers and students evaluate the work of projects together. At last, we will point out emphatically the two problems: supervise students' behavior, require students' participation in evaluation, these can ensure the success of PBL.

articleTitle: Study of fault diagnosis about airborne equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the study of the fault diagnosis about the airborne equipment in XX-ATE, this paper discusses the characteristic of each fault diagnosis method. It also brings forward the possible problem and gives the ideas of settlement.

articleTitle: Coding based opportunistic routing in ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this work, we focus on the unicast routing issue in ad hoc networks. Our aim is to design a protocol so that the average number of transmissions for the communication between two end nodes is minimized. Opportunistic routing can reduce the number of transmissions taking advantage of the broadcast nature in wireless networks. In ad hoc networks, different unicast flows may intersect at a relay node and bring coding opportunities. In this paper, we proposed an efficient heuristic coding strategy and applied it in opportunistic routing to reduce the number of transmissions. Extensive simulations are conducted to show that our protocol outperforms ExOR protocol.

articleTitle: Utility-based connection admission control in an IEEE 802.16e wireless metropolitan area network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper proposes a utility-based connection admission control (CAC) scheme for IEEE 802.16e broadband wireless access (BWA) networks. We develop specific utility functions for real-time and non-real-time services coupled with a handover process. By means of these functions we present a novel utility-based CAC algorithm which determines a connection that conducts to the greatest utility in each time of admission decisions, so as to maximize the total system utility. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed CAC scheme.

articleTitle: Interaction representation in agent-based modeling for intelligence reconnaissance system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is an important basic research task in computer engineering to describe complex behaviors of warfare system by intelligent warfare actions analysis and modeling. To perform modeling and simulation for dynamic, complex and intelligent process of intelligence reconnaissance on information battlefield, multi-agent system technology is used in this paper. Based on agent analysis, definition and description of interaction is presented. A modified Contract Net Protocol (CNP) model is put forward and Agent UML (AUML) is applied to represent the inter-agent problem, i.e., interaction of multiple intelligence reconnaissance agents. The results are validated by the established demonstration system.

articleTitle: Research on application of Web data mining based on musical instrument network integrated marketing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the Web data mining technology, analyzes the role of Web data mining in musical instrument network integrated marketing and the issue on how to use the Web data mining technology in musical instrument network integrated marketing.

articleTitle: Analysis of an epidemic system with impulsive input and time delays
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, an SEIRS epidemic disease model with double delays of latent period and immune period is formulated, and the global dynamics behaviors of the model under pulse input and vaccination are analyzed. By use of the stroboscopic map, an `infection-free' periodic solution is obtained, and the global attractivity of the `infection-free' periodic solution is given.

articleTitle: Studying on cracking of reinforced-concrete beam and column joints
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The work is concerned with an analytical investigation of the behavior of reinforced-concrete beam - column joint subassemblages under monotonic and cyclic loading in an attempt to assess the effect of cracking suffered by the joint on the overall structural response. The behavior of the structural forms investigated was established by nonlinear three-dimensional finite-element analysis, after the latter had first been validated through a comparison of analytical predictions with published experimental findings. In all case studies presented, the joints were found to suffer considerable cracking that initiated at early load stages and led to an increase of the overall displacement values by a factor larger than 2. Such behavior indicates that the assumption of `rigid joint', which is implicit in methods used for the practical analysis of frames, is not applicable when such methods are employed for the analysis of concrete structures, even within the elastic range of structural behavior.

articleTitle: Application of Sigma-point Kalman filters on carrier frequency offset estimation of OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For the non-linear dynamic state-space model, extended Kalman filter (EKF) fits the system state and observation equations to obtain valuation of state but it has deficiencies like apparent fluctuation and slow convergence. While the Sigma-point Kalman filters obtain the statistical characteristics based on deterministic samples, accordingly better approximation can be achieved. In this paper, the OFDM carrier frequency offset is described as non-linear dynamic state-space model, and the Sigma-point Kalman filters are applied to estimate the offset value. Simulation results show that they perform better at capturing the high order moments than EKF and they gained higher accuracy, faster convergence, smaller fluctuations and less noise sensitivity.

articleTitle: Based on the VRML model of virtual library the research and implement
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Introduces a VRML technique combining with 3dsmax, Solid Edge and such software engineering drawing of virtual model and method, the realization of the system of independent roaming, collision detection and viewpoints etc. Function. With strong real-time, interaction and immersed sense, roaming among the room would entity model of realism.

articleTitle: Local elements — The charm of small town tourism planning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the increasing level of urbanization, tourism planning in the small town is carried out in full swing throughout the country, which promoted the small town's rapid economic development. But there is a phenomenon of vague positioning and weak features in the small town tourism planning. In the light of the above phenomenon, this paper proposed a coping strategy - digging local elements of small towns, which emphasize on local natural scenery, climate characteristics, building and street, customs and culture, catering and handicrafts five aspects. And, based on the model of tourism planning of famous tourism town - Yabuli, this paper used the above mentioned strategy to analyze Yabuli's local elements. Guided by the aim "can enjoy, can goods, can entertain, can participate in", we integrated local elements with all aspects of Yabuli Town Tourism Planning and the study of practical application of which in small town's tourism planning. This article aims to emphasize that we should dig, present and integrate local history and culture in the small town's tourism planning, and focus on building a strong local humanity culture tour, starting to regain the unique charm of the small town tourism.

articleTitle: A bufferless Network-on-Chip based on DPmesh
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Network-on-Chip (NoC) has emerged as a potential approach to connect a number of IP cores on a single die. Compared with off-chip network, area occupancy and power consumption are two main constraints in NoCs. In addition, a high proportion is consumed by the buffers in the input ports of routers. Therefore, bufferless NoC, which eliminates in-router buffers and copes with contention by dropping or deflecting packets, is proposed to effectively resolve this issue. However, most current work focuses on exploring bufferless NoCs on traditional 2D mesh topology, which provides relatively less optional output ports for packets and thus gives rise to larger influence on performance. This paper proposes a diagonally and parallel linked mesh (DPmesh) designed for bufferless deflection NoC. The new topology increases the number of parallel links in the same direction and adds diagonal links on the basis of mesh, for the sake of increasing the number of routing options and decreasing the average latency. Our evaluations show that our proposal significantly improves the performance of bufferless deflection NoC and we conclude that DPmesh is a better option for the design of bufferless deflection NoC than 2D mesh.

articleTitle: The analysis of the current educational quality of teachers in sports institutions under the background of informatization
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The outcome of this research has brought deep thinking of some teachers about their teaching. The cores of the thinking lie in the educational concept, the differences in our educational goals and methods between the information era and the traditional, the definition of educational quality of physical education teachers, the related theories and practical problems. What we train is the person that can walk independently. Therefore, we should train our physical education teachers with culture, individual moral cultivation, professional knowledge, and the modern information literacy.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient partial spectrum sensing with adaptive cooperation in cognitive radio
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Energy-Efficience has attracted significant research attention in recent years. Partial spectrum sensing algorithm with decision result prediction (DRP) and decision result modification (DRM) technique successfully conserves computation energy. Firstly, this paper proposed an new DRP based on the MAJ(Majority) rule instead of AND rule. The simulation results highlights the improvement in energy-efficience and detection performance. Furthermore, an adaptive cooperative partial spectrum sensing scheme is proposed. Each cognitive user chooses an appropriate FFT size based on received SNR. Simulation results shows that, the adaptive scheme is optimal tradeoff between energy saving and detection performance whatever for cognitive network or single cognitive user.

articleTitle: How to enhance effectiveness of Internet recruitment of enterprises
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the recent few years, with swift development of informatization technology, as a newly born talent recruitment mode, internet recruitment has gradually received wide recognition and favor in China and has become one of the major channels for enterprise recruitment and personal job hunting. For enhance effectiveness of internet recruitment, we should enhance vocational quality of network recruitment personnel, improve relevant laws and regulations, set up effective management system, and bring in moral education.

articleTitle: Improvement of particle swarm optimization and its application in the earth-rock dam instability risk calculation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the light of the problem of premature convergence and local convergence in particle swarm optimization (PSO), a clustering coefficient (λ) and a boundary restriction equation are introduced in the model of PSO at first. And a PSO with cyclical migratory behavior (CMPSO) is proposed based on the optimization of particles' work model. And then, the two parameters' characteristics of CMPSO, N which represents migration cycle and K which represents total number of iterations, are tested on benchmark functions. Finally, CMPSO is used to calculate the slope instability risk of Chengbi River Reservoir Earth-Rock Dam. The result shows that CMPSO has a significant increase at speed and precision in calculation compared with PSO, and needs fewer particles. Compared to the result of Monte-carlo simulation, CMPSO also has higher accuracy than PSO in the calculation of slope instability risk.

articleTitle: Study on programmable controller experimental teaching based on PBL
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the intellectual economy age, it is the need for the new era's development that improving students' innovation ability by cultivating their interesting, enhancing their proactivity and promoting their self-learning abilities. In order to achieve the above goal, taking the drawbacks in present experimental teaching into consideration, this paper introduced Problem Based Learning (PBL) method into programmable controller experiment. By doing this to improve students' quality and to cultivate innovative talents.

articleTitle: Channel model of cooperative ARQ protocols over wireless networks and its delay statistics
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper builds the Finite State Markov Channel (FSMC) model of the equivalent channel related to the cooperative diversity system where the relay performs decode-and-forward (DF) to help the source and each link apply adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) at the physical layer. We apply the matrix geometry theory to conduct queueing analysis for two typical automatic retransmission request protocol over such networks; Theoretical results and simulation ones of the delay distribution are given, it is shown that cooperative diversity plays an important role in reducing delay.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact of prices and cost on the yield of rice, wheat and maize
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In short term, the preceding period of yield has negative effects on the current period of yield; the preceding period of price has positive effects on the current period of yield. In long term, the cost is the main influencing factor on yield, and positive effect; the price has little effect on the yield.

articleTitle: Energy consumption and energy efficiency retrofit potential for government office buildings in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the energy consumption characteristics of government office buildings in Beijing. Four office buildings were chosen to analyze the energy consumption features and annual energy consumption trends. Energy efficiency potential of government office buildings were analyzed from the six perspectives. The results show that the air conditioning energy consumption was 25.9 kwh/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·a, accounted for 53.9% of the total energy consumption. Building envelop, heating and air conditioning system were the key factors in the energy efficiency retrofit.

articleTitle: Introspection on experimental psychology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper has integrated the critiques of present theorists on experimental methods, discussed its status and gave some suggestions on the development of Experimental psychology.

articleTitle: Interactive Electronic Technical Manual design of CNC machine tool
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aintainability is the very important property of CNC machine tool in its life cycle. The maintenance of CNC machine tool is quickly and exactly can take important action in extending its using life and ensuring its reliability. Moreover IETM is the important support resource of guiding maintenance, facilitating training and enhancing maintainability. This paper is based on Europe standard S1000D, presenting the IETM design frame of CNC machine tool and design theory of standardization, interoperability and modularization.

articleTitle: Study of P2P flow detection technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To identify and control P2Pflow more infectively, the industry went through Multi-level explores and put forward many infective P2P flow detection methods. They are the method based on the port, the method based on deep data, the method based on machine learning and the method based on network behavior. In the paper, we sumerize and analyze those methods, and compared both the advantages and disadvantages between them At last, it analyzed the further step of P2P Flow Detection Technology.

articleTitle: The design for tracking control system based on multiple rotary transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is known that multiple rotating transformer, as the high precision of state information such as location, velocity, and acceleration, is widely used in the numerical servo control system. The principle of the multiple rotating transformers and its detecting method is firstly detailed, and then the tracking control system with the control core of TMS320F2812 and speed detecting element of multiple rotary transformer is designed. Additional, the interface between multiple rotary transformer and its digital converter as well as software flow chart is described. Finally the man-machine interface is designed. Experiment result shows that all off the hardware and software work well and truly finish appointed function.

articleTitle: The distributed replica location method based on direct index linked lists
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Quickly finding the physical locations of one or more replicas of desired data based on logical replica name is the foundation to implementing grid data access efficiently. A replica location method based on direct index linked lists is proposed based on the analysis of recent condition in replica location. The distributed replica location can be quickly implemented by using the direct index location node, the main replica linked lists and local location information in the method. It can achieve good scalability and ease of implementation.

articleTitle: Dually secure, reversible and progressive image transmission
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the paper, a novel image transmission method is presented. Our approach is achieved by padding each shadow generated by JPEG2000 based secret image sharing method into sub-bands of the integer wavelet transform of the poly-phase sampled sub-images. As a result, our method provides the following features: (1) this method is secure, reversible and progressive reconstruction for both secret and cover image transmission; (2) the secret image is fault tolerant; (3) the cover images are capable of conquering data losses; (4) the stego image is user-friendly for easy management; (5) the computational complexity of the proposed method is highly efficient. Experimental results are given to demonstrate these promising features of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Minimax estimation of parameter of inverse exponential distribution
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Bayes estimators of the parameter of the inverse exponential distribution are obtained for the well known weighted square error loss, square log error loss and Modified linear Exponential (MLINEX) loss functions. Further minimax estimators are derived by using Lehmann's Theorem. Comparision of these estimators are also studied by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Mobility management based on MIP table in mixed IPv4/v6 networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: IETF has specified Mobile IPv4 and Mobile IPv6 in RFC3344 and RFC3775 respectively, but not yet discussed Mobile IPv4/v6 in any published RFC. This paper proposes a scheme to solve one of Mobile IPv4/v6 problems which Home Agent (HA) and (Correspondent Node) CN are located in IPv6 network, while Mobile Node (MN) moves within IPv4 network. In the solution, a gateway called Mobile IPv4/v6 translation gateway (MIPv4/v6-TG) is introduced to bridge between IPv4 network and IPv6 network, which is made up of a traditional NAT-PT gateway and a Mobile IP application level gateway (MIP-ALG) built upon the NAT-PT gateway. MIP-ALG maintains a MIP table, a data structure, which is formed by entries. We use the MIP table to realize the communication between the IPv4 entities and the IPv6 entities. The creation, usage and update processes of MIP table are described in this paper. Through the experiment we find it can realize the basic communication in IPv4/v6 mixed network. The measurement of performance test proves the solution's efficiency. And it can work compatibly with RFC3344 and RFC3775.

articleTitle: Study on electronic structure and optical properties of the filled skutterudite CeFe4P12
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Full-Potential Linearized Augmented Plane Wave plus local orbital method (FPLAPW +lo) calculations were performed for CeFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> in the filled skutterudite in order to investigate the optical properties and to show the origin of the different optical transitions. It is found that the CeFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> compound has a indirect band gap: 413.41meV. Then the contributions of the different transition peaks are analyzed from the imaginary part of the dielectric function. In contrast to recent experimental expectations, our calculations are in good agreement with experimental reflectivity spectra. Furthermore, the different optical properties have been investigated. We have studied the absorption coefficient, the electron energy loss function, the refractive index, and the extinction coefficient.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the intensity of the utilization of land used as the rural residential areas from the view point of low carbon — Bsed on the case stuy of County Lai Shui
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The development of Low Carbon Economy is guided by the idea of Sustainable Development. Thus, if we want to evaluate the intensity of the utilization of land used as the rural residential areas from the view point of low carbon, we must choose indexes which reflect the requirement of sustainable development. In this study, the author choose indexes according to the PSR mode, that is, choose indexes based on the following three aspects: pressure, state and response. Though the relative evaluation in County Lai Shui, the author draws three conclusions. (1)The general level of the intensity of the utilization of land used as the rural residential areas in the case area is low; (2)Because of the variation in terrain and economic development level, the difference among areas is notable; (3)The investment in the construction of rural residential areas in the case area is unsatisfactory.

Author Keywords: intensive utilization of land Low Carbon evaluation PSR mode

articleTitle: Common-path endoscopic optical coherence tomography application to human internal organs detection
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Due to the small volume of incipient Pathological Cells, the conventional imaging methods cannot effectively diagnose early-stage cytopathic effect. Since the spatial resolution of optical coherence tomography (OCT) can reach the magnitude of micron, and if OCT probe possesses the characteristic of small fabric and nice flexibility in order to easily enter human body, OCT probe can detect the cytopathic effect in a very early-stage. So, this article first introduces some existent common-path OCT system and then compares the advantages and the disadvantages of each CP-EOCT. Finally, this article mainly researches on a new common-path Endoscopic OCT (CP-EOCT) which possesses the advantages of small volume and high flexibility.

articleTitle: On autonomous learning and classroom teaching design at universities
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In view of the current situation that teachers give priority to teaching and students learn mechanically and passively in the current university classroom teaching, it is proposed that teachers should completely change the teaching idea, from the traditional “teaching” to “learning”, and take “how to better organize and guide the students to independent study” as the guiding ideology of teaching design, and take “paying attention to the multitudes of teaching target”, “revolving around the knowledge framework to teach”, “strengthening the guiding role of teachers”, and “maximizing the use of the modern education technology” as the principles of teaching design, to elaborately design the classroom teaching, in order to better support the students' autonomous learning.

articleTitle: A simple uneven rotation clustering algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Clustering algorithm can prolong the life time of wireless sensor networks, but cost of reconstruction is large. Energy load imbalance for multi-hop transmission is also a problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a simple uneven rotation clustering (SURC) algorithm to reduce cost of reconstruction and solve problem of hotspots. Besides, nodes in cluster work alternately, further saving energy. The experiment shows that the algorithm not only effective saves energy and solves imbalanced load, but significantly extends the survival time of network.

articleTitle: Research on a intelligent dual temperature box
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A intelligent dual temperature box is researched in this paper. The dual temperature box utilizes cascade refrigeration system. R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub> is the refrigerant of high temperature circle system, and R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sub> is the refrigerant of low temperature circle system. The R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub> system can operate alone or with the R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sub> system. So the dual temperature box can achieve two vapor temperatures of -65°C and -20°C. And the refrigerant system of it can operate stable while the temperature is -65°C.

articleTitle: Research on EDDL
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electronic Device Descriptions (EDD) are becoming more and more important for the engineering and commissioning process of Distributed Control System (DCS). Electronic Device Description Language (EDDL) is has been the key to interoperability for millions of devices used throughout most process plants. The paper firstly introduces the background and the development history of the EDD technology. And then describes the elements and the structure of EDD file in detail. Finally the development and application of EDD for PROFIBUS PA field device based on Siemens PDM software are described.

articleTitle: A method based on distributed algorithm of delay-bounded multicast routing
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)

articleTitle: Research on electrolyte stability of vanadium redox battery for electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Recently, the vanadium redox battery (VRB) will be applied to electric vehicle as a new kind of efficient battery. However, to reach this goal, some problems about the electrolyte stability of VRB have to be solved. In this paper, some experiments on the electrolyte stability of VRB have been done, and the experimental result is also analyzed. The main influences on the stability of positive electrolyte are the concentration of sulfuric acid, the concentration of V (V), the state of charge (SOC), the temperature and additives in electrolyte. To the negative electrolyte, the main problems are the oxidation of V (II) and the sediment of V (III). Experiments also prove that adding additives is the best of all solutions.

articleTitle: The simulator design of GPU accelerated radiated noise from surface taget
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The simulator design of surface target radiated noise is the key technology to test passive sonar systems, target oriented recognition and underwater soft against. The mathematical simulation model of the line and continuous spectrum in frequency domain from surface target has been established based on the description and analysis of radiated noise signal characteristic. Delay acoustic orientated method and one-third octave filter bandwidth algorithm for the simulation of moving target position and information are proposed. The design of broadband FIR filters has been completed. The overall structure of the target noise simulator is real-time implemented by using the widely used GPU (Graphic Processing Unit) accelerated parallel platform. It greatly reduces the consumption of the system hardware resources. It is proved that the simulator can better achieve the characteristics of surface target radiated noise after the mathematical analysis of simulator output. It has a good scientific application value.

articleTitle: Key management scheme based on certificateless cryptography for satellite networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The article proposes a key management scheme for satellite networks targeting the problem of existing key management scheme cannot be suitable for satellite networks. Threshold secret mechanism is used to achieve the protection for system master key, and avoid the single point of failure problem. The certificateless cryptography is introduced to achieve secure distribution for public and private key pair, and the signcryption mechanism is adopted to achieve secure distribution for system master key share. The proposed scheme eliminates the requirement for a secure channel within the key distribution process, and avoids the key escrow problem. The scheme meets the security requirements, and has a high efficiency.

articleTitle: The system of urban culture logos and its construction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Culture logo is the symbol and sign of urban culture. This paper analyzes the specific meaning of culture logo, the system elements of urban culture logos and the procedure for constructing this system. The system of culture logos can highlight the characteristics of urban culture, upgrade the city's culture level and promote the organic integration and common progress of urban culture, economy and society.

articleTitle: On study and achievement of 3D emulation system for river routing based on MapX
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: 3D emulation system for river routing, based on hydraulic model and study of visual technology, is developed by visual development environment of combining Visual Basic, MapX and SQL Server. Thus the routing process of simulating river under different boundary conditions is achieved and the water level and flow at any time and any section is offered while the change process of water level and flow of every section is reflected through time series.

articleTitle: Chu Han street, "Central cultural area in Wuhan": Thinking on the commercial development mode of urban renewal
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Dalian Wanda Group's biggest urban projects in Wuhan, Chu Han street, is a turning point in the history of WuHan urban design. And this paper talks about the space characteristics and existing problems of the project from the view of the relationship between the architectural space form and the cultural connotation. Then from the vital relationship, the paper discussed the attitude and the ways that we should hold to approach the urban renewal responsibly.

articleTitle: Sliding mode controller for air-breathing hypersonic vehicle with flexible body dynamics
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A brief introduction to the Truth Model, a flexible air-breathing hypersonic vehicle, developed by Bolender and Doman is given. The model is used only for simulation and control design verification. And the linear equations of motion of the longitudinal dynamics for hypersonic vehicle derived from the Truth Model are obtained based on Jacobian Linearization approach. In this study, a sliding mode controller design based on the approach law is applied to the model of the longitudinal dynamics for the hypersonic vehicle. Finally, the simulation results using sliding mode controller with the approach law are shown. Simulation results demonstrate that the designed controller has robust tracking performance.

articleTitle: Fire zone/field model performance based investigation in fire flashover phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Flashover is a crucial phenomenon in which all indoor combustibles ignite nearly simultaneously in building fires. Flashover prediction and understanding are vital in building fire protection engineering. Current fire simulation software is unable to accurately estimate the flashover-induced time. This study developed an improved mathematical zone model for analyzing flashover during a building fire with crucial parameters, including heat release rate, wall thermal inertia, and smoke layer height, which was combined with FDS (Fire Dynamic Simulator) field model software to analyze a park lodging bedroom fire experiment from the NIST (National Institute of Standard Technology). The effects of fire intensity and heat pyrolysis for burning objects on the fire characteristics were studied and used to predict the flashover-induced time.

articleTitle: Comparative limestone and seawater method in Desulfurization system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
