abstract: The Power plant flue gas of coal-fired units are in addition to the sulfur removal system (Flue Gas Desulfurization, referred to as FGD) wet limestone/gypsum, in need of using a lot of fresh water and limestone, which can be the formation of another waste problem. The sea water flue gas desulphurization system, the sulfur removal efficiency can reach 90% or more. Large coal-fired units almost have sea water flue gas desulphurization system, and Formosa Plastics Mailiao power plant in Taiwan has also pioneered the use of the international community. The aim of the study are to compare the advantages and disadvantages of limestone and seawater method. The advantages and disadvantages of the sulfur remove system operators are expected to explore the practical operation of the seawater FGD.

articleTitle: Study of the word segmentation algorithm based on Hash dictionary mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Machine learning of data analysis and processing in internet allows users to access information quickly and conveniently. As most of the information is text, so that automatic segmentation technology has great significance. The word segmentation dictionary is an important component of the Chinese automatic word segmentation system. The speed of the dictionary loading and query can affect the speed of segmentation system directly. This paper proposes an improved word segmentation mechanism based on double word Hash. The test result shows that the improved word segmentation algorithm enhances the query speed and efficiency of the term matches.

articleTitle: The application of multimedia and network in sino English intensive reading instruction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, multimedia and network are more and more widely applied into English intensive reading instruction. This paper is aimed to analyze the status quo of the application of multimedia and network in English intensive reading instruction in China, and give some suggestions to help solve the problems occurred in the application.

articleTitle: Compensation of I/Q imbalance in M-QAM tranceiver with multi-antennas
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: An approach to the compensation of I/Q imbalance is discussed in this paper. A method based on the least squares (LS) is proposed. Although digital orthogonal demodulation provides an efficient means for system and circuit designers to avoid the effect which is caused by local oscillation (LO), to sample broadband signal with high-rate analog-to-digital (ADC) suffers from high cost and increases difficulty of the implement of FPGA. This paper presents a rigorous analytical model for analyzing the effects of local oscillator output imperfection of in-phase/quadrature (1/Q) imbalance on M-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (M-QAM) transceiver performance. Then a method of compensation of the 1/Q imbalance is proposed according to the model.

articleTitle: Correction of multiple frequency offsets and detection in V-BLAST OFDM systems with distributed transmit antennas
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper addresses the correction of multiple carrier frequency offsets (CFO) and detection in vertical Bell Labs layered space-time (V-BLAST) orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems with distributed transmit antennas. We first propose a low-complexity CFO correction method suitable for low delay spread channels by exploiting the underlying characteristics of zero-forcing (ZF) detection, and then propose a ZF based detection method involving two CFO correction processes to further improve its performance in the high delay spread case. Simulation results show that the proposed CFO correction method can effectively correct multiple CFOs in low delay spread channels, while for the high delay spread case the proposed detection method with two CFO correction processes can further improve the detection performance.

articleTitle: Technical means for transaction security in electronic commerce
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper first gives an brief analysis on some serious security problems for E-commerce transactions, stresses secondly technical means for ensuring transaction security, including Data encryption, Digital signature, and Security protocols. in the end, This paper generalizes security problems and its countermeasure in E-commerce.

articleTitle: The technology study of permanent magnet brushless DC motor without position sensor
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper studies the control technique of without position sensor for permanent magnet brushless motor(BLDCM). According to the mathematical model of BLDCM, the paper derives the working principle of commutation principle for using the third harmonic back electromotive force(EMF). Compared with the other technologies of without position sensor, the method of third harmonic detection can be easily achieved in the application of high-power BLDCM, and the system operation is very stable. At last the simulation results show that the theoretical analysis is completely correct, and the result provides a new study idea to the technology of without position sensor for BLDCM.

articleTitle: Analysis on features of practice teaching of University of Hertfordshire
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Practice teaching is an important link in teaching process. An analysis on features of practice teaching in the Britain university will bring enlightments and creative thoughts to our teaching process. Through analysis on its features of practice teaching, the thesis further explores a practice teaching method which is more scientific, operable and conforming to the actual situation of Chinese universities. The teaching method will cultivate students'ability to analyze and solve concrete problems independently as well as fully reflect a process of self-study and self-education among students.

articleTitle: Network chart matrix method of portrayal solution node time parameter and essential way MATLAB realization and network planning optimization
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The network-based planning techniques already widely applied in each management domain, each node time parameter and the critical path determination is extremely important; This article applies the network chart the matrix method of portrayal solution node time parameter and the essential way, The article has also established the mathematical model which the network optimizes.

articleTitle: The architecture of city tunnel monitoring platform
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The city tunnel monitoring platform was studied based on the city tunnel monitoring system in order to share information and resources in this paper. The characteristics of the data which are collected from different city tunnel monitoring systems were analyzed. The XML (eXtensive Makeup Language) based multisource description method was proposed to uniformly express various data in the monitoring platform. Then, the common architecture of city tunnel monitoring platform was discussed. The city tunnel monitoring platform aimed at solving the problems that the monitoring data of the city tunnel is isolated and hardly to share, enhancing the monitoring level of city tunnel.

articleTitle: Computer-assisted methodology in Sino English extensive reading instruction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: English extensive reading is a course which aims at improving students' proficiency by a large amount of reading. However, there are many problems in the existing traditional extensive reading instruction. This paper explains a new methodology which may greatly improve the situation in Sino English extensive reading with its advantages. Implications of computer-assisted methodology applied in this course are also elaborated.

articleTitle: Algorithm for redundancy elimination in network traffic
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The network redundant traffic, not only consuming network bandwidth, but also reducing the efficiency of the Internet, exists abundantly in the course of exchanging Internet data. In the context, protocol-independent redundancy elimination, which can remove duplicate strings from within arbitrary network flows, has emerged as a powerful technique to improve the efficiency of network links in the face of repeated data and has been widely used. Redundancy elimination middle-boxes are being widely deployed to improve the effective bandwidth of network access links of enterprises and data centers alike, and for improving link loads in small ISP networks.

articleTitle: Side-lobe cancellation system based on uniform plane array
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Adaptive side lobe cancellation is an effective measure to rejecting interference without rejecting the target signal. This paper analyzes side-lobe cancellation principium based on uniform plane array, introduce the method to calculate optimal weights by matrix inversion algorithm. Finally simulation validates the cancellation performance which is valuable in appliance. It shows that the adaptive side lobe cancellation system is very effective to interference cancellation and the direction of interference estimation.

articleTitle: The low-cost implement method of blind two-step equalization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To reduce the computational cost of two-step equalization algorithm brought by extracting the orthogonal basis of equalizer coefficient vector space using Singularity Value Decomposition (SVD), a low-cost implement method of blind two-step equalization algorithm is proposed, which obtains the orthogonal basis of equalizer coefflcient vector space using Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to the first P columns of the inverse of the measurement auto-correlation matrix. It reduces the computational complexity from O(K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) to KP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, where P ≪ K. An adaptive implementation of the low-cost method is presented to update the equalizer coefficient vector real time, which has the computational complexity of O(K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Numerical simulations show that the low-cost method has an advantage of computational simplicity and shares the same performance with the origin one, and the adaptive implementation has higher convergence speed and less steady residual error than the existing adaptive algorithm at present.

articleTitle: A Chinese unsupervised word sense disambiguation method based on semantic vector
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The supervise machine learning word sense disambiguation method need to annotate the words of the training corpus, in order to overcome the data sparseness problem to achieve the good word sense disambiguation effect we must establish a large-scale marked Corpus, but obtaining the marked corpus requires high artificial price. Against this problem this paper proposes an unsupervised learning method without manual annotation. Firstly we mine the feature words based on PMI (Point-wise Mutual Information) and Z test, defining the v words to describe a certain sense of polysemy, and then calculating the similarity between sense words and the features of polysemy in the context to determine the correct sense of the polysemy. This paper disambiguates ten typical polysemy, and experimental results prove that the method is effective.

articleTitle: A secure client on smart phone to monitor automotive sensor network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a proposal on design of a secure client on smart phone to monitor automotive sensor network. Recently, more and more vehicles, such as BMW X5, are connected from outside via smart phone[3]. From smart phone, users can use the internet resources in automotive. Also, from smart phone users can monitor the automotives. When the automotive is moving or stolen by robber, an alert information will be reported to users and users can even brake their automotive via smart phone in emergency status by sending control command to the vehicle information gateway. So a client software in smart phone is required to monitor the sensor network in automotives. And to prevent the client software is maliciously used by robbers, a security mechanism should be given for this client on the constraints of computation power, security level and power consumption. We proposed to encrypt all the messages in IDEA, which is with high security level and prone to implement in software and less demands on computation power. The critical data is suggested being stored in record management set, a mechanism based on Java MIDlet. And a communication transaction management is also proposed for SMS/MMS communication between the client software and its gateway. The verification of the key updating process is verified with model checking in UPPAAL[7].

articleTitle: An extracted human face algorithm for facial features potential distribution
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A valid algorithm for extracted human faces and facial features has been put forward. This algorithm has combined the gradient mapping of binary edge image and the potential distribution of people's facial characteristics. First of all, using the gradient mapping of horizontal direction and vertical direction of binary edge image, to determine the location of the human face and the rough location of the human eye, then using the approximation method to location the human eye's accurate positioning; To determine the location of mouth by the gradient mapping in vertical direction of the image; Combination of the human eye position, mouth position, as well as the potential distribution of face characteristics to determine the location of the nose. At the same time, in order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, a series of different people in different postures has been used to validate the algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the compatibility of learning styles and multimedia mode in College English class
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Soloman learning styles questionnaire has been applied in this study to survey the English learning styles of non-English majors in Grade 08, with a purpose to understand whether the students in the arts, sciences and engineering have some preferences in learning styles. Furthermore, the students have been interviewed about their own learning ways and their attitudes towards the present multimedia teaching mode in College English class, trying to probe into whether the multimedia teaching mode would meet the requirements of every college student today, and what teaching modes should be employed to truly achieve the consistency of teaching and learning to improve the teaching effect.

articleTitle: Data Mining method based on Lattice
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of internet and storage technology, we have got a lot of data. In order to find the information from these data, Data Mining has become an increasingly important topic in research as well as in industrial application. Up to now, there are a lot of Data Mining methods and specific tools. This article mainly talks about a new Data Mining Method called Data Mining based on Lattice. It has been applied in many research areas, such as: Data Bases, Data Analysis and Machine Learning Technology. The experiments finished by foreign researcher showed it may be a useful method for information retrieval and machine learning problem domains. Data Mining based on Lattice is indeed a better method of organization, which is useful for each domain. The use and application of Data Mining based on Lattice is an area of active and promising research in various fields. Therefore, it is important for us to study the Data Mining Method based on Lattice.

articleTitle: Probe into how to select wedge points of building structure
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of China's building structure, the reality and veracity of structural computation is playing an increasingly important role. How to select wedge points has great influence on the reality and veracity of structural computation. so, the proper choice of wedge points is a significant step in the design of building structure. Besides, the choice of wedge points is concerned with the horizonal resistance ratio of soil (m values) and the rigidity of the floor. Through some simpli-fied models, this paper illustrates that different choices of stiffness and m values how to impact on wage points.

articleTitle: The study of the influence of flow velocity on the internal force of deep arch ring
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the current code only have the calculation method of water pressure about pier, water pressure value of the main girder did not mention. Water and air belong to the fluid system, its motion and the stress are basically the same, so this paper quoted the calculation method of static wind load for the calculation of arch under water pressure, and the use of finite element software to analyze engineering examples, study the influence degree on the internal force of deep arch ring because the action of water pressure under the different flow velocity.

articleTitle: Study on the building technology of ocean boundary database
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Ocean boundary plays a significant role in various activities at sea. China owns broad waters, and the related data of ocean boundary was mostly recorded on paper, which is not up to the meets of the informationization and the users' demand. This paper, according to the study of ocean boundary database, adopts OO language and relational database, presents the design methods, and provides the powerful theory support for building technology of the ocean boundaries database.

articleTitle: Research of permanent magnetic brushless motor on epoxy resin with Taguchi method
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study used experiment design with Taguchi method to understand performance of epoxy resin. The objects experimented were permanent-magnet brushless motor with 263 coiling number and potting compound. Experiment was conducted to explore effectiveness of potting reduced the temperature. The Taguchi method was applied to determine the optimal sample combination. The results revealed from this study were positive on epoxy resin to transfer heat.

articleTitle: Research on slope stability and protective measure of VII region in Guilaizhuang
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to actual hydrologic condition and geologic information of VII region in Guilaizhuang, this paper arrives at a conclusion that the slope of VII region is in the state of limit equilibrium on the basis of failure mode research and slope stability analysis. Through contrast of some plans, it is considered that frame beam retaining wall is more reasonable, later this paper introduces the design of frame beam and anchor rope in detail, at last there is contrastive analysis of plasticity strain figure on the basis of ANSYS, which has broad application.

articleTitle: The issue and improvement suggestion of electronic commerce teaching process
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There are two reasons of why E-commercial can't fully fit for the society needs. First, the footing of high school is unclearly. Second, there is a practice gap between teaching and real world. Aiming at the problems, the importance of personnel training and practice teaching is discussed.

articleTitle: New blind signature scheme based on hyperelliptic curve
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the analysis of hyperelliptic curve cryptography and design principle of blind signature, a novel blind signature scheme based on hyperelliptic curve cryptography is proposed by transplanting a proxy signature arithmetic into hyperelliptic curve cryptograph. Then security of the new scheme is analyzed. Cryptanalysis shows that it satisfies unforgeability, undenyability, non-trail, blindness and other security requirements of blind signature. By introducing hyperelliptic curve cryptography this scheme's capability of anti-attacking is improved evidently comparing with existing blind signature schemes based on other public key cryptography.

articleTitle: Statistical inference for ANOVA under heteroscedasticity: Statistical inference
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper provides generalized inference methods to compute generalized p-values for the hypothesis of the equality of the fixed effects, generalized confidence regions and simultaneous confidence intervals for the effects in unbalanced one-way ANOVA model under heteroscedasticity.

articleTitle: Study on iron mining grade optimization method of open-pit mine based on marginal cost analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cut-off grade is the critical grade between ore and waste rock, the technical parameters which has a major impact on the open-pit's overall economic benefits. In this paper, it is studied that the marginal cost theory, combined with open-pit's production and management characteristics, determines a reasonable cut-off grade. The economic viability of exploiting low-grade iron is studied, and it is the technical support to exploit fully the mineral resources and to improve economic performance and social cost-benefit.

articleTitle: The further mechanical analysis on connection bolts of wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A large amount of bolt connections are frequently used in WTG. Combining characteristic of WTG bolt connection, with the connection of pitch bearing inner circle and blade as the research object, using finite element method, build multiple connection model, adopt multi-point constraints and nonlinear contact for finite element analysis, research on bolt rod element types, connections of each component and the establishment of contact, acquire the analysis result of different fine degrees from bolt stress to thread contact stress, puts forward the feasible finite element analysis scheme of wind generator bolt connection.

articleTitle: Adaptive precoding for spectrum shaping of OFDM-based cognitive radio signals
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a novel adaptive precoding scheme for spectrum shaping in OFDM-based cognitive radios (CR) system is proposed. The proposed adaptive precoder is designed using singular value decomposition (SVD) optimization method to minimize the power interference of OFDM signal to licensed users (LUs) while keeping the extension power at an acceptable level. Analysis and simulation show that the proposed scheme can significantly reduce the power interference to LUs at the expense of a little precoding efficiency. At the same time, the bit error rate (BER) performance of the proposed system over Rayleigh fading channel is improved due to the frequency diversity and the peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) is invariable.

articleTitle: Construction of ecological environment in corporate e-Learning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper focuses on e-Learning in the view of ecology and tries to construct an ecological environment to resolve the issues which corporate training faced. Nowadays e-Learning of corporate plays a significant role in employee training, as well as developing the internal human resource system. However, we still cannot overlook the existing shortcomings, such as the high investment, immature system, shortage of interaction and the rigid curriculum design. Ecological environment of e-Learning is multidimensional and it includes physical environment, social environment and normative environment. This study uses the principle of ecology as an analytical tool to help understand how to construct a corporate e-learning environment by three sub-environments mentioned above. The e-Learning ecological environment should transform from learning spaces to learning places. The distinction is similar to that between a `house' and a `home': a house keeps out the wind and rain, but a home is where we live and we can find sense of belonging.

articleTitle: Analysis of and development countermeasures for tourism e-commerce websites in Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Though tourism e-commerce in Shandong Province has developed to a certain scale and level in recent years, there still exists a great distance from the goal of building Shandong into a really great tourism province. Starting from website researches and visits, this paper analyzes the existing problems of current tourism e-commerce websites in Shandong Province, and brings forward well-targeted countermeasures in an effort to provide reference resources for the development of tourism e-commerce websites in Shandong Province.

articleTitle: Research on Japan software industry development
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Software industry is one of the emerging industries create huge market value, as well as major national strategic industry in the world. Japan software industry as Japan information industry, an important part of the rapid growth of information industry, accumulating a wealth of successful experiences. Investigation of Japan's software industry experience in the development process, for the development of software industry in our country is not without inspirations. Japan has been pulling the China software outsourcing is one of the main sources of power, Japan software development will have a profound impact on China's software industry.

articleTitle: Study on geometric mean sorting method of interval numbers
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the properties of geometric mean sorting function for interval numbers are discussed, the comparison between the geometric mean sorting method and the sorting method based on relative correlation coefficient is given. Then the shortage of sorting method for interval numbers based on relative correlation coefficient is derived. Finally, the rationality and the practicality of geometric mean sorting method are further confirmed by the example.

articleTitle: Information system construction of the forestry enterprise in China
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Facing the developing characteristic of informatization and intensification, the forestry enterprises can stand unassailable position in the market competition by accelerating realization of informatization. So based on the characters of forestry enterprise and the intensified path, author suggested that the overall infomatization of forestry enterprises can be accomplished step by step. Fist of all is setting up the gradual goal of information, second, choose the suitable technology and the last, synthesis realize the informatization. The author also suggested that the element task of forestry industry administration or forestry apartment is to manage platform of the E-government well and the key content is to strengthen the safety of network and develop towards internationalized direction.

articleTitle: A novel method for the Doppler-shift correction of the measure and control signal
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Because of the adverse effect of Doppler-shift (frequency offset) to the measure and control signal, this article describes a novel method for the correction of the Doppler-shift in the received signal based on Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). It presents the results of computer-simulation tests to measure the time taken to correct the Doppler shift at a very low signal-noise ration.

articleTitle: A block-based DCT and multiresolution reordering scheme for high resolution image coding
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A scheme for high resolution image coding is proposed in this paper. In this scheme, 8×8 block-based DCT and multiresolution reordering is performed on the input image to obtain three-level wavelet-like tree structure. The same procedures are performed repeatedly on LL subband to obtain multi-level wavelet-like tree structure. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed scheme provides better PSNR performance at high bitrate than other DCT-based rearrangement ones.

articleTitle: Simulation study on air power brake system of half vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Air power brake system (APBS) on a vehicle was put forwarded in this paper to resolve that the braking distance couldn't be effective curtailed because of the maximum ground braking force during vehicle braking. We analyzed its working principle, added Fa and researched on the basic simulation of control model. The academic feasibility of initiative air power brake system was expatiated, that was based on the principle of compressed air power reaction which was applied to the brake system, then established dynamics model of a new automotive brake system and simulation model of ABS&APBS based on MATLAB/Simulink. The simulated tests were designed to compare with the curve of vehicle speed and wheel velocity with APBS. The graph prove that APBS reduce braking distances at 6%–14% and braking time at 14%–32%. The results show that the new system can increase braking efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and application of the guiding and twisting mechanism for straw pad automatic bundling machine
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The core components that guiding and twisting mechanisms of straw pad automatic bundling machine were designed and applied. A guiding groove with ring separable structure and twisting mechanism with the function of screwing and shearing the wire were put forward, and the banding cycle of the designed automatic bundling machine was 13s. Replacing manual bundling with the straw pad automatic bundling machine can enhance the production efficiency and automation level, improve bundling quality, and reduce labor intensity.

articleTitle: Application of information technology on undergraduate course teaching of International jurisprudence
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Information technology and Internet have already been rooted and applied in all fields of higher education, there is no exception to International jurisprudence teaching. This paper analyzes the content and function of information technology, elaborates on International jurisprudence teaching methods and its characteristics then puts forward that relative way to put information technology into use successfully in International jurisprudence teaching process.

articleTitle: Research and exploration on teaching “The pump and fan”
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to "pump and fan" curriculum characteristics, combined with the teaching practice, the teaching difficulty undertakes an analysis, put forward the teaching methods and suggestions. Hope that through this curriculum teaching, improve students' professional quality, deepen their understanding of the professional knowledge of the system understanding.

articleTitle: Mining consumer behaviors in the electronic commerce environment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the electronic commerce environment, the consumers can purchase products from the internet and the business can easily obtain the data about the transactions. Compared with other commodities, consumable products are purchased high-frequently. Although single gains for consumable products may be lower than that of appliances or electronic products, the accumulative gains for consumable products are great. Therefore, grasping suitable timing to do sales promotion for consumable products is an important task. For the consumable products, the purchase time for the next transaction is usually related to the purchased quantities for this transaction. In this paper, we propose a novel data mining algorithm to find the item-consumption behaviors for most of the consumers. From this information, we can predict the next purchase time for an item based on the purchased quantity of this item at this time. The experimental results show that our algorithm is efficient and scalable, and the mining results can exactly reflect the consumption behaviors for most of the consumers.

articleTitle: Optimization of diverter's nozzle in the flow facility
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the design and optimization of diverter's nozzle in the flow facility. The profile of the flow at the outlet of the nozzle has great influence to the performance of the diverter. In case to optimize the diverter, we need to optimize the structure of the nozzle. As to the nozzle, an approximately symmetrical velocity profile across the jet width is desired. Here, we use the Fluent software combine with the experiment as tools to research the best structure of the nozzle.

articleTitle: Design & implementation of laboratory information management system based on agile method
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Agile software development is a new methodology of developing high quality software timely when facing significant change; it is convenient for managers to accomplish the collection, disposal, output and other work to the data. There are chart and table functions to the output data and information of laboratories, functions of the output of original and final reports of laboratories, making it affiance to precede the quality control of the data and to help managers arrange analytical plans, staff and other daily work.

articleTitle: Partial distortion based computation-constraint motion estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Recently, the rapid development of wireless networks and multimedia communication techniques provide solutions to achieve watching digital videos on hand-held devices. Motion estimation (ME), the most important part of video coding, has been used to increase the effectiveness of video compression. However, the computations of motion estimation could be failed in limited computing environments even using the fast algorithms. Therefore, the traditional ME algorithms cannot directly applied to the hand-held devices. In this paper, we propose a partial distortion scheme that sacrifice little visual quality for hand-held devices in a given computation constraint condition. We also analyze various computation-aware based block matching algorithms and present an efficient method to compute the motion vectors. The proposed method significantly reduces the requirement of computation power in computing motion vectors while the number of search points needed is only 25% of the conventional method.

articleTitle: The application of medical nursing network teaching platform in medical teaching adult education
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of society, the application of teaching - learning platform for students to learn is an inevitable trend. This paper discusses the online teaching platform of medical nursing in the teacher-student interactive teaching guidance in the application. A questionnaire survey suggests that this adult - learning platform for medical students is of great significance in the overall quality.

articleTitle: The decoding device design of IRIG-B format time code
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: IRIG-B format time code (the B-code) is widely used in various systems of the time synchronization as an international common time coding sequence. A decoding circuit is presented for decoding IRIG-B format time code which utilizes the method that takes single chip processor as core and combines peripheral control circuit with D/A converting circuit. This circuit decodes the temporal information of the year, month, day, hour, minute, second and transmits to the equipment located in different parts in the way to a serial port output in order to realize the time synchronization between various equipment and export normative second pulse information.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge creation in virtual enterprise
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: At first, this paper outlines the brief introduction of virtual enterprise and knowledge creation. Then, it discusses the motivation of knowledge creation in virtual enterprise and analyzes the SECI model and three dimensions of knowledge creation in a virtual enterprise include the individual dimension, the member enterprise dimension and the virtual enterprise dimension. On this basis, it analyses the status quo of knowledge creation in virtual enterprise and lists existing problems. Finally it provides a series of advices to improve the efficiency of knowledge creation in virtual enterprise. Knowledge creation process of virtual enterprise based on the existing infrastructure will be further developed in the future.

articleTitle: The research of application of powder active carbon in removing antibiotic pollution
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article discusses the effect of active carbon in the aspect of absorbing antibiotic pollutions. Under the experimental conditions, 30 kinds of antibiotics are used. And active carbon's removal rate is about 96.54% to 100%. Nadilixic acid, Oxytetracycline and Lincomycin are selected as representatives. Based on the data, when the pollution is up to 1mg/L and the removal rate is >;99.99%, the dose of usage of active carbon should be 115mg/L (Nadilixic acid), 75mg/L (Oxytetracycline) and 25mg/L (Lincomycin). According to other antibiotics' difficulty of being absorbed by active carbon, this paper calculates the use of active carbon in the similar situation. To long-term pollution which is less than 1ug/L, The use of active carbon should maintain in the range of 1 to 35mg/L, so that antibiotics pollution can be removed effectively.

articleTitle: Investigation of generating random phase in transform domain communication system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Known as one of the Cognitive Radio (CR) transceiver technologies, the transform domain communication system (TDCS) has the characteristic of low probability of intercept (LPI) and the capability of multiple access (MA). In this paper, basing on the random phase mapping, the characteristics of the pseudorandom (PR) phase vector and the Basis Function (BF) are investigated. After that, two methods of generating random phase, the least common multiple method and the equal interval method are proposed, which both can generate the PR phase vector and the BF of TDCS. In matlab, simulation results indicate that the two methods both can generate the BFs, which have the characteristic of strong autocorrelation and weak crosscorrelation in TDCS.

articleTitle: The system dynamics analysis of the enterprise ERP project
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Because of the increasing demands of enterprise standardization management, ERP project executive effect is attached great importance by the enterprises. By analysis of ENR influence factors and current situation, we make the ENR influence factors modeling using system dynamics. We present part of modeling results to verify the reliability of model and give theory reference for evaluating and forecasting the ERP.

articleTitle: Strategy on functional pattern planning of seasonal landscape in winter city
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Functional pattern planning of seasonal landscape in winter city is not a simple process, nor is simple functional layout, but considering seasonal variation of winter city and adaptive mechanism of landscape, also is a complex and time scale landscaping arts. This paper take landscape geography and landscape ecology as the theoretical basis, divided the functional elements of seasonal landscape into the landscape resources, subject demands and space functions. Proposed strategies of exploiting multi-season landscape resources, constructing multiple space function and building model of functional transformation to realize seasonal design of landscape in winter city and planning of functional patterns.

articleTitle: Studying on the architecture of the CGF in combating training system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of computer simulation technology and the requirement of enhancing the fidelity of combating training on the sea, it is inevitable to integrate computer computer generated forces(CGFs) into military simulation system. And the CGFs must act as an actual enemy commander in the virtual sea battle space. For the purpose of reuse and expandability of a synthetical combating simulation components which had been worked out in the past, it is developed to be HLA-compliment In this paper, special emphasis had been put on the building an extensible and flexible architecture of the CGFs which could be integrated into such an synthetical combating simulation system. The precess of decision-making is found on the analysis of behaviors that an entity commander would act in real sea war.

articleTitle: Network security evaluation in hospital based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Judgment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to analysis of the development of the digital hospital, this paper summarizes the factors which affecting the safety of the hospital network in currently. by taking the method of questionnaire, the proportion of each factor is counted. Combined with the way of expert advice, decides the weight of each factors, establishes the model of Fuzzy Comprehensive Judgment and gives the specific evaluation process. In practice, the result shows that the method proposed is feasible and instructive.

articleTitle: Multiple shared trees multicast based on set covering and Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Single shared tree and source rooted trees are two extreme approaches for the many-to-many multicast applications. These two approaches complement each other in terms of performance, protocol overhead and robustness. The problem we faced is to construct multiple shared trees for many-to-many multicast applications and reduce the management costs by minimizing the number of shared trees, which can be transformed into the set covering problem which is proved NP-complete. Then an Ant Colony Optimization(ACO) algorithm for multiple shared trees multicast based on set covering (MSTSC) is presented in this paper. Simulation experiments indicate ACO algorithm for MSTSC is efficiency and feasible.

articleTitle: Towards multi-core expert system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There is growing interest in integrating rule based reasoning with other resolution paradigm, including constraint programming. This paper proposes three hybrid techniques which reinforce standard reasoning technique of rule based system with constraint satisfaction techniques. Firstly, we describe general principles of our multi-core expert system. Furthermore, we explain the various manners for communication or collaboration between a CSP solver and an inference engine of expert system. Secondly, we present the hybrid inference mechanism, and we give the principle of these approaches. Then, we analyze these approaches emphasizing the properties of each one.

articleTitle: Hardware design of data acquisition and processing of digital IF receiver
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The intermediate frequency (IF) signal solution hardware scheme of software defined radio which based on DDC and DSP is formulated. Signal conditioning circuit composed of OPA842 and AD8138 ensures the analog input to ADC AD6644 is differential and low noise. In design DDC HSP50214B realizes frequency conversion and rate conversion, it lowers the sampling rate and filters the signal to process for following. The buffer of data transmission between DDC and DSP is composed of two FIFOs. According to the structure of hardware the mode of data transmission and access timing of FIFO are analyzed.

articleTitle: Reform and exploration of electrical and electronic practice teaching center for local college
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For the needs of engineering talent for country and the characteristics of personnel training for local colleges, with its own teaching conditions of Hunan Institute of Science and Technology, electrical and electronic practice teaching center has made effective reform and exploration in practice of teaching philosophy, teaching content, teaching methods and means and so on. Electrical and electronic practice teaching center constructed a special teaching system, and achieved remarkable results in self-development of teachers and training of students for Hunan Institute of Science and Technology.

articleTitle: The application of XML query approximate matching algorithm in PDM technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: PDM is the tool to help managers manage product data and product development process. Due to the business data owing object-oriented features and supports for object search, thus XML has these characteristics, so that people increasingly prefer to use XML to store business data. In this paper, we propose XML-twig approximate matching twig join algorithm based on DTD named AdvancedFTJ, which can realize flexible matching in PDM It does not only meet the strict matching, but also satisfies the query needs with clear query target when the PDM user doesn't understand the pattern information of the DTD.

articleTitle: The comparison of shock resistance effects of rubber pipe clamp and spring banger
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The piping systems of ships are always numerous and complicated. In the situation of underwater explosion, the large displacement is always been the FMEA failure mode of pipe. In view of mis situation, author chose a typical pipeline of ship, and compared the effects of shock resistance of two pipelines installed with two types of vibration dampers. The result indicates that rubber pipe clamp is better than spring banger. And in the process of research, author also found the law of maximum stress distribution area of two vibration dampers.

articleTitle: Several experience of ship collision avoidance
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Poor visibility had a great influence on the safety of the ship navigation, data shows more than 60% of ship collisions are caused by poor visibility, while radar is avoidance, collision avoidance an indispensable tool in particular the fog. Using radar we can get early warning collision risk by, so that we have more time for the give way vessel, collision avoidance, at the same time, we use VHF, AIS have dangerous ship on radar can also be identified and contact, coordination of lien, better collision effects can be achieved. In order to make the ship pilots to effective use of these instruments for collision avoidance, this article describes using these instruments under poor visibility conditions for some commonly-used method of collision avoidance. For ship pilots have drills boat collision reference in poor visibility conditions, with a view to preventing collisions to achieve a good effect, ensure the safety of maritime navigation.

articleTitle: Indicator diagram identification based on ART2 neural network and features of moment invariant
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The indicator diagram is an important basis to analyze the downhole conditions of the pumping unit. Currently, it is mainly depends on artificial judgment to identify the indicator diagram, that not only needs higher requirements of the peoples' experience, but also spends much more time and energy. ART2 neural network for an arbitrary sequence of continuous or binary mode, has the ability of fast and stable learning. It overcomes the shortcomings of the feed-forward neural networks, such as learning slowly; falling into the local minimum and washing away previously learned information easily. Moment invariants can reflect the key characteristics of two-dimensional graphics; it also owns the traits of rotation, stretching invariance and strong anti-interference, etc. It can be used for the feature extraction of pattern recognition. This paper mainly based on ART2 neural network and the moment invariant to identify the indicator diagrams in different working conditions. The recognition result shows that the ART2 neural network owns many advantages such as the fast, stable and high accuracy performance in the indicator diagram recognition process.

articleTitle: Research on the torque characteristic of disc micromotor on axial magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to increase the electromagnetic torque density of micromotor with axial magnetic field, numerical analysis of permanent magnetic field and electromagnetic torque were deduced and the key factors of increasing torque density of micromotor was obtained. The numerical analysis of three-dimensional magnetic field in air gap produced by spliced sector permanent magnetic poles is done, and the way of improving flux density and permanent magnet use efficiency are given through investigating the influence of magnet thickness, height of air gap and pole interval rate and other parameters to air gap flux density and leakage flux. Based on the test of axial magnetic field and torque characteristic of micromotor, the analysis of micromotor magnetic field and calculation of torque are verified, meanwhile using the plane stator with 0.7mm thickness assemble micromotor having minimum air gap height of 1mm and its torque constant up to 3.8mNm/A.

articleTitle: Research on the moving vehicle detection technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the Comprehensive utilization of symmetric difference methods and background subtraction<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1, 2]</sup> for moving vehicle detection. Firstly build a reliable background update model, and then combine the basically accurate foreground image got from background subtraction with difference image got from symmetric difference. Finally get the reliable image of moving target, so that the mobile vehicles can be detected from video sequence.

articleTitle: A new frequency source based on Sigma Delta and CORDIC
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Direct Digital Synthesizer has become the first choice for the signal generator in modern electronic devices. But the spur prevents it from replacing traditional frequency synthesizer completely. This paper introduces a new frequency source, conjoining Sigma Delta and CORDIC, to produce high-resolution and low spur analog wave-forms. With phase noise as low as -107dBc/Hz, the generated sine waveforms at MF and HF show the better performances than those produced by general analog signal generator. Furthermore, It does not require a ROM, a multiplier or DAC, easily realized in FPGA(S), CPLD or ASIC.

articleTitle: Study of investigating and improving negative space in an old urban block of Nanning city: Characteristics and formation causes of negative space
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study focuses on an old urban block called Water Street in a southern city of China - Nanning. Based on field investigation, etc., this paper discusses manifestation and disadvantageousness of negative space in the street, summarizes characteristics of negative space combining with relevant data, analyzes causes of negative space according to the aforementioned research, and provides foundations for comprehending negative space in the old urban block, transforming its spatial layout, etc.

articleTitle: Clustering routing protocol based on local optimization for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper has proposed the wireless sensor network routing protocol which has the advantages of low energy consumption. In consider data delay, the protocol using the cluster head forwards strategy transmit information to the base station. In the clustering phase, combining with both the residual energy of nodes and randomly generated threshold to generate cluster heads and establish clusters; In the data transfer phase, using local optimal strategy to make the number of the information forwards is reduced, so that avoiding delay of the information and decreasing the energy consumption of the cluster head. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the protocol, through balanced energy consumption, stable clusters and data transfer times decrease, makes the network lifetime longer than LEACH and DEEC protocols.

articleTitle: A position system of multi-APs based on RSSI
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we present a measure to compute the position of the mobile device, which can reduce the effect of the walls and other obstructions via the ratio of the RSSI form the each AP in the similar environment. It enhances the accuracy for the coordinates of the mobile devices by applying much more APs than the traditional RSSI location system.

articleTitle: Reducing forecast errors by logarithmic transformations for complex time series
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Both nonlinear theories and Fourier analysis predicate theoretically that low-order nonlinear transformation has three advantages. First, it can increase the signal-to-noise ratio of a complex time series that has a large fluctuation. Second, it can insulate negative effects of outliers or bad data. Last, it can improve the distinction between the signal and white noise. The trend in the classical decomposition of “trend plus seasonals plus residuals” of a complex time series is equivalent to a non-periodic signal with continuous frequency spectrum, and is inevitably lost partly by the discrete Fourier transform for the discrete finite time point. Our numerical experiments with natural logarithmic transformation confirm these theoretical deductions.

articleTitle: The model driven approach with UML for Instructional System Design
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Instructional System Design (ISD) is an incremental process that systematically follows the stages of analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. However, educators are often confused about which model to use because of the omission of some basic guide on how the model has been used. Another reason for the less than satisfactory acceptance of the systematic approach is the apparent absence of validation for many models. This paper with the aid of the systematic theory and method, present and describe the new models of instructional design by UML diagrams, and offered the new theory framework and modeling method on theoretical research and practice for ISD.

articleTitle: On the design and implementation of a virtualized residential gateway
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents ongoing work in the realization of an open and functional next-generation Residential Gateway (RG). Our RG supports the deployment of third-party services through Operating System-Level (OS-Level) Virtualization, namely LXC Namespaces. Our experiences show that LXC Namespaces is capable of supporting a relatively high number of services with little performance overhead, even on modest hardware. In order to provide the proof of concept, we present a validating application from the healthcare domain, although the generic RG architecture is capable of supporting services from other service domains.

articleTitle: Power aware routing protocol based on OLSR in Ad Hoc network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: PA-OLSR makes an improvement on the routing algorithm, frame format, information storage table of OLSR. The key concept of PA-OLSR is finding a lowest energy cost between souce and destination, and choosing the longer lifetime nodes as MPR. PA-OLSR uses the power control mechanism based on signal attenuation rate that can estimation the minimum transmission power to neighbor nodes, and considers the energy loosing rate in the node lifetime assessment. According to the theoretic analysis, this dissertation gives the simulation models based on the OPNET Modeler platform, and analyzes three performances parameters: the success rate of the packet transmitting, end-to-end delay, and network lifetime. The simulation results show that PA-OLSR can improve the channel utilization and network lifetime.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of intelligent management system of undergraduate graduation thesis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: After analyzing most of the current Graduation Thesis Management Systems, we proposed an intelligent management system which can meet the requirements of the process of most Graduation Thesis Management Systems. In this paper we mainly introduce the design of the functional components and implementation of the system. We developed the system using ASP.NET and SQL Server database and designed user interfaces for the system manager, principal, student, advisor and supervisor. The system supports batch lead-in of teachers and students' information, two-way choice of thesis topics, managements to thesis grades, statistics and export of thesis related information as well as automated analysis to thesis topic's repetition frequency. The system has been used for two years for the management of our school's graduation papers, and it works well. The implementation of the system is benefit for improving the management efficiency of graduation thesis and has realistic meaning to promote the IT application in school.

articleTitle: Chaos theory in the power to control system design
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The chaos is a seemingly random irregular movement, It reflects the inherent characteristics of the nonlinear science, It is a common phenomenon, The chaos is in recent years the very issue of concern, chaos theory for practical application in engineering has become a hotspot at home and abroad, including in the design of the power control system is one aspect of the application. In this paper, we study Chaos theory, first, an overview of the chaos theory, chaos theory and then in the power control system design and optimization focuses on the practical application of elaborated.

articleTitle: A method for face gender recognition based on blocking-LBP and SVM
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As an important field of face recognition, gender recognition based on face has been paid more and more attention. This paper proposes a method for gender recognition based on blocking local binary pattern (LBP) and support vector machine (SVM). With the difference from those traditional methods for face image feature extraction, we divide a face image into several blocks, overlap or non-overlap, and the LBP histogram characteristics of these blocks are extracted and cascaded to form face feature vector. The SVM is used to carry out the gender recognition on the feature vectors. The analyses are given about the effect of the attachments of face and the different partitions of face image on recognition results. The detail experiment results show that our method gives higher accuracy.

articleTitle: The study of determining spinning reserve capacity with wind power
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the scale of wind power expanding each year, the traditional method for determining spinning reserve capacity is no longer applicable. In this paper, the author analyses the probability distribution of the wind power output error, and brings it into the power system reliability calculations, to replace the power system reliability index constraints based on the original spinning reserve constraint. At last, the author uses Lagrangian relaxation method to solve the unit combinations, and the result shows that the proposed method for determining spinning reserve is feasible on the economy and reliability.

articleTitle: A novel heating system for heavy oil extraction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: At present, industrial frequency heating technology is widely used to extract heavy oil which the content of glial asphalt, wax and freezing point are higher. Its heating effect is poor and it wastes electricity seriously. With the integrated application of eddy effect, skin effect and proximity effect, a novel heating system was developed. Both a dedicated multi-function cable and three-phase AC source whose voltage, frequency and power can be regulated were designed. The experimental results showed that the heating system has advantages such as high heating efficiency, low power consumption, and small pollution to the power grid, which can be used for practical production.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a new infrared transmitter and receiver
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Infrared communication is the main mode of short distance communication and has been widely used for point to point data transmission. The main drawback of infrared communication is that the signal is very weak and there are certain requirements for firing angle. According to these disadvantages, this design of transmitter circuit has used three stage amplifiers in order to amplify the initialization audio signal to drive the emission heads work normally, and also two emission heads are used to ensure sufficient strength of transmitted signal. Optical receiver employs a two stage amplifying circuit and some filter circuits to ensure the receiving signal can be detected normally.

articleTitle: Random vibration analysis of controlled building based on the equivalent excitation method
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the equivalent excitation method, the equivalent excitation load of the controlled system is constructed under random excitations, and then adopting the state space control theory, the responses of the controlled system are calculated. According to the equivalent excitation method, the statistical characteristics of the responses are determined to fulfill the random vibration analysis of the controlled system. The simulation analysis of a real building shows that the LQG controlled structural has remarkable control effect. And that prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the random vibration analysis for the controlled system.

articleTitle: Simulation of LDPC convolutional decoders with CPU and GPU
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, the Sum Product Algorithm (SPA) and the Min-Sum Algorithm (MSA) are used for decoding low-density parity-check convolutional codes (LDPC-CCs). The two algorithms have been implemented and run on three different computing environments. The first environment is a single-threading Central Processing Unit (CPU); the second one is the multi-threading CPU based on OpenMP (Open Multi-Processing); and the third one is the multi-threading Graphics Processing Unit (GPU). The error performance of the LDPC-CCs and the simulation time taken under the three specific computing environments and the two decoding algorithms are evaluated and compared. It is found that the different computing environments produce very similar error results. It is also concluded that using the GPU computing platform can reduce the simulation time substantially.

articleTitle: The study of Cult3D technology and its application in virtual experiment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cult3D is a three-dimensional streaming technology which is developed by a Swedish company called Cycore. With excellent texture, flexible interactive way Cult3D has become an ideal tool for developing virtual experiment. In this paper, we take college physical electromagnetic virtual experiment as an example. Then introduce application methods and skills of Cult3D technology in the virtual experiment, which provide students with lively and effective virtual learning environment.

articleTitle: A height controller design for miniature UAVs based on GPS and barometer
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the limitations of airborne sensors configuration of conventional miniature UAVs, this paper proposes a practical real-time algorithm which can integrate barometric height and GPS altitude. This algorithm uses the GPS altitude to calibrate baro-altimeter on-line, without considering the motion model and maneuverability of carrier. Tests showed that the fusion algorithm has significantly improved measurement results of altitude information, combining short-term and dynamic performance of barometric height with long-term stability of GPS altitude. On this basis, the height controller was designed for miniature UAVs, and successfully applied to the flight control system of a small unmanned aerial vehicle for polar research, with the control error less than 10m during cruise stage.

articleTitle: The study of ZigBee networking with wireless sensor
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Introduces the ZigBee technology and its protocol stack in this paper. By using TI's CC2430 to design the hardware of sensor network node, analyses on the principle and process of ZigBee wireless sensor network building, builds a star network for temperature sensor, and tracks each nodes through the serial port. Experiments prove that the network nodes working state is stable.

articleTitle: An experimental analysis for compressive sensing in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: We design a kind of wireless sensor network node for collecting parameters about environments of farmland, and employ compressive sensing algorithm in wireless sensor networks. Temperature is picked out for compressing and reconstructing. Primary analyses show that the algorithm can effectively compress observations for transmitting fewer packets. The increase in computation brought by compressive sensing is within acceptable range, and the total energy cost of the network is reduced by a large ratio. By taking comparison between original and recovery, the results quantitatively show that, compressive sensing algorithm possesses significant performance and efficiency, and can meet requirements of accuracy on signal compression in some applications of wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: The research of stability performance of five-axle whole wheel steering vehicles with electric wheel basing on direct yaw control system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the characteristic that the driving torque of five-axle and whole wheel steering vehicles with electric wheels can be controlled independently, to improve vehicle handling and stability, based on the yaw control strategy, it was proposed that the optimal vehicle handling and stability can be achieved while turning, according to the target yaw rate, based on the PID control algorithm and DYC control strategy, with the control of the inner and outer wheel driving torque. And a five-axle vehicle model was built in Adams/View software, and was co-simulation with Simulink software. The results show that, during the angle step input response, compare to the only first two-axle steering vehicle, with the use of DYC control strategy, the yaw velocity overshoot is smaller 2.7% than without DYC, settling time is smaller 19.7%. For whole wheel steering vehicle, the yaw velocity overshoot with DYC is smaller 59.5% than without DYC, settling time is smaller 33.9%. This greatly improved the vehicle's stability performance. Especially for whole wheel steering multi-axle vehicle, this decreased the possibility of steering shimmy.

articleTitle: The virtual reality technology in art design
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a new technology. It has great application prospects in the field of art design. At first, this paper analyzed the concept of virtual reality technology. At second, this paper analyzed the concept of art design. At third, this paper introduced the applications of VR technology in display design, including: panoramic image technology, three-dimensional display technology, stereo sound display technology, and interactive display technology. At fourth, this paper introduced the applications of virtual reality technology in product design. At fifth, this paper introduced the applications of virtual reality technology in environment art design. Finally, this paper discussed the importance and the future of art design based the VR technology.

articleTitle: A solution to blind separation of convolutive communication mixtures in frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient algorithm to deal with convolutive blind source separation of communication signals in frequency domain is presented. The classical JADE algorithm is adopted to perform linear complex-valued ICA in each frequency bin. To solve the permutation ambiguity problem, a new permutation technique based on high-order statistics is proposed. Then, a post processing procedure called CMA is added to compensate for signal distortion. Simulations are included to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and application of high concentrating solar photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Using the solar energy focusing photovoltaic generate electricity is the effective way of solving current questions about shortage of energy exhaustion of resources, environmental pollution and so on. Under the condition of the same output power of the photovoltaic system, using low cost superiority of the high concentrator material in place of the expensive solar cell to reduce the comprehensive cost of the photovoltaic system and realize the highly effective and the efficient unification of the focusing photovoltaic system. In this paper, concentrating photovoltaic power generation system technical problems are analyzed, and put forward improvement scheme. In addition, at the end of the paper, in combination with high concentrator solar photovoltaic power generation data collection and monitoring system, the high concentration photovoltaic system part of the operation data were analyzed briefly. Test data analysis indicates that, on the optimal design and analysis can improve the efficiency of solar photovoltaic power generation system.

articleTitle: Measurement and analysis of thermal environment in a Nanning's pedestrian street
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents summertime measurement data of air temperature, globe temperature and pavement surface temperature in the pedestrian street in a southern city (Nanning) of China. Thermal comfort and solar shading effect in the passage space of arcade buildings were analyzed. Characteristics of air temperature variation were also discussed. Based on analysis results, effective strategies were proposed for improving the thermal environment in the pedestrian street.

articleTitle: An intrusion detection classification model base on projection pursuit
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Intrusion detection is a challenging and critical problem in network security. Extensive research activities have been aimed at network-based intrusion detection systems, but most of them are proved unsatisfactory. This paper presents an effective intrusion detection classification model based on projection pursuit. With maximizing a projection index, Projection Pursuit uses Genetic Algorithm to search for the optimal projection direction, projects network connections records from high-dimensional space into 1-dimensional space, and uses the projection values to analyze the data structure and classify the type of intrusion. This intrusion detection classification model not only cuts down the computing complexity in the process of network connection records, but also opens out non-linear structure not like in latent semantics analysis only discovering linear structure, and the results of classification can also be visualized. The results of the experiments on KDD CUP 1999 data show that this model not only has good performance, but also reduces the number of false alarms effectively.
