Therefore, the DVC is suitable for wireless video capturing device, camera and so forth which the computation ability, memory size, power consumption are limited. The DVC decrease the complexity of encoding process, but increase the complexity of decoding process. To guarantee the fluent of the multi-view stereoscopic TV play, GPU is employed to accelerate the decoding process. The experiment result shows that joint decoding of eight views to generate the side information is more effective than conventional decoding of single view. And the CUDA could accelerate the decoding process efficiently.

articleTitle: Study on monitoring method of gun recoil mechanism of technique appearance based on K-L transformation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This text mainly makes use of K-L transformation to tank gun recoil mechanism in great quantities breakdown phenomenon and breakdown reason data of different category carried on to lower a Wei number, withdraw characteristic vector and compute the processing of long-lost degree and come to a to effectively cut influence quantity and judge the effect of breaking down the category, the breakdown diagnosis equiping for the tank of recoil mechanism provided a simple method and turned a development to provide new path to the intelligence for tank weapon at the same time.

articleTitle: The effect on residential life for the tunnel construction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the appearance of tunnels in the city or downtown, residential life and building is influenced inevitably by drilling and blasting construction at the entrance of tunnel. In order to reduce the effect, the monitoring of effect on resident, such as dust and noise was conducted during the construction of the entrance of tunnel. The monitoring result shows: (1) Dust content is 20 mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> at the entrance of tunnel for blasting. It is 60 mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> during the construction of wet pneumatically placed concrete. It is higher than the standard of health, 5.3 mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. (2) Noise is 85 decibels when ventilation and noise is 200 decibels during the construction of drilling that is more than the standard, 60 decibels. It provides the reference for similar engineering.(3)The surface settlement induced by drilling and blasting in tunnels affects residential life.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise environment sound technology innovation policy system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Many studies pointed out that the government should play the guiding role in environmental protection, in fact, enterprises, as the subject of economic activity, especially industrial enterprises, its initiative in the process of environmental technology innovation has a direct impact on environmental technology innovation and application. This paper firstly analyzed the impact of different environment regulatory and policy tools on environmental technology innovation; secondly, the paper analyzed the environmental policy system in America and European countries and the inadequacies of China's environmental policy system; finally, the paper proposed the policies and measures prompting China's enterprise environment technology innovation.

articleTitle: An unified resource mapping strategy based on XML in computational grid environments
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Mapping heterogenous resources is a challenging issue due to structural differences and structural inconsistencies. Based on the characteristics of XML and several extensions on the XML tree, A unified resource mapping strategy in computational grid environments is proposed for XML trees. A semantic relationship between nodes in XML trees is captured by the concept of a schema graph. Mapping are specified on the schema graph patterns of the schema graph. A mapping is not restricted by the structure of a specific XML tree. A technique for evaluating mapping is presented.

articleTitle: Research on the effectiveness of accounting management systems based on adults education
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The computer is an important symbol of mankind enters the information age and this phenomenon of the computer and cyber crime was studied deeply by scholars. The laws of many countries on how effective the punishment and prevention of computer crime requires a robust, the number and scope of the regulations, and even the proceedings, which is lagged far behind the reality of demand for computer crime in judicial practice. Computer and network crime in Chinese Criminal Law lack of judgment on the Elements and actual operability, so having some new problems to be solved.

articleTitle: Teaching exploration on programming design experimental practice
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Programming design practice course help students master and grasp the grammar. The past teaching method and environment isn't conductive to effective programming design learning. Through several years teaching practice, a new way that can foster students' programming interest and ability in solving the real problem is presented. Besides, the teaching experience and some results are also introduced.

articleTitle: Research of Chinese maritime education and training
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: China is a maritime power and IMO is one of the members of a class, have certain experience in maritime education and training and a better foundation. But with the current structure of the world economy and international trade structures increasingly profound changes, rising technology competition and China's accession to the WTO, of maritime education in China and international economic competition and domestic demand compared to the urgent need for the shipping industry, has been lagging behind. At the same time as the international shipping centre and moved East in the international shipping market has put forward higher requirements of maritime education in China, but also to the rapid development of maritime education in China provides a good opportunity.

articleTitle: Smart phone based online QoE assessment for end-to-end multimedia services on 3G mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Although there are already QoE metrics for some types of multimedia services on Internet, in the area of multimedia services over 3G mobile Internet, only 3GPP defines QOE metrics for popular multimedia services. To find the user perception on these metrics, a subjective assessment framework is proposed, where distorted video samples are generated by mapping from a simple End-to-End QoS (EQoS) metric set, and a new subjective assessment method, User Satisfaction Threshold Measurement (USTM) is designed. Hereafter, to formulate the subjective assessment in a most natural way, a smart phone based QoE assessment system managing the distorted video samples of the metrics, implementing USTM, providing an online test agent on smart phone to let subjects join the test at any places, is designed. As the result of the subjective assessment, four user satisfaction thresholds, multi-level user opinions, the user attention degree and their mapping to the parameters in EQoS, are obtained, providing useful guidelines for network plans, source productions and player deployment to network services providers like China Mobile.

articleTitle: MARR-ALOHA: A mobility adaptive variety of RR-ALOHA for vehicular ad-hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Although many Distributed Time-scheduling MAC algorithms are under evaluation for vehicular Ad-hoc networks (VANET), they are still not fully applicable for VANET with requirements of transmission reliability and efficiency. In this paper, a mobility adaptive variety of RR-ALOHA is proposed to adapt to the diversity of node density and contention severity in VANET. By introducing CSMA into slot and making full use of 3-hops channel state, the proposed schema outperforms RR-ALOHA in several aspects. NS-2 simulation results show that the novel protocol improves the speed of Basic Channel (BCH) reservation as well as the quality of slot allocation.

articleTitle: Study on the Collaborative Product Design Platform in the context of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at enhancing the response to customers' demand and the efficiency of designing product in the networked collaborated environment, a new concept for product design, which is from the supply chain view, is put forward based on the Internet of Things (IoT). In accordance with the requirements of collaborative product design, the relative application technologies of the IoT are deeply analyzed. To optimize and carry out the product design flow through the network, a modeling framework of Collaborative Product Design Platform established on the IoT is given. The fundamental structure, feasibilities, functions and key technologies of this platform are described in detail. All of these researches provide significant practical references for enterprises to build the related product design platform for improving the design quality.

articleTitle: Rating prediction algorithm and recommendation based on user beahavior in IPTV
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Service quality of IPTV directly influence Quality of user's Experience (QoE), one of the key technologies to attract new users. The current researches of IPTV mainly focus on two aspects: On one hand, researchers are concerned on evaluation of the quality of videos; on the other hand, personalized recommendation is cared more and more. For the former, the most effective solution is to improve the bandwidth of IPTV network; but to the second, Collaborative Filtering (CF) Algorithm performs perfect effect in personalized service. This paper we mainly pay attention to the later, based on the interests of user. Owing to the characteristic of interactions between user and television in IPTV platform, different behaviors of user, such as explicitly rating behavior, watching behavior and saving behavior and so on, may show different interests of Items. To obtain interests of user and make Personal recommendation, the author firstly introduced related behavior mining algorithm according to the main three behaviors and then proposed a new similarity computation in recommendation based on CF. Finally algorithm performance is evaluated with modified IPTV data from real TV watching data provided by Wenguang Shanghai Corp. in China and it shows quite comparative quality of recommendations.

articleTitle: Context-aware adaptive data scheduling algorithm for P2P streaming systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In mesh-based Peer-to-Peer media streaming systems, media contents are always divided into different data segments and stored in different peers. These segments are then streamed from multiple senders to a receiver. The receiver needs to coordinate the senders by specifying a transmission schedule for each segment. Therefore, the scheduling algorithm, which is in charge of coordinating data received from multiple peers, is the key factor for users' perception of video quality. In order to improve the overall performance of streaming systems, the Context-aware Adaptive (CAA) scheduling algorithm is proposed in this paper. In CAA algorithm, priorities for data segments are defined based on context information and the neighbors' bandwidth is dynamically evaluated. Then, the CAA algorithm calculates the order and direction of data segments from neighbors, according to context information such as priority of segments, current utilization of senders and the network capacity. Simulation results show that the proposed CAA scheduling algorithm requires smaller startup delays, and enhances the peer's average throughput. What's more, it achieves more balanced load distribution across peers than some conventional scheduling algorithms, and also improves the continuity index.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of node in cloud storage
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There is a method to evaluate the performance of the node storage the replica in the cloud storage, under this method we can get better node when we place the replica according to user requirement for service. First, establish the model of the performance of the node storage the replica using the analytic hierarchy process. Then, obtain the weighting of each factor in model using the combination weight. At last, the valuations of nodes are calculated and the rank of nodes is given by grey comprehensive evaluation. Experiment results show that the proposed method could provide more reasonable replica strategies effectively.

articleTitle: Student perceptions of e-learning components within a Masters level accounting module
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper is located in the arena of Masters-level accounting module with sixty seven registered students in England. It is concerned with identifying and exploring students' perceptions of influences, both positive and negative, of three specific e-learning components upon their learning experiences. The components are vote clickers, digital ink applications, and lecturecasts. The findings inform educators and module designers in the pursuit of the development of new blended learning modules, against a backdrop of increasing student expectations, and particularly so in the context of the high level of fees for post-graduate programmes. Students surveyed total sixty seven with forty five responses (67.2%). Data are collected through an on-line survey. The survey questions are derived from two focus groups using semi-structured interviews, with the interview themes informed from a literature review. The students in the focus groups are also stratified representatively. Data are analyzed and explored using absolute and relative frequencies. The exploration generates findings suggesting the vote clickers and digital ink innovations are perceived as enhancing the learning experience, but with mixed perceptions regarding lecturecasts, with lessons for educators.

articleTitle: An analysis on Chinese learners' participation of blog-based language learning after class
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Computer and internet technology brought about innovative changes of students life especially their leisure time after class. In light of this, the purpose of this study is to explore learners' participation of blog-based language learning in their independent learning in order to suggest a motivated and collaborative environment to communicate and learn.

articleTitle: Development of a virtual simulation system on CRH3 EMU bogies for maintenance
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper developed a virtual simulation system on CRH3 EMU bogies for maintenance, integrating with virtual simulation technology, computer simulation technology, modeling technology, virtual reality technology and multi-media technology, where the structure characteristics of CRH3 EMU bogies and requirements for maintenance are considered. The key technologies applied in the developed system were introduced in detail including 3D modeling and model converting for CRH3 EMU based on modularity, 3D visualization based on virtual reality, dynamic assembly simulation, information searching and inquiring and multi-media implementation. The system proposed in this paper can contribute to engineers to make reasonable and cost-effective maintenance plans, and can also be used to train the maintainers. In accordance with the structure characteristics of CRH3 EMU bogies and requirements of maintenance, virtual simulation technologies, computer simulation technology, modeling technology, virtual reality technology and multimedia technology are integrated to develop a virtual simulation system on CRH3 EMU bogies for maintenance. Key technologies applied in the system development include 3D modeling and model converting for CRH3 EMU based on Modular structure, 3D visual viewing based virtual reality, dynamic assembly simulating, information searching and inquiring and multi-media implementing. The system introduced in this paper can help engineers to make a reasonable and cost-effective maintenance plans. It can also be used for maintenance engineers and workers.

articleTitle: A novel model of bursts in event sequences
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When we focus on events analysis, such as studying the event burstiness and monitoring the event trends, we have to face a great number of similar events that had happened in the history, i.e. event sequences, usually spanning more than 10 years. Burst detection is a popular technique of sequence analysis. Today there are several burst models and detection algorithms based on different burst definitions, producing very different results. However, almost all of these definitions are difficult to clearly define the beginning and end, as well as intensity of the burst. In this paper, we reconsider the burst definition and propose an efficient detection approach for event sequences, which can be further utilized to other temporal sequences or data streams. As a sample application, we present the burst model for event sequences since the end of WWII (1946~2010) collected from the event lists in Wikipedia. Finally, we show the results comparison of our model and three popular ones in terms of rationality, and two case studies.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of heat transfer effects on methane hydrate dissociation by depressurization
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The methane hydrate dissociation process is always subject to the influence of heat transfer, which may affect the distribution of core temperature and the cumulative gas production. In this study, in order to analyze the heat transfer from surrounding and the conduction and convective heat transfer effect in hydrate dissociation process, a two-dimensional axisymmetric simulator is developed to model methane hydrate dissociation in porous media by depressurization. Energy conservation, mass transport, and intrinsic kinetic reaction are included in the governing equations, which are discretized by finite difference method and are solved in the implicit pressure-explicit saturation (IMPES) method. Therefore a series of simulations are performed to study the effect of the distribution of temperature and the cumulative gas production. These result suggest that heat input from surrounding have an obviously influence on the cumulative gas production and the distribution of core temperature, but the influence will be weaker when heat input from surrounding be a suitable value. Comparing with heat convective, heat conduction plays a less important role in hydrate dissociation.

articleTitle: Research and development of designing HARQ in LTE system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Because reliability of data transmission is crucial and there are noises or interference in Long Term Evolution (LTE) system, the process of HARQ are becoming complicated and important. In this paper, firstly we study and introduce HARQ. Then the central work is research of HARQ which the protocol didn't refer to and need giving attention to; through analyzing details of the questions, proposed a development of HARQ in SPS and cooperation between HARQ and ARQ. Finally, we proved feasibility of the way and it enhances security of transmission with theoretic analysis.

articleTitle: Study on Huai'an transport system internal coordination development based on DEA model
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Railway is the artery of national economy, and it is an important part of integrated transportation system. With the development of economy and society, railway transportation of Huai'an cannot meet the needs of rapid economic growth. It has put a serious impediment to the development of economy. The reasons lie in that the railway system hasn't implemented coordinated development. This paper chooses the number of employees of railway system and the number of freight vehicles as input indicators, and selects volume of rail freight, volume of passenger traffic and cargo turnover as output indicators. DEA theory is used to build Huai'an railway transport system internal coordination development model, and lingo software is adopted to solve. The evaluation results show, to increase the scale return of Huai'an railway transport, we need to increase the investment in railway transport systems, and to achieve the coordinated development with other modes of transport.

articleTitle: Optimization of the spare-part procure plan based on production plan in a steel pipe enterprise
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, with the onsite research of the procure plan process in a steel pipe enterprise, a optimizing model is set for due date setting of purchase plan and reducing the cost, also a solution using Genetic Algorithms is offered.

articleTitle: Study and application of automatic scoring technology in C programming test
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new automatic scoring method which combines the key statement points with the lexical or grammatical error analysis is proposed for programming test through the simulation of manual scoring. Through the experiments, the proposed method fundamentally corresponds with the thought process of manual scoring. Also, the probability distribution of the automatic scoring result is similar to the one of manual scoring result. It has great significance for realizing paperless test.

articleTitle: Necessity and strategy for transnational modern distance education in realization of wushu
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper made it as a starting point to conduct feasibility studies to promote wushu as soon as possible to achieve cross-border distance education, wushu needs to transnational modern distance education, and needs to make a preliminary study for implementation strategies. From analysis, the conclusion can be made that wushu is very necessary in this form of transnational modern distance education, which can be enhance its overall communications capabilities to meet the needs of international spread.

articleTitle: Maximizing system throughput in multi-user cooperative relay networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper we address the resource allocation problem in cooperative relay network. We provide a comparative analysis of two basic protocols namely Amplify and Forward (AF) and Decode and Forward (DF), by implementing different sub-carrier allocation techniques with optimized power allocation. Our analysis is focused on total achievable system throughput and achievable individual throughput for each user.

articleTitle: Discussion on the evaluation system of college physics experiments
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper introduces the evaluation system of college physics experiments, and discusses in detail the evaluation criterion of experiment preview, lab report, each experiment score, and operating test. Our teaching experiences for many years have demonstrated that this evaluation system has strong operability in the inspection of students' practical abilities and experiment quality.

articleTitle: Analysis on impact effect of broken suspender of arch bridge parallel double-suspender system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: For the search on the impact to bridge span structure due to sudden broken of arch bridge suspender, the paper aim at the parallel double suspender system, use finite element analysis software to simulate and calculate that in short-length, medium-length, long-length three kinds of suspender system, when one suspender sudden break, the impact effect endured by another suspender at the same hoisting point and the arch ribs, bridge deck structure which connected to broken suspender. The paper also discuss the value of impact coefficient of broken suspender, provide theoretical basis for the design of failure safety suspender.

articleTitle: Study on static and dynamic load test of continuous girder bridges
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It conducted a research on static and dynamic load test to investigate actual working conditions and bearing capacity of continuous girder bridges. Detect the mechanical characteristic and deformation of main bridge structure especial the pier no.2 which was strengthened of a continuous girder bridge under static and dynamic load. Build finite element model of MIDAS/Civil of the bridge and calculate theory values related to contents of the test. The result comparison between experiment data and theory values shows that, both deformation and strain of every control section and characteristics of vibration such as frequency damp ratio and mode shape meet the requirements. During the study, some conclusions were deduced and precious experience was accumulated for calculation of mechanical characteristic and load test of this kind of bridges.

articleTitle: Scheme of WTL-based instant booking system on mobile network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid rise of mobile E-business, real time booking service by cell phone is facing great chances and challenges. General method of using J2ME or MFC to develop mobile software can't meet the fast and real time requirements of mobile booking service. In this paper, we propose a new WTL-based method to realize instant booking function by cell phone on mobile network. On the basis of the server of the railway ticketing system, we realize the real time mobile booking system on windows mobile platform. Experiment results show that when booking train tickets by this system, average network access time is only 1.894s, and average query time is only 4.157s. It is testified that this method can greatly shorten the booking query time and other relevant time factors when comparing with traditional method of J2ME or MFC.

articleTitle: Jet Riemann-Lagrange geometry and applied for Rebelo model
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to introduce Jet Riemann-Lagrange geometry and apply it to discuss Rebelo model and technical progress model by means of solving a sort of Kaldor flow equation, we get the solution of model and give the meaning of solution in economy.

articleTitle: Research on education network information ecological index visualization evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the information ecology theory and applies it to the education of the content of the web site and function of the assessment, put forward a set of evaluation indexes and set up a reasonable and effective evaluation index system. We determine the index weight by using the analytic hierarchy process, during the establishment of the judgment matrix, we use two methods, the 1-9 percentage scale and index scale system. In the experiment, we use the parallel coordinate system and the bar chart to show the index and evaluation results, contrast and analysis the results.

articleTitle: Architecture of remote vital signs acquisition based — GPS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper a architecture of real-time remote life monitoring system based on the GPS is presented. The system architecture consists of ARM, vital signs monitoring module, GPS and GSM wireless communication module; it can be applied to long-distance medical treatment, exploring trends of potential chronic diseases and communicate illness, and urgent situations informing for sudden diseases.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm and its application in node numbering optimization in FEM
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: By comparing the commonness between Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and node numbering problem, full permutation coding scheme of chromosome in nodes numbering optimization is proposed. Fitness function of each chromosome is established considering corresponding relations between nodes number and row-column value of coefficient matrix. Crossover operator of genetic population adopts improved order-crossover method. Mutation operator works adaptively by using evolutional reversed operator in which chromosome mutates upwardly. Selection operator, which combines the Roulette wheel approach and elitist model, creates a new generation including the optimal chromosome within parent generation and random backup chromosomes within filial generation so as to ensure the overall astringency of genetic search as well as the diversity of generation. At last, an example using the suggested method has proved that the genetic algorithm in node numbering optimization works effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: Information system evaluation model study of manufacturing enterprise
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of manufacturing enterprise information evaluation, an evaluation method is established in this paper. Firstly, this paper describes the complexity of information system evaluation and summarizes manufacturing enterprise information system evaluation index system. By using Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to determine index weights and then using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to establish manufacturing enterprise information system evaluation model. Finally, this paper use the model to evaluate two manufacturing enterprises in Guangxi province, the case studies prove the rationality and scientificity of the model.

articleTitle: Modern information technology and education informationization
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper summarized the basic characteristics of information, the basic content and key elements of information technology. It expounds the influence of the application of modern information technology in the field of education on education - education informationization. It further expounded the connotation of education informationization and analyzed the characteristics of education informationization from the aspects of technology and education. It also discussed the great changes on education brought by information technology and the reformation of education model in the circumstance of information technology.

articleTitle: A novel plastic optical fiber heating furnace for plastic optical fiber drawing tower
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the design of heating furnace with gradient temperature distribution for plastic optical fiber drawing tower. The heating furnace is of cylinder profile, and can be divided into five layers from outside to inside, that is, the shell layer, insulation layer, heating silk layer, buffer layer, and drawing layer. The furnace is equipped with three groups of temperature sensors, three groups of protection device, and gas ventilation furnace cover up and down. We also provide a special furnace heating design, which can provide a greater degree of increasing the stability of the optical fiber drawing and size control of optical fibers. The proposed design provides an ideal solution for the small size plastic communication optical fiber.

articleTitle: Data source simulation for Command Information System based on RTI
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of simulation entity limit and time delay in the Command Information System simulation, a design of federation member technology based data source frame is introduced. By using the new application frame, the efficiency of the simulation system and the utilization rate of resources are improved.

articleTitle: Dynamic-static analysis of sheet-transfer mechanism for high-speed offset press
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Reasonable design for sheet-transfer mechanism of high-speed offset press is very important for transferring sheet accurately and ensuring topping print precision. On the condition that known the motion law of each member in the mechanism, dynamic-static analysis of the mechanism can be done based on D'Alembert principle. The parameters including forces of each hinge joint point and torque have been gotten by establishing dynamic static equations. The result by anlysis and comparison shows the dynamic performance of mechanism can meet technological process demands in high-speed.

articleTitle: Voltage-mode multifunction biquadratic filter with single input and five outputs
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a new tunable voltage-mode multifunction biquadratic filter with single input and five outputs is presented. The proposed configuration is very simple, consisting of one plus-type single-output differential difference current conveyor (DDCC), one plus-type dual-output inverting second-generation current conveyor (DO-ICCII), three resistors and two grounded capacitors. The use of grounded capacitors is particularly attractive for integrated circuit implementation. The filter can simultaneously realize bandreject, highpass, lowpass and two bandpass filtering responses with single input and five outputs. It permits orthogonal controllability of the quality factor and resonance angular frequency, and no component matching conditions or inverting-type input voltage signals are imposed. All the passive and active sensitivities are low. HSPICE and MATLAB simulations results are provided to demonstrate the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: The design and research of the ubiquitous learning model in the digital campus
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In recent years, our country has promoted the principle of construction of learning-oriented society. Ubiquitous learning is exactly echoing this theme. However, Ubiquitous learning has not successfully realized in colleges and university learning environments for lack of high-technology and short of finance. Based on this point, this paper analyzed u-learning logical model in the digital campus environment and put forward the optimized hardware model. We also come up with a feasible program for the colleges and universities focus on the u-learning.

articleTitle: Personnel agent system analysis of the pros and cons of personnel management in university
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Change traditional employment practices of personnel agency system in university, and achieve an important measure of rational allocation of human resources. The problems of college personnel agent system more comprehensive thinking, rational solutions, designed to enable personnel agency system in colleges and universities play an active role in the implementation of the strategy of the talented personnel to promote the optimal allocation of university human resources.

articleTitle: Evaluation of AS/RS based on evidence theory and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of AS/RS system, the evaluation index system of AS/RS system is established from the system of economy, stability, technicality and speed, sociality and safety. Based on the index system, evaluation model is established for AS/RS system combining the BP neural network and evidence theory. In this method, the normalized warehouse data as input of BP neural network, through the different parameters of the neural network training the output value has been obtain. Using D-S evidence theory synthesis rules for the output value, evaluation result has been obtained. The method solves the output instability of a single BP neural network and overcame the evidence theory subjectivity through the expert knowledge to determine the evidence, improved the credibility of the evaluation results. Using the evaluation model do an empirical analysis of four AS/RS, the result has shown the feasibility and effectiveness of the model in the AS/RS system.

articleTitle: Investigation on cross-over experiment curriculum
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With development of campus education, traditional ways of experimental teaching need reform. This article exemplifies different types experimental curriculums crossing over problem with Zhejiang University City College, putting forward feasibility to cross experimental curriculums over between all levels. The article also covers how and why to construct cross-over experimental curriculums, improving system reform of experimental curriculum.

articleTitle: Research on image processing algorithm of posture correction of bending larvae
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the process of on-line hazard larva recognition, larvae often appear in bending posture, which makes the extracted feature vectors distorted and affects the recognition results. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an image processing algorithm based on sector-shaped transform to correct the bending posture and improve the larva recognition rate. Firstly, bending larvae are segmented in order to determine the bending region and nonbending region after image thinning, linear fitting and circle fitting. The bending region is corrected to straight line by sector-shaped transform; and the nonbending region and the bending region that has been processed by rotation, translation and sector-shaped transform are combined to form a complete larva. Finally the eight-neighborhood mean method is used to calculate the pixels of gaps in the combined larva. Euclidean distances of seven feature vectors based on moment invariants before and after the posture correction and the standard posture show that the algorithm can greatly improve the similarity of feature vectors between larvae of bending posture and standard posture.

articleTitle: A dynamic trust model for semi-distributed mobile P2P networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As the existing trust model is not suitable for the semi-distributed mobile P2P network, a dynamic trust model based on super node SDTM is presented. Trust relation is categorized into two kinds: ordinary node and ordinary node, super node and super node, and each solution for the two kinds is put forward. Meanwhile, SDTM solves the problem of the ordinary node dishonest feedback using direct trust tree of super-node. The simulation result shows, SDTM can effectively deal with the dishonest feedback of network attacks over the existing trust models, and legitimate nodes have a higher success request rate.

articleTitle: College music professional vocal teaching methods
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Vocal professional courses for colleges and universities of music education in accordance with culture of the needs of music educators set the basis for development of arts education in primary and secondary schools, is the key to deter mining the quality of arts education. In this paper, the vocal music education, for example to explore the methods of the higher music education.

articleTitle: Research of the regional character of vernacular dwellings in south of Shaan'xi
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper studies the regional character of the traditional dwellings in the south of Shaan'xi, analysis its type of the yards, architectural forms and space, building techniques, architectural decoration and styles, points out that these regional character should be inherited in the renewing and reconstruction of the village.

articleTitle: Information flow integrated optimization model of projects construction process
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The main reasons for delay and overinvestment in construction projects are the unsmooth information flow. According to the project construction process, information flow of construction project is defined, and its model is constructed. Information flow model as the core content of information, combine the information resources, regulate the engineering project management process. Through the integrated optimization model of project construction process, using information management technology and computer and network technology, the interaction of information flow and material flow during the project are analyzed by project process model construction. Wireless system of construction site is constructed using wireless network and equipment. It allows staff and equipment to share information at real time, thus to optimize information flow of construction project. Accelerating flows of information, reduce the cost, improve the owner ability to the decision and control, and the level of management of construction projects.

articleTitle: The design of coder and decoder based on ISO18000–4
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article analyzes the coding and the decoding technology specifications of the 2.45GHz RFID system with the ISO18000–4 protocol, and designs the Manchester coder and the FM0 decoder according to the protocol. The experiment results have proved that the design can be implemented by the FPGA, with the XILINX ISE software and FPGA device support for the simulation and synthesis.

articleTitle: The construction and realization of the ubiquitous learning environment in the campus
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: As an rising study model, ubiquitous learning is extensively efficient and advanced. Comparing to the developed countries, China's U-learning study lies in the low level and cannot provide efficient service to the whole society. The realization of U-learning environment in the campus can improve students' study ability and efficiency. It also guarantees education's quality and scientific level. In a word, constructing the U-learning environment in the campus is full of necessary and significant.

articleTitle: The determination of reasonable plate's slope on push-extend multi-under-reamed pile
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper analyzes the elasticity-plasticity of the push-extend multi-under-reamed pile in use of finite element method theory by ANSYS. lt takes three common slopes of push-extend multi-under-reamed piles to study the regularity, which are in the same environment and dimension except for slope. It introduces the realative theory to make the anlysis much more accuracy. The regularity is analyzed which is taken by the software of ANSYS to summarize and can get the reasonable plate's slope to analyze the bearing capacity of push-extend multi-under-reamed pile precisely.

articleTitle: Cultivation and guarantee of core competition ability in local small-medium construction firms
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of the reform and opening and the market economy in our country, numerous domestic local small-medium construction enterprises got many development opportunities and faced many competition challenges which never appeared before. For local small-medium construction firms, they should cultivate the core competition ability if they are sure to win wider space for survival and development. Facing these development opportunities and competition challenges, they should not only set a novel principle of management, but also involve special operation and coordination competition and constantly absorb development powers from innovation. For the local government and administrative departments, they must take many steps to service the local small-medium construction firms with the cultivation and guarantee of core competition ability. Basing on the investigation on the local small-medium construction firms in Huaian, this paper found that the core competition ability was a strategic choice of local small-medium firms, explored how to cultivate core competition ability and how to guarantee the core competition ability of firms. The conclusions in this paper can provide those decision-markers in local small-medium construction firms and those local administrative departments with some good advice.

articleTitle: Effects analysis of I/Q imbalance on the multi-antenna receiving systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper we present the effects analysis of the imperfections for practical high speed wireless multi-antenna transceiving systems. Some integration expressions are derived for evaluation when the effects of in-phase/quadrature(I/Q) imbalance is concerned. Several simulation results shown subsequently demonstrate that the existence of these imperfections brings an even bigger problem than in their traditional single antenna counterparts. All the work provides a theoretical foundation of the practical multi-antenna wireless communication systems for engineers and designers.

articleTitle: Experiment study for simulation tracking of coarse pointing subsystem
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is known that the free-space optical communication is one of the most promising communications, and the ATP system especially coarse pointing subsystem is the key to construction and maintain of the communication link. To our knowledge, only few experimental experience for coarse pointing subsystem exists today especially with respect to communication construct in cities. Therefore, an experiment system for coarse tracking system simulation for free-space optical communication between buildings is set up. The control strategy adopted in the coarse pointing subsystem is described and some experiment with different simulation speed under constructed system has been done. The result shows that control accuracy is several hundreds of microradian and can meet the system requirement. Standard deviation for tracking error of X-axis increases with the increase of simulation speed, but has no order for Y-axis.

articleTitle: Study on the fabrication and mechanical property of silicon particle reinforced Zinc-based composites
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The silicon particle reinforced Zinc-based composites was fabricated using gravity casting technique with sodium salt as modifier. The microstructure and mechanical properties of silicon particle reinforced Zinc-based composites was studied by the metallurgical microscope, scanning electron microscope (SEM), impact toughness test, flowability test and hardness testing in this work. The results show that the fabrication technique of silicon particle reinforced Zinc-based composites with fine silicon particle distributed uniformly can be obtained; and with the increase of Silicon content in the alloy the hardness of the alloy increases, the impact toughness of the alloy decreases; and with the increase of Silicon content in the alloy the flowability of the high aluminum Zinc based alloys which contains Silicon decreases, and the wear resistance of ZA40-4.5%Si composite is better than that composites in all test conditions.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of Electronic Medical Records Editing System based on CDA
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is difficult to exchange information between heterogeneous Hospital Information Systems (HIS). It becomes the obstacle of regional medical system establishment. The coming forth of HL7 (Health Level 7) CDA (Clinical Document Architecture) standard provides the technical basic conditions. This paper describes CDA standards and CDA document structure. Through a complete analysis of Electronic Medical Record (EMR), the model of Electronic Medical Records Editing Subsystem is given. Based on this model, functional modules of Electronic Medical Records Editing Subsystem are designed and implemented. Through Electronic Medical Records Editing Subsystem, clinical documents can effectively produce, parse, validate and view. It provides a technical support for exchanges of medical and health information.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact on the dish centrifugal separator's drum stress of rotary drum parameters
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper took the rotary drum of the dish centrifugal separator as the study object. First of all, software ANSYS was used to set up Finite element model of the drum, and then the main parameters which affect rotary drum stress and strain were analyzed. The results showed that the maximum value of F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">W</sub> + F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub>, F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">W</sub> and F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> were proportional to the speed and the square of the radius. With the drum wall thickness increased, the maximum value of FW + FC were decreased. The drum Height had little impact on the drum total stress. The present study suggested that the analytical method put forward in this paper was feasible, for it improved the design efficiency and quality, moreover, it provided important theoretical basis for the design of the drum.

articleTitle: Existence and global exponential stability of anti-periodic solution of higher-order recurrent neural networks with distributed delays and impulse on time scales
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: By using the continuation theorem of coincidence degree theory, M-matrix theory and constructing some suitable Lyapunov functions, some sufficient conditions are obtained for the existence and global exponential stability of anti-periodic solutions of higher-order recurrent type neural networks with distributed delays and impulses on time scales without assuming the boundedness of the activation functions f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub>, g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub>.

articleTitle: Analysis of the port sailing safety based on SEM
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Clarifying the interrelation of factors that influence the port navigation security can be of great help in ensuring it. This paper, by setting up security factor-related structural equation model path diagram, and solve it to get the influence coefficient. In this way, we know to what extent they influence port navigation security, thus dealing with hidden variables that cannot be worked out any other way.

articleTitle: Low-complexity distributed routing algorithm in wireless sensor networks with power control for QoS improvement
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Low-complexity joint power allocation and route planning algorithm for multiple antennas wireless sensor networks (WSN) is introduced in this paper. The Quality-of-Service (QoS) aware packet forwarding problem is cast into the framework of dynamic programming, such that adaptive power allocation can be jointly realized at each hop. State space partition techniques and state aggregation approximation architecture are introduced to derive the value function. In order to reduce the computational complexity, we present a sub-optimal routing protocol by performing the route planing and power allocation separately. Simulation results indicate that the proposed protocols significantly outperform classical routing algorithms.

articleTitle: A case study of application specific NoC design
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Network-on-chip (NoC) is emerging as an effective architecture which address the shortcomings of traditional bus-based System-on-chip (SoC). NoC has been under investigation for several years and many different architecture and various protocols have been proposed. However, compared to the general-purpose NoC, the methodology to design application specific NoC provides greater practical insight. In this paper, we present the design process of application specific NoC. According to this design flow, we design a 4×4 2D mesh platform and give the result of the specific NoC mapped with a OFDM receiver application.

articleTitle: Construction of the engineering experimental teaching system for remote education based on the model analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Modern remote education engineering experimental teaching is an important way to cultivate talents with applied competence. The implementation of the experimental teaching should be constructed as a complete system, and the thinking principle of the resource design as well the basic framework of this construction should be more systemic and pertinence. In this paper, the model is constructed based on the relationships of all the factors influencing the experimental learning system. The optimization analysis of the model objective is made according to the influence of each factor on the model objective. Combined with the results of the optimization analysis, a better engineering experimental teaching system for remote education which is more suitable for the learning of the continuing education students can be constructed.

articleTitle: Fast surge suppression by inserting an AlGaN/GaN-based varactor
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this report, a metal-semiconductor-metal varactor diodes on top of an AlGaN/GaN-based epitaxial structure is proposed to the fast surge protection application. The fabricated device's capacitance-voltage (C-V) property and surge immunity are presented. In addition, to verify its capability for slow and fast surge absorption, three protection configurations; the gas discharge arrestor (GDA) only, in a state-of-the-art surge protection circuit, and the proposed circuit with AlGaN/GaN-based varactor were all under the system-level lightning and Electrostatic Discharge surge tests. The measured results show that the proposed fast surge protection circuit can suppress a fast intrusive pulse (FIP) voltage of 4000 V to 360 V, a reduction of 91%; whereas that suppresses to 1780 V only, a reduction of 55%, by using a traditional GDA only.

articleTitle: A method for sorting out the spam from Chinese product reviews
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper conducts a research on the spam detection in the field of Chinese product reviews. As to useless reviews, the paper uses four important classification features based on questions, hyperlinks and so on to characterize reviews, and then adopts the classification method based on the Logistic regression to detect the useless reviews. As to those untruthful reviews, firstly 2-gram model is proposed to characterize reviews with the consideration of the word order, then the Katz smoothing method is adopted to smooth the model, and lastly the KL divergence is added to detect the untruthful reviews. The experiments have illustrated that those methods put forward in this paper can effectively detect the spam in the field of Chinese product reviews.

articleTitle: Research on the successful case of the reform practice of college English teachers under the network environment
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Research focuses on the reform of College English in the network environment. We explored 150 non-English major students through the reform practice. The results and findings indicate the success of the reform. It helps to facilitate the students' language proficiency and develop the motivation in their process of learning English.

articleTitle: Based on semi-fuzzy c-means clustering BIT fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A semi-fuzzy c-means algorithm based on revised Euclidean distance was proposed to improve the real-time capability and precision in fault pattern classified. Effectiveness of threshold parameters on clustering was investigated, and then program steps were given. The example of fault diagnosis in an airborne fire control system BIT was developed. The results show that the new algorithm can recognize fault pattern adaptively and precisely.

articleTitle: Research on Jiaozuo Chrysanthemum of Chinese herbal medicine of comparative advantages and spatial distribution in Jiaozuo city
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Using the method of improved comprehensive comparative advantage index, this paper analyzes the comparative advantage of Chrysanthemum areas in Jiaozuo City, and the areas are expressed in the map by GIS software. The results show that there are significant regional differences among Chrysanthemum production, and the townships of production advantages are mainly located in the central and southern parts of Jiaozuo City. According to the principle of comparative advantage, it is suggested that Chrysanthemum growing areas of the towns be adjusted, and the rational distribution and specialized production for the Chrysanthemum production be implemented. At last, the reasonable measures and suggestions for the Chrysanthemum development are proposed.

articleTitle: Design of Web-based environmental information system for K-12 schools
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With global warming and pollution issues become more and more serious around the world, environmental education has been looked as an important instructional activity in K-12 education in many countries. The purpose of the study is to introduce a prototype of a Web-based Campus Environmental Information System (CEIS) designed for K-12 schools. The proposed system consists of several campus environmental information collection stations and related network platform software. Via the Internet, the system can automatically collect real-time campus environmental information, such as temperature, humidity, noise, air quality, and etc. Collected data could be used for environmental information query, educational services and informal learning activities such as online supported environment exploration, collaborative learning for K-12 schools. This system could not only serve people's daily life, but also effectively promote the scientific inquiry ability of K-12 students.

articleTitle: The reviewing about culture of city sights in Nanning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nanning has built the city near 1700 years, was called the “Yongzhou”. Along the city building is the city sights, especial the “Eight sights in Yongzhou”. From ancient city landscape, we can easily understand to the historical and cultural characteristics of the city, and the evolution of urban space. Historical landscape culture is another coordinate system, can provide the more spiritual life of the traditional culture connotation.

articleTitle: Reflections on teaching of complex function and integral transformation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: “Complex function and integral transformation” is an important professional foundation course. Integrated into the history of mathematics in teaching in colleges and universities have an important meaning, contributed both to students' understanding of the mathematical knowledge, and improving students' ability to solve problems, but due to time reasons, integraling the history of mathematics into college mathematics course is difficult to achieve. Authors explore from the combination of mathematics history and the course, the way of students learn the history of mathematics and so on.

articleTitle: An audio digital watermarking algorithm based on wavelet for air channel
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Using technology of wavelet decomposition and energy calculation, an audio digital watermarking algorithm was proposed. The proposed algorithm chooses mid-frequency wavelet coefficients to calculate the energy. Through the method of energy's comparison and adjustment, the watermarking information and synchronization signal were embedded into the original audio carrier with large capacity. Experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm has a good hidden effect and an excellent robustness. Furthermore, it can be applied into air-channel transmission situation with low bit error ratio.

articleTitle: Application of FFT in frequency domain characteristics test system for ultrasonic flaw detector
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To test the frequency domain characteristics of ultrasonic flaw detector, this paper designs a test system which based on the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm and VC++ platform. After sampling the time domain waveform of launching and the receiving amplifier of ultrasonic flaw detector, amplitude spectra of frequency domain was got through the C++ program which had a core of fast Fourier transform (FFT) processing discrete data. Then the system obtained the characterization parameters (center frequency and bandwidth) of the output pulse frequency of ultrasonic flaw detector's launching amplifiers and the frequency response of ultrasonic flaw detector's receiving amplifier. At the same time, test interface of the detector frequency domain characteristics parameter was designed with VC++ platform. Experiments results showed that the system had the capability to quickly and accurately test the frequency domain characteristics of ultrasonic flaw detector, and visually displayed them.

articleTitle: Researchof reinforced concrete deck arch bridge detection technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of China's transport, bridge is playing an increasingly important role in economic development and has become a link, In view of the current situation ofbridge construction, this paper expounds the importance of static dynamicload test of bridge. Combined with the engineering example, static load test introduced the content and method of data processing and the line. In the bridge technology condition assessment are given for the normal operation of the bridge to provide reliable experimental data.

articleTitle: Digital learning environment on the impact and countermeasures of scientific research team
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the development of information technology, digital information resources has become increasingly obvious trend, digital information resource has become the key strategic resource of development of human society, especially since the new century, informatization construction effect is distinct. In the worldwide network environment, digital research environment for learning provides more flexible, more convenient, and more capacious platform for the development of building and running for scientific research team. In order to clarify the effect of scientific research team, to grasp the scientific research team of the future development of the basic situation, it is important for universitise to draw on the advantages and avoid disadvantages to the use of new technology in construction of new period.

articleTitle: Analysis of non-English majors' motivation in autonomous learning via the Internet
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Research focuses on the survey of 55 non-English major students' autonomous learning via the Internet. The paper attempts to find out the students' motivation in English learning.

articleTitle: Design of an energy-saving routing protocol in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper takes energy-saving into consideration, basing on typical clustering routing protocol and combining with the optimal cluster-head selection formula, the improved threshold formula and cluster radios formulas to choose cluster-heads. Applying the proportionality principle to the forming stage of cluster to make the distribution of cluster even more reasonable; during the stable stage of cluster, the member nodes in cluster use TDMA to communicate with the cluster-head node, and cluster-head nodes communicate with base station BS via multi-hop interrupt communication manner.

articleTitle: Study on user experience influencing factors of online Guangdong pavilion in Shanghai World Expo
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The influencing factors on Web 3D User Experience are studied for online Guangdong pavilion in Shanghai World Expo with grounded theory method. We discover the four influencing factors as follow: web site quality, external environmental factor, user internal factor and recommendation, and the influencing factor model of Web 3D user experience is tried to established.

Author Keywords: Online Guangdong Pavilion in Shanghai World Expo

articleTitle: Study on auto panel dies cost accounting system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cost accounting plays an important role in a manufacturing organization. A cost accounting system is the application of accounting and costing principles methods and techniques in the ascertainment of costs and the analysis of savings and/or excess as compared with previous experience or with standards. The processes of manufacturing auto panel dies are very complex and the production cycles are very long. As a result, accounting the cost is very complicated. The cost composition and the cost accounting model are studied. The architectures of cost accounting system are proposed. An auto motor dies cost accounting system is developed and applied in an auto die and mould company. It is demonstrated that the system can achieve accurately and quickly cost accounting, and provide a reliable foundation for making cost strategy.

articleTitle: A novel matting algorithm applied to SAS image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Poisson' equation has been used to mat in digital image widely, but there is less report using it in acoustic image, such as SAS image. We proposed a novel matting algorithm of Poisson' equation applied to SAS image, in the proposed algorithm, the statistics of image were studied firstly and then Markov Random Field (MRF) theory was applied to initialized the image which can mark the interest regions, at last Poisson' equation is used to mat in the region. The simulation results have proved the new algorithm could be used in the real SAS images.

articleTitle: Short-range wireless communication based on AVR microcontroller: Remote control system of aircraft model for example
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of the network and the communication technologies, the demand for wireless communication is increasing. In recent years, short-range wireless communication had a rapid development and application in all aspects because of its advantages. This paper, as the aircraft model' remote control system for a example, briefly introduced how to achieve short-range wireless communication based on AVR microcontroller. In addition, in this design, to get a longer transmission distance, we design a RF module.

articleTitle: CIEMA: A configurable integrated enterprise model architecture
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In current enterprise modeling field research, the model structure and modeling tools are generally limited to a specific modeling theory that is not flexible, so it is hard to meet the modeling requirements of different industries. This paper proposes a CIEMA (Configurable Integrated Enterprise Model Architecture), wherein we use a model configurable file that is independent from the business system to abstractly express model structure, thereby supporting the extensibility and configuration of different modeling methods. First, we propose a formal representation of CIEMA's basic elements and construct CIEMA's hierarchical structure; then, we use XML to design configurable file and its corresponding mapping method, thereby supporting the development of an executable system; finally, through the realization and application of the modeling platform to verify CIEMA's extensibility, we achieve configurability and good performance.

articleTitle: Design of a dynamic frequency compensation low dropout voltage regulator with buffer impedance attenuation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a low-drop (LDO) linear regulator with buffer impedance attenuation (BIA) for frequency compensation. This novel proposed LDO take advantage of the dynamically-biased shunt feedback in the buffer stage, which could lower its output resistance for driving the pass device to achieve fast response. Implemented in 0.35μm CMOS process, the LDO dissipates 184μA quiescent current and is able to deliver up to 100mA load current. With a 2.3μF output capacitance, the maximum transient-output variation is 25mV with full-load step change of 100mA. The proposed circuit will find application in the battery-powered portable devices.

articleTitle: The improvement of caching strategies about unstructured P2P system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Improving cache replacement strategies is an important way to enhance the performance of network. As the lack of cache replacement strategies about P2P systems, the author proposes the corresponding improvement measures and designs a new cache replacement strategy - MFU (Most Frequently Used). This algorithm aims to achieve high-degree peers to delete popular contents and low-degree ones hold popular contents by setting threshold properly, thus reducing the maximum load of peers. And then, using Gnutella system as network model, the author compares MFU with LRU, LFU and ARP through simulation experiment to prove the advantage of hit rate and load balancing about MFU.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for calibrate in building survey
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new building survey based on laser and pan is proposed, how to calibrate the scanning device be the key factor in this system. We proposed a algorithm which use a serial of reference points to get the actual position. Through the experiment, scanning result can meet the request of survey.

articleTitle: Research on the mode design of writing teaching in college based on modern information technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The application of wrtiting teaching in the technology of modern information tends to involve in the stimulated and imaginary “electronic disease”, which is against the cultivation of college students' professionalism. Therefore, the teaching design should be characterized by the integration of theory and practice, of uniformity and diversity and of out-school activities and in-school training so as to enhance the cucciculum integration and benefit the students' life as well as their writing. Thus, the author of this article utilizes the internet teaching environment, and attemts to adopt the writing teaching mode design of Cognitive Apprenticeship in the in-class training, the Corporation system and the BTEC Module in the out-class activities in order to reach the promotion of students' professionalism and writing in an all-round way.

articleTitle: LMM based blind signal separation with hybrid sampling
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Laplace Mixture Model (LMM) is used to characterize the distribution of observed data. The stationary distribution of the model parameters is obtained by the hybrid of Gibbs and Metropolis-Hastings sampling, by which the mixing matrix is further estimated. With the mixing matrix estimated, we separate the sources successfully. Simulation results show that the method proposed is very robust to initial values and performs better than traditional methods, at the same time the method does not need large calculation amount.

articleTitle: Approaches to the development of online measurement and evaluation system: Structure, strategy, and technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Online measurement and evaluation system is a complex integration, which include question database, paper management, test management, paper revising, result analysis. In structure, strategy, and technology, this article provide useful approaches to the development of the complex system.

articleTitle: Learning adaptability to the web-based English learning mode from educational ecology perspective
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the theory of educational ecology and quantitative and qualitative research methods, this thesis investigates and analyses non-English major students' learning adaptability in the web-based language learning environment, expecting to bring unprecedented interpretations and suggestions to learners' learning adaptive problems emerged in the new teaching mode from the ecological prospective.

articleTitle: The SOPC implementation of a keyword spotting algorithm based on biomimetic pattern recognition
