publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A keyword spotting algorithm based on biomimetic pattern recognition is proposed in this paper, including the modeling algorithm and the recognition algoithm. Then the SOPC implementation of the algorithm is given using software and hardware co-design mothodology. The design of two hardware acceleration units are discussed in detail in this paper as well as their contribution to system performance in term of speed. Practical test indicates that this design fully makes use of the characteristic of FPGA and the algorithm proposed, enabling the keyword spotting system implemented to run fast and in real time.

articleTitle: Using content analysis to analyze the trend of information technology toward the academic researchers at the design departments of universities in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Most graduate students and researchers focus their researcher on each kind of the commercial product design at the design departments of universities in Taiwan. Their research-domains are not restricted in few domains generally. But the information technology (IT) has became the popular industries in Taiwan recently, the more and more researches have been found to be concerned with the IT-related topics and developments in the departments of fine art and design. As mentioned problems above, this study wishes to explore the researching issues and analyze the trend of the design departments. The study uses the content analysis (CA) methodology to collect the thesis of National Central Library in Taiwan and classifies the researching-issues judged by the paper-title content. The judgments of the paper-title according to the original, IT-involved, IT-extended, IT-system and IT-related have classified into five catalogs. The goals of the study hope to find the increasing or decreasing of the academic researches toward the IT-related issues. This study uses the content analysis (CA) to analyze those academic-research trends to offer the summary reports finally.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid localization system combining hexagon-based algorithm with mobile anchor
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Localization is an important process in deploying ad-hoc wireless sensor networks. Several localization algorithms have been developed. However, they do not achieve satisfactory performance on irregular networks. In this paper, we present a localization algorithm based on an idea of growing local maps. This paper presents an ongoing work on a localization mechanism applied to wireless sensor networks. This mechanism can cooperate with hexagon method and trilateration and dynamic robot node to estimate the coordinates of some unknown nodes. It can estimate the sensor nodes that have no GPS with some other nodes that have GPS devices. Thereafter, we can obtain more unknown nodes with some estimated nodes. It decreases the cost that localization tracking of wireless sensor devices.

articleTitle: A novel algorithm for interference temperature estimation of cognition domain
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on the concept of interference temperature, a novel interference temperature estimation algorithm for cognitive domain, which integrates adaptive line enhancement with multi-taper spectrum estimation and singular value decomposition, is presented with detailed description in this paper. The algorithm provides the reference for communication access, avoidance and power control of cognitive radio subscribers. The performance of the algorithm is analyzed and compared by simulation according to the practical requirement of cognitive radio. The result shows that the proposed algorithm has higher probability.

articleTitle: Research on map-positioning technology based on W3C Geolocation API
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is a severe situation for the traditional Geolocation web applications to collect GIS data based on user IP addresses, WiFi APs, GSM&CDMA stations or GPS in a sustained and stable way. Meanwhile, the GIS data acquired in the traditional way must be transformed to coordinates to locate the client's position based on client-side Java-scripts analysis, and that needs connecting to exclusive database to query user's location information, which requires certain professional knowledge of GIS for developers. The Geolocation API is an interface used to perceive geo-spatial location of the client device designed by W3C and can easily seamlessly archive web client's location integrated with HTML5. This paper researches the key technologies of how to get the map positioning of WebGIS using W3C Geolocation APIs based on HTML5 specification, and it has been implemented a distribution and aggregation model of social network members.

articleTitle: An application of computer-assisted language teaching in college English teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The development and improvement of computer hardware and software technology brings a new opportunity for foreign language teaching reform. The application of computer-assisted language teaching in college English has unparalleled advantages, which greatly enhance the initiative and enthusiasm of students in learning a foreign language. However, everything can be double-edged. As a result, we must realize its limitations and take appropriate countermeasures.

articleTitle: The application of simulated training software in international trade course
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Simulation training software in international trade course is to help students understand and master the basic procedures for import and export transactions. This paper is to present the strength and weakness of simulation training software using TMT software as the example. Simulation Training software combined with the internet, video resource and real business office together enhance the negotiation, analytical, operation, and risk-prevention capacities of students.

articleTitle: A universal synchronization algorithm of joint timing — Carrier in all digital receivers
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A universal synchronization algorithm of joint timing-carrier is presented in this letter. This algorithm performs pre-rotation before timing adjustment, pre-rotation of sampling data is finished by using estimated phase difference. Timing adjustment is finished by modified Gardner algorithm. This algorithm is universal, which can be used in most of modulation systems, including QPSK, OQPSK, GMSK etc. The performance of the proposed algorithm is very close to the theoretical curve.

articleTitle: Cause analysis and preventive measures of the disease of embankment in the loess regions
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on an extensive survey of the disease of embankment in the loess regions, this paper first analyzes its causes, and then proposes some reasonable and effective preventive measures in design and construction according to the special characteristics of loess and the embankment. These measures can effectively reduce or avoid the occurrence of the disease of embankment, thus providing a reference for its prevention in the loess regions.

articleTitle: Floating-point error and its effect analysis of digital pre-distortion
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The power amplifier of the radio repeater often works in the nonlinear regime to improve its efficiency, which will not only cause a lower SNR and mutual interference between the channels, but also increase the error rate of the signals transmitted in their own channels. This paper utilizes the pre-distortion technology to solve the problem and applies the QRD_RLS self-adaptive algorithm to realize the DPD in FPGA. The data truncation errors in FPGA are operated and stored by a finite floating point. Based on results of DPD, the rise of baseline is analyzed in this paper. This paper proves that error is the leading cause to the rise of baseline. Moreover, the errors caused by the truncate operation are discussed, and the method of reducing truncation errors is also demonstrated. After optimization, the SNR of the circuit grows more than 35 dB, the ACPR improves 20 dB and the influence of errors is limited to merely 3dB.

articleTitle: Suitable BSS algorithm for separating carrier modulation and LFM signals
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Our goal is to find a suitable BSS(Blind Source Separation) algorithm to separate the mixed radar signals when the sources are modulated with the same type such as carrier modulation and LFM. It is especially a difficult case if their modulation parameters are similar. In this paper, we select six BSS algorithms, FastICA, SOBI-RO, JADE, TFBSS, RADICAL and Kernel ICA to deal with this problem and obtain our experimental conclusion. Then we propose a novel method to improve the performance. The simulation results show that the method is effective to get better performance compared to the existing algorithms particularly in the low SNR cases.

articleTitle: Study on the design and implementation of a centralized optical remote monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The development of the computer technology and network communication technology promoted the development and innovation of remote monitoring technology. This paper designs a centralized Optical remote monitoring system which is based on TCP/IP protocol and acts the Internet as a communication channel. At the same time, it analyzes the application of the system. The results show that the monitoring system for remote monitoring technology which is based on the web has obvious advantages in real-time, scalable, multi-client data transfer.

articleTitle: Effect of ventilation holes and their structures on air drag and heat dissipation of steel wheel
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The air drag and the heat dissipation of two steel wheels were simulated by heat-structure coupling method. The effects of ventilation holes and their structures on air drag, air drag moment and the maximum temperature of brake disc and rim were studied. The numerical method to calculate the flow field was validated by experimental results. The study shows that, the differences of air drag and air drag moment between the prototype and the modified wheel can be neglected and the air drag and the air drag moment of both structures change little with time. The maximum temperatures and the average temperatures of brake discs in both wheels fall with time and the maximum disc temperature of modified wheel falls more slowly. The maximum rim temperatures of both wheels rise with time and the modified wheel rises more slowly. These results indicate that the aging of tire can be slow down by modifying the structures of the ventilation holes.

articleTitle: A blind separation algorithm of speech mixtures base on time-frequency masking
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on Technology of Time-Frequency Masking, we raise a blind separation algorithm of speech mixtures, which can be used for separating any number of source using only two mixtures. The method is valid when sources are satisfying W-disjoint orthogonal, that is, when the supports of the windowed Fourier transform of the signals in mixture are disjoint. In time-frequency domain, Performance is compared for floating-point and fixed-point implementations. A Weighted K-means clustering algorithm is presented as an alternative to gradient descent methods for peak tracking and demonstrated to achieve excellent performance without adversely affecting computational load. extract the spatial cues of speech signal, which are relative attenuation-delay pairs, then Motivated by the maximum likelihood mixing parameter estimators, we define a power weighted two-dimensional (2-D) histogram constructed from the ratio of the time-frequency representations of the mixtures that is shown to have one peak for each source with peak location corresponding to the relative attenuation and delay mixing parameters. Then, mark the time-frequency binary masking and using this technique separate the source in time-frequency domain. Finally, I-STFT is used to transform the separated source back to time domain and separated the signal. In a word, the proposed algorithm will give a new prospect to the research of blind separation of speech.

articleTitle: Research on the cascading failure of scale-free networks based-on the coupling coefficient
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper researches the issues of cascading failure when scale-free networks based-on the coupling coefficient experience the random attacks and intentional attacks. Based on the Node Dynamic Model, follow the principle of that the load on the collapse nodes must be re-distributing locally and preferred, compared the global cascading failure phenomenon under the two attack strategies of the extended scale-free network relative to the typical model of scale-free networks, and explored the effectiveness of the two different attack strategies. Numerical simulation indicating that when the adjustable parameters between a certain value in this model, the attack on the smallest node in the network moderate than the largest node in the network attacks to more easily lead to cascading failure, the extended network has been more robust.

articleTitle: The dynamic stiffness analysis of extensible inclined taut cables
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The linear dynamic behaviors of an extensible sagging inclined cable are investigated. An improved dynamic stiffness matrix for a cable element is derived. The coupling between the tangential and normal displacements, the weight component parallel to the cable chord and the viscous damping are taken into account. All dynamic stiffness coefficients are derived from more general asymptotic solution of the motion equation in the natural vibration. Example calculations are discussed to demonstrate the efficiency of the current method. Since the dynamic stiffness matrix has direct relation with the natural frequency of vibration, it can be used to calculate the natural frequencies and mode shapes of the prestressed cable network and cable-stayed structures through a summation process the same as the conventional finite element method.

articleTitle: Objects detecting and tracking with a new particle filter
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Robust real-time tracking of non-rigid objects is a challenging task. Particle filtering has proven successfully for non-linear and non-Gaussian estimation problems. The article presents the integration of mean shift vector of the moving object into particle filtering. Color distributions are applied as they are robust to partial occlusion, which are rotation and scale invariant and computationally efficient. An initialization mechanism of particles based on Gaussian distribution is introduced, and a dynamic transfer matrix is used because moving objects may disappear and reappear. Comparisons with the mean shift tracker and a combination between the mean shift tracker and particle filtering show the advantages and limitations of the new approach.

articleTitle: Improved carrier phase estimation algorithms for optical coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To enhance the performance of Viterbi-Viterbi phase estimation for optical coherent transmission systems, two effective approaches are investigated in this paper, as adding one stage of normalization and using weighted average filter in the algorithm. The simulation results for QPSK, 8PSK and 16-QAM show that: (1) Triangle window can enlarge the range of permitted block length over 1.5 times in VVPE for three modulation formats, which means the ability of adaptive is enhanced for receiver with respect to laser linewidth; (2) Improved algorithm achieves smaller SNR penalty due to laser phase noise. For the linewidth per laser of 9MHz (QPSK), 2MHz (8PSK), and 1MHz (square 16-QAM), the SNR penalty is 0.8dB.

articleTitle: Research of the charge mode of electric automobile charging station and the key technology of the control system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electric automobile is a kind of environmental vehicle, which shows great promise for the future. It is an important method to solve the energy and environment problems. Electric automobile charging station offers energy supply to the car for running. It is the necessary Supporting infrastructure to develop the electric automobile.

articleTitle: Design and exploitation of integrated management system in university laboratory
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Nowadays, integrated management of laboratory still relies to manual labor in many universities. Many advanced tools and network are not fully used, which makes laboratory management at a lower level than other fields of university. This situation effects and restricts the development of university. This system is based on campus network and the particularity of laboratory management. It is a powerful software designed with advanced tools. By using this system, work efficiency is improved, laboratory management is standardized and the development of university is accelerated.

articleTitle: Spectral compact method of UNB using orthogonal ABPSK
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the recent years, a kind of small angle modulation is booming, that is UNB, first named by Dr. H.R. Walker, a high bandwidth efficiency is attained using the power as BPSK, which is from 15bps/Hz to 100 bps/Hz and even high than that. But For the most existing modulation method called UNB, besides the strong ultra narrow carrier-like spectrum, there is a wide continuous spectrum spread, which is not expected. The article presents Orthogonal ABPSK modulation; spectral characteristics and the demodulation performance using digital match filter method are analyzed; the spectral characteristics shows that the Orthogonal ABPSK has a better spectral characteristics, besides the continuous spectrum, there is only carrier line spectrum existing. And the main lobe of the continuous spectrum is also compressed, which only equals 2 times of the data rates, so the continuous spectral is compressed greatly compared to other ABPSK modulation method. Besides, the demodulation performance is only 3dB lower than that of BPSK and much better than that of other ABPSK formats.

articleTitle: Research on Quasi-orthogonal space-time block code
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Quasi-orthogonal space-time block code ensure that data transfer at full speed. However, it will reduce the error performance. Based on it, this paper proposed a new quasi-orthogonal space-time block code using full rate of the four transmit antenna. And it proposed the decoding method based on maximum likelihood algorithm. A number of simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has better error performance than the typical Jafarkhani quasi-orthogonal space-time block code.

articleTitle: Instructional design for situational Chinese mobile learning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Mobile Assisted Language Learning has become independent of traditional language learning and computer assisted language learning. Mobile assisted situational Chinese, which is outstanding for its mobility, ubiquity and pervasiveness, has been becoming a new trend of the study on theories and applications in the field of teaching Chinese as a second language. Based on the daily life of Beijing, this paper selected 28 practical valuable situations for students, in order to make the Chinese communication multimedia courseware in real situations, focusing on instructional design for situational Chinese mobile learning. The research findings of it could be some theoretical references and technical supports for Chinese learning at anytime, anywhere.

articleTitle: Developing learners' English thinking capabilities with the assistance of multimedia and network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper overviews the necessities of developing learners' thinking capabilities in English education. Based on a clear definition of English thinking capabilities, the author suggests 2 effective ways to develop learners' thinking capabilities in the multimedia and network supported English teaching and learning environment.

articleTitle: The empirical study of effectiveness on Blended learning in the western rural middle schools — Take an physics course of a junior school in Qujing, Yunnan Province as an example
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Take an experimental middle school of rural-distance education projects in the west area of China as an example, The paper constructs and implements a rural-distance education model based on Moodle. Although the study found that the model does not significantly improve the achievement of students, it can reduce the gap anong the students and improve students' interest in learning, and it can also save expenses for school.

articleTitle: Research of the model on recycling utilization of oil sludge
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The research object of our study is oil sludge produced in petrochemical wastewater treatment. A technical option is proposed in conditioning and dewatering of oil sludge, recycling of gas condensate and malysite so as to minimize the oil containing sludge, fully utilize resources and to protect environment. Results show that the structure of oil sludge is improved and the dewatering effect of oil sludge by flocculants conditioning. The sludge dewatering rate can increase about 22% and the gas condensate content is reduced to 0.086g/g after ultrasonic treatment. The malysite recovery and the total solid reduction are improved to 72.15% and 46.41% under the synergistic effect of acidification and ultrasonic wave. Finally, the excess sludge solidification by using solar drying method can reach landfill atandard. The objective of this paper is to establish a technique of the oil sludge treatment, which can be used for reference in the recycling utilization of oil sludge resource.

articleTitle: Research and test on RC Non-cap slab-column connections with prestressed steel
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Strengthening RC Non-cap slab-column connections with prestressed steel and Comparing hysteresis curve and the steel stress of slap-column between prestressed steel and ordinary slap-column through experimental method, it can get this result, the hysteresis curve of prestressed slap-column is fuller, seismic capacity is stronger, ultimate load is bigger.

articleTitle: Design of concealed alarm system based on GSM
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Considering the characteristics of banks and other financial institutions, this paper aims at reforming conventional alarm system by the concealed GSM monitor and wireless alarm system, meanwhile, SMS and voice alarm can be send out by multi-regional remote control FM network. On receiving the alarm, the monitoring center can achieve real-time on-site monitoring, thus provide more efficient information for the incident handling.

articleTitle: A high performance configurable random divider with FGPA and ASIC implementation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The divider is the one of the most important modules in microprocessors. A new algorithm was proposed to realize the decimal frequency divider with any number divide ratio, and the divide ratio was configurable by the SPI. In the statistical periods, the divide ratio is adjusted dynamically by calculating the error of clock. Error of divider can be reduced, and the accuracy after the four rounds has come to 1E-14% after 4 rounds. The implementation of decimal frequency divider was realized with FPGA and ASIC (under 180nm technology). The experimental result indicated that the decimal frequency divider takes fewer resources, and its performance is steady and reliable.

articleTitle: Research and design about intelligent transfusion guardianship based on wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In view of the flaw of artificial guardianship that exists in the medical transfusion guardianship process at present, this paper develops a kind of intelligent transfusion guardianship meter based on the wireless sensor network. It is compose of the following components, including the infrared detection module, ZigBee wireless transmission unit taking CC2530 as the core controller and step motor control module. Adopt the operating system of TinyOS and nesC, which faces wireless sensor network, to carry on the software design. This kind of intelligent transfusion guardianship meter, based on the wireless sensor network, is easy to operate, and may reduce the occurrence of transfusion accidents effectively.

articleTitle: Monitoring on safety factor of mine roadway based on structural equation model
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the process of tunneling, it has great significance to monitor the safety factors to prevent and reduce the happen of the safety incidents in order to ensure the health of miners and the development of enterprises. This article established monitoring model in the mine roadway using structural equation model to find out safety factor affecting security incidents in the mine roadway, in order to take measure to prevent the safety occurrence for the managers and relevant personnel.

articleTitle: A low-complexity null space-based method for blind CFO and DCO estimator in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Although orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) holds great potentials for the next generation wireless communication demands, the carrier frequency offset (CFO) and the DC Offset (DCO) in many practical systems can cause the loss of subcarrier orthogonality and hence severe performance degradation. So far, in the absence of DCO, one most successful CFO estimation approach makes use of the signal null space. However, with DCO, the same kind of easy to-implement null space to both the CFO and DCO terms have not been discovered. A compromise solution has been proposed to first project the signal onto the null space of the DCO term, then carry out the singular value decomposition (SVD) to find out the null space of the resulting CFO term. Although very accurate CFO estimation results can be obtained this way, the involved high computational complexity may pose a major hindrance to its practical deployment. In this paper, we show that it is possible to construct a null space to both the CFO and DCO terms. Our particular construction makes use of the Householder transform. As a consequence, the null space approach to CFO estimation in the presence of DCO can be done just as easily as in the absence of DCO, without having to resort to SVD. Experimental results show that the proposed method can obtain the same estimation accuracy as the state of the art methods, yet with much lower complexity and more than 10 times the speedup gain.

articleTitle: A preliminary study on instructional design model in M-learning
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Mobile learning has developed into a flexible and convenient learning mode with the development of mobile communication apparatus and network technology, but in real application most studies focus on the technical level other than the instructional design level. On the basis of summarizing the definition and features of mobile learning, this paper structures out an instructional design model for mobile learning and explains relevant elements.

articleTitle: Optimization design on floating raft system for advancing vibration isolation charaeteristics
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The floating raft system is more and more used in ship powerplant for the purpose of reducing vibration and noise; it is that the multi-equipments are installed on the same vibration isolating system with the double layer isolators and a middle raft frame. The optimization design on float raft system is significant for advancing the design level and enhancing the vibration isolating performance. The finite element model of floating raft system is set up, the system modal is computed, and the vibration feature is determined by the use of the direct finite element method. Then, a optimization model is formulated for enhancing vibration isolating performance, the local thicknesses of middle raft frame are taken as design variables, the weight of middle raft frame is taken as constraints, the response accelations on base of floating raft system are taken as objection, the optimization problem is solved by the feasible directions method. An example optimization is achieved, the example results show that the vibration isolating performance is greatly enhanced by thickness redistribution of middle raft frame while the weight is not added.

articleTitle: A new type of electro-hydraulic control valve structure
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The solution to eliminate the conflict between engine fuel economy and emissions performance has been the key to the development of engine technology, and engine variable valve timing technology is raised by one of the options. Development of variable valve technology in the world is introduced. According to variation of valve control parameters, variable valve technology is classified in detail. Combined with today's typical variable valve mechanism, approaches to realize the variable valve technology are systematically stated and evaluated. Combined with common rail technology, design a kind of electrical and mechanical hydraulic control valve, launched the structure features analysis, this paper expounds the working principle.

articleTitle: Research on inter-satellite ranging and velocity measurement method based on Doppler frequency measurement
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To improve the deficiency of autonomous timing of inter-satellite measurement, a method of baseline measurement which is based on inter-satellite two-way measurement for distributed spacecrafts is proposed in this paper. This method implements satellite autonomous timing through Doppler frequency measurement value and tracking carrier frequency. Meanwhile, it satisfies high precision ranging, achieving centimeter-level accuracy. Furthermore, when carrier tracking loop error is at about 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> m, the accuracy of velocity measurement can reach 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> m/s.

articleTitle: Evaluation on network load balancing in Xen
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Network load balancing is usually used to distribute workload across multiple network links, to improve the scalability and availability of network servers. Virtual machine is a technique in consolidated servers, co-located hosting facilities, distributed web services, and security platforms. We have implemented load balancing by NICs bonding on Xen which is an open source software for virtualization. The bonding of NICs also provides fault tolerance using network redundant connection to reduce network downtime. Two approaches are presented using bonding driver in Linux operating system with Xen. The evaluation shows that, bonding physical NICs in Xen virtual machine monitor (VMM) brings a higher throughput and lower CPU cost. Bonding in DomU has certain advantages in data path redundant and short message responses at the price of costing extra 10% CPU resources.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of PEM fuel cell based on distributed-parameter model
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The study of the dynamic modeling of PEM fuel cell was based on the distributed-parameter model. The simulation will complete with Fluent, a computer software dealing with the PEM module of computer fluid dynamics. This paper first describes the distributed-parameter model, including the quality, momentum, energy, species conservation equation in PEM cell, the electrical chemistry equation in the catalyst layer, then a 3D structure model for single cell with a single channel is established. The dynamic response and performance were calculated with the non-steady calculator in Fluent. Simulations are that dynamic responses of voltage when current density step changes.

articleTitle: Study on wireless local area network technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With increasing maturity and development of wireless LAN technology, wireless local area network has been widely used in all areas of social life. As a new technology, applications and application of wireless local area network has its huge advantage. Taking into account the socio-economic development requirements of the 21st century to study how the effective use of wireless LAN technology, to build wireless local area network to facilitate effective communication and improve people's living standard is very urgent and necessary.

articleTitle: Mining the emotional words from Chinese reviews based on part of speech and syntax
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In the reviews, customers use emotional words to express their own views about the products. Consequently, mining the emotional words automatically become one of the hot spots in reviews mining. For the emotional words abstraction of Chinese product reviews, we approach from the two aspects of part of speech and syntax in this paper. We mine the part of speech templates of emotional words from training set firstly, then extract emotion words set based on the templates, and prune the emotional words set through the dependent relationship and stop words set at last. The final extraction results not only include the emotional words which evaluate the dominant features, but also include the ones about the invisible features and overall evaluations. The method is not limited to certain categories of products, so it has the extensive applicability. The experimental results show the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A peer-to-peer solution for SIP servers cooperation in wireless mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Deploying SIP services in wireless mesh networks is valuable for communication scenarios without infrastructure. In traditional method of SIP service provision, severs work individually without cooperation, and there exist such problems as low availability of resources and high cost of information update. In our multi-servers cooperation scheme for providing SIP services in wireless mesh networks, all servers are placed in an overlay. The overlay is built on Chord algorithm with 2 modifications; one is recording the information of all nodes in route table, the other is replicas-distribution by equal-distance hashing method. Theoretical analysis and comparison on performance were made among the scheme without cooperation, Chord-based cooperation scheme, and our scheme. And our scheme is proved to be superior in such metrics as query-delay and maintenance cost, and is especially applicable for networks with fixed number of servers and a lot of dynamic SIP users. Simulation results verified that our scheme can guarantee higher query-hit-ratio and forwarding speed, and decrease the overhead of network traffic.

articleTitle: The protection of the privacy right in electronic commerce
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the popularization and application of the electronic commerce, online shopping, internet supermarkets and a large number of online bookstore web retailers emerge and e-commerce advances quickly in China. The development of e-commerce brings not only convenience to consumers but also challenges to the protection of consumer rights. Problem about privacy is unavoidable in e-commerce. An important prerequisite for the development of e-commerce is the well control over privacy information that could be used as the competitors' advantage in e-commerce, so privacy protection is particularly important. By analyzing the domestic privacy protection in the present situation of e-commerce environment, this paper provides legislation advices to protect individual privacy in e-commerce. Our country is in the early stage of electronic commerce now, there will be a win-win outcome for individuals and businesses to establish and complete e-commerce environment and the protection system of personal privacy. If the internet privacy problem were resolved, e-commerce and online information industries will be more prosperous.

articleTitle: A practical updating background method in moving target detection
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Background subtraction is a powerful mechanism typically for segmenting moving regions in image sequences taken from a data acquisition system. It compares each new image to a model of the scene background image. In this paper, we present a novel method for the reconstruction of background image in background subtraction. This method firstly calculates the difference of two neighboring images, then deals with this result to determine whether the background image needs to be updated and finally reconstructs the background image by a simple weight formula. The experiment result shows that the proposed method could update background image quickly and timely in the scene of traffic flow monitoring. Using this method we can get a more accurate background, which is conducive to the segmentation of the target.

articleTitle: Fast algebraic decoding of the (17, 9, 5) quadratic residue code
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A fast algebraic decoding algorithm is proposed to correct all patterns of two or fewer errors in the binary (17, 9, 5) quadratic residue (QR) code. Computer simulations show that the average decoding time of the proposed decoding algorithm is about 2.88 times less execution time than the D3 algebraic decoding algorithm of Chang et al.

articleTitle: Mechanical property study on wind wheel of vertical axis wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Wind power has been generally concerned as a clean, renewable energy. The mechanical properties of supporting columns, rotating blades and the corresponding pieces of wind turbines are important for the safety working during designed life. Finite element method has been used in this paper to research the mechanical properties of rotating blades with the corresponding connecting pieces with the procedure of load analysis, modeling, meshing, restraint conditions setting, simulating and results analysis for a vertical axis wind turbines with the designed wind of the Beauport force 10. The conclusions have been obtained as follows: (1) the weakest position locates at the edge between the square tube II and tray salver; the blade unit is safe for the wind of Beauport force 10; (2) the stress increases with the wind power rising with the trend of conic.

articleTitle: Dynamic alliance model system design based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Combined with Web Services technology, we design virtual enterprise dynamic alliance system. The system structure is mainly includes three roles: the customer, the core enterprise and member enterprises. Using openness of the Internet and the specification of the protocol, we provide a loosely coupled data layer and application layer integration among enterprises. Dynamic alliance system service uses a custom mode that the server-side applications act as a service provider role to provide various services for other small and medium-sized manufacturing enterprises. Through WSDL to create a Web Services client program, and call the service provider to implement the service. We regards the demands of Huaian enterprise as the research object and give system function diagram to realize the system design of the dynamic alliance information platform for small and medium-sized manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: The study on the channel characteristics and models of unified TT&C system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The received microwave signals must have distortion and attenuation during the transmission because of channel effect from the target to TT&C Station. Due to the particularity of TT&C system and the position of its station, firstly the characteristics and the effect of TT&C channel are analyzed. Secondly, the channel models are built and the simulation results confirm their feasibility and validity.

articleTitle: Adaptive wideband sidelobe cancellation based on uniform line array
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Sidelobe cancellation is an important method of anti-jamming technologies. This paper proposes an adaptive wideband sidelobe cancellation system base don uniform line array. In this system, calculate the weight of auxiliary channel by the subbands with interference and then weighted the auxiliary channel signal to obtain the jamming signals to achieve interference cancellation. The simulations show that the system can restrain two jamming signals effectively.

articleTitle: Multi-functions online chatting system based on Red5
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the fast development of Internet, chatting room has become the most widely used communication tool. A kind of multi-functions network chat system based on open stream media server Red5 is proposed in this paper. Since the same registered users of different websites usually use the fixed user names and passwords, the vulnerability of these fixed passwords exist, which could be solved through dynamic Hash authentication based on target site URL, random number and password. JavaScript, Flex, AS3 and JSP technology are used for development and are combined with the popular Struts2, Hibernate and Spring framework. Hence, functions such as real-time video or audio chat, MOD and file transfer could be realized. Test results show that this system could be proper used in the actual network environment, and the performance on Safety, efficiency, maintainability and expandability is also very excellent.

articleTitle: The research of stability performance of five-axle all wheel driving vehicles with electric wheels basing on direct yaw control and traction control system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When turning at high speed, multi-axle vehicles are prone to steering shimmy, and even turning out of control and other issues. According to the characteristics that the driving torque of each electric-wheel can be independently controlled, the Direct Yaw Control strategy was proposed to improve the vehicle's steering characteristics. According to vehicle steering characteristics, a yaw rate calculation formula was established, that was also a yaw rate of the control objectives. The five-axle vehicle dynamics model was established with software ADAMS, and DYC-TCS control strategy was built with software Simulink. The step input response test was proceeded with different driving speed. It was found that when turning with DYC-TCS control strategy, the controllability of yaw rate can be significantly improved, the yaw rate convergence time became short, in particular, steering shimmy tendency can be reduced. It can improve the vehicle's handling and stability.

Author Keywords: direct yaw control and traction control system

articleTitle: Fuzzy clustering segmentation algorithm research for sport graphics based on artificial life
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, linking with the basic principle of FCM (Fuzzy c-means clustering) algorithm, on the basis of theory research, the segmented partitions emerge when the state of the lives reaches an equilibrium. The artificial life approach is promising in image processing because it is inherently parallel and coincides with the self-governing biological process. Then combined with intensity-texture-position feature space in order to produce connected regions shown in the image, the final segmentation result is achieved at last. The experiment results prove that in the view of the sport image segmentation, this algorithm provides fast segmentation with high perceptual segmentation quality.

articleTitle: Experimental study of cooperative communication utilizing GNU Radio and USRP2
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A Software Defined Radio (SDR) is a radio communication system that has been typically implemented by means of software on a personal computer or embedded computing device. GNU Radio and Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP2) are the software part and hardware of a concrete realization of the SDR In this paper, we seek to explore the advantage of cooperative communication using the GNU Radio and USRP2. We will compare the system performance with and without cooperative communication. Quality of Service (QoS) in terms of Packet Loss Rate (PLR) is investigated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Frequency to MIDI converter for Musical Instrument Microphone System
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The design of a Musical Instrument Microphone System (MIMS) allows musicians having the opportunity to experiment with other musical instrument sounds without actually having to learn how to play them. The sound wave is received and processed in a digital signal processer with outputting digital sound frequency to a frequency to MIDI (Musical Instrumental Digital Interface) converter in real time. The MIDI note is then sent to a sequencer or sound module to produce different instrumental sound. This paper is focused on frequency to MIDI note conversion and MIDI control messages generation.

articleTitle: The design of ZigBee protocol based mobile node in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to overcome the defects of static wireless sensor network nodes, such as poor adaptability, communication disruption, lack of dynamic networking and so on, a kind of approach to design mobile wireless sensor node is proposed in this paper. Detail hardware implementation and software design are also introduced. And then together with Laboratory Virtual Instrument Engineering Workbench (LabVIEW), ZigBee mobile wireless sensor network is built to verify the feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: Analysis and improvement of identity-based designated verifier signature scheme
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Li Mingxiang et al proposed identity based strong designated verifier signature schemes are analyzed, it is found that the scheme of security vulnerabilities: non designated verifier can verify the validity of the signature, and the scheme does not have the unforgeability. Based on the above shortcomings, proposed the improvement scheme. While retaining the merits of the original scheme overcomes the original scheme security hidden trouble. Improved scheme satisfies transitivity, unforgeability, signer identity anonymity and other safety features, and has higher efficiency of signature.

articleTitle: The design of stepper motor system based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper designs an stepper motor control system apply to blood coagulation analyzer, which mainly includes the design of the hardware of nodes in slave machine, the communication program and motor control program and software in host machine. Combining with the CAN bus, the system uses MC9S12XS128 micro controller as control core and SLA7078MR as drive chips of the stepper motor to realize the communication between host machine and slave machine. Test results show that the system runs stably and has well real-time reliability.

articleTitle: A binocular vision tracking method based on Gabor filter
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To solve the stability and rapidity problem of visual tracking, the paper presents a method that the characteristic points in sequenced images assemblies for target is collected by the Gabor filter, and turned into matching templates. The detection with the Sobel operator is used to get initial points position, to determine each initial point parameter, and in this way we can speed up optimizing for parameters. The experimental result has been verified that the arithmetic is with highly reliability and availability, it can avoid the affection by target feature collecting from background, so the method has the benefit to the real time binocular tracking.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of keyframe extracion methods in content-based teaching video retrieval
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper discusses the current key frame extraction technology based on the characteristics of teaching video. An experiment system of key frame extraction has been designed based on color feature. The algorithms, which are based on the Histogram average method, content analysis, shot boundary extraction, Kernel Clustering method and so on, have been achieved and and its characteristics are summarized.

articleTitle: Researching on the role of e-portfolio in the learning progress
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The research of the e-portfolio in the learning progress role, It will be beneficial to explicit the e-portfolio in which learning stage of the learning progress, and form a whole set of school's e-portfolio system, improve managers' or teachers' thought value degree. This paper, from the learning motivation, understanding learning information, consolidate the knowledge, ability to apply knowledge such five aspects to discuss e-portfolio in the process of learning role.

articleTitle: Research of image recognition technology about moving object based on low-resolution camera
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the issue of accuracy in the process of motion pattern detection, and propose a new multi-frame superposition motion detection algorithm on the base of traditional adjacent frame difference method. First, we deal the captured image with blurring, color separation process and so on, then implement the multi-frame superposition processing technology and calculate the average coordinates of movement points to analyze the image. And the experiments prove that this algorithm maintains the traditional algorithm's efficiency while has a great improvement on accuracy and versatility at the same time.

articleTitle: Performance of network coding in ad hoc network multipath routing protocol
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Network coding, the notion of performing coding operations on the contents of packets while in transit through the network, was originally developed for wired networks; recently, however, it has been also applied with success also to mobile ad hoc networks (MANET). In this paper, we compare the performance of different protocols for ad hoc networks — Multipath routing based on fresnel zone routing (FZR), and Energy aware Node Disjoint Multipath Routing (ENDMR) protocol. Simulation results show that, with the proposed network coding in ad hoc network multipath routing protocol (NC-MR), packet delivery ratio, network lifetime and packet loss can be improved in most of cases. It is an available approach to multipath routing decision.

articleTitle: Data fusion of the wireless sensor network in greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Data fusion is one of the key technologies of wireless sensor network. This paper designed the fusion process of the WSN measured data. In order to exclude outliers, the measured values of sensor nodes in each group are tested for consistency firstly, and then the batch estimation algorithm is used to estimate the measurement values, at last, according to the value of each sensor measurement variance, an adaptive weighted calculation method was designed to get the final fusion values of the environmental factors. The proposed data fusion method greatly enhanced the WSN communication efficiency, improved the measurement precision and decreased the energy consumption of the wireless sensor node.

articleTitle: Design and realization of SOA based management system for open experiment lab
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper first analyzed the current situations and problems in open experiment labs of higher education and then explored and designed SOA based management system for open experiment lab. This system can meet the needs of functions, performance and security and it has improved quality of experimental teaching and simplified the management work.

articleTitle: A high order temperature curvature compensated CMOS bandgap reference
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents a second-order corrected bandgap reference (BGR) based on TSMC 0.35μm 2P3M CMOS process. This novel proposed CMOS bandgap reference take advantage of the high temperature coefficient (TC) of some resistors, to compensate the high-order temperature curvature of the base-emitter voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BE</sub>). This circuit can achieve temperature coefficient of 1.5ppm/°C for temperature from -40 to 120°C at 5 V power supply. The proposed circuit will find application in the high precision analog and digital circuits.

articleTitle: CVT speed ratio control study on the dynamic performance compensation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: There are some shortcomings in the CVT dynamic performance in the conventional economic model This study increased dynamic performance of vehicle through amending the target speed ratio and the proportional solenoid valve drive signal voltage With the driver's intention(the accelerator opening change rate), we get the driver's intention index. We use the driver's intention to modify the target speed ratio and to improve the engine line of work. To solve the problem that the speed ratio responds slowly, we raise the proportional solenoid valve drive signal voltage and accelerate the shift speed The real vehicle testing results show that in the conventional economic model car up to 50km/h in 4.3s; after dynamic performance compensation, car up to 50km/h in 3.6s, CVT ratio control method, based on dynamic performance compensation, can improve vehicle dynamic performance.

articleTitle: The information platform structure about the comprehensive evaluation system model for nursing outcomes
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To explore the scientific and effective management model for nursing outcomes, thereby to correctly evaluate nursing care and increase management efficiency, which are supported by hospital information network platform and mobile nurse workstations. The ambiguous theory-based and three-level nursing outcome comprehensive evaluation model is built through utilizing timely collection and management system for nursing comprehensive information, then building a corresponding network platform.

articleTitle: Implement of HDB3 coder in base-band system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Based on rules of HDB3 Encoder and Decoder, Encoder and Decoder System will be given. there are four modules in encoder, namely, detection of four 0 sequence in source information, generator of “V”, generator of “B”, obeying the AMI rule, and AMI encoder.

articleTitle: A muti-channel Online Selling Syndicates based on cloud structure
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Starting from brief introduction to fast developing Chinese B2C E-commerce market, we develop an Online Selling Syndicates system with Spring framework and several Apache open source projects for this market based on Software as a service(SaaS) model and analysis of customers' requirements, multi-channel and multi-tenant are supported by the system. For convert IT resource to business concept, a controller cluster mode is designed to decentralize the statue control of cloud computing. Two fast check algorithms are designed to serve the efficient control.

articleTitle: Drive-by downloads defense based on kernel level filtering
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Recently, How to secure your browser out of malware attacks became the hottest topics on system security. According to the characteristics of Windows systems and drive-by download, this paper designed to eliminate drive-by malware installations present a browser-independent system architecture based on windows kernel file system filter driver and user-level hook technology. By Intercepting the user's download behavior, user-level module will get the file path information passed to the kernel-level file filter driver module, which can redirect all malicious program to a particular directory in which is to prevent the execution of any binary file. The capabilities of the design combining user-level modules and kernel-level modules can ensure the safety of the operation system. The experimental results present that our defense system has a good protection of the injection of malicious programs because of the fragile web browser and lower running overhead and little impacts to user.

articleTitle: A high-speed iris recognition system based on DM6446
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we present a high-speed iris recognition system based on DM6446 and put forward by a DSP and ARM dual-core embedded system processing platform, DM6446 is TMS320DM6446 abbreviation, which the TI company produces the high level of integration video processing chip. The system has integrated with the image acquisition, image processing, recognition and has advantages of high speed, small size, and low power consumption. It is not only faster and more effective than single-core DSP, but it also has the function of real-time display, which can help the users to easily capture the perfect image that they need. The system use for the registration and the correct recognition of human iris, we use the traditional iris identification algorithm, which has high recognition rate and with good stability, after the success of the iris matching, the plate will show personal information which is already registered to data base. The test shows that the iris image can be correctly identified by the system. In addition, this board can also be used for face recognition, license plate recognition and fingerprint recognition, etc

articleTitle: A resource quick search and locating algorithm of P2P VoD system based on skip table mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When design and implement a video-on-demand system on P2P network, due to the play asynchronism among users, the randomicity of the node joining and leaving and the random VCR operations of the users can exacerbate the node dynamics. In this paper, several key techniques of the system are studied. a P2P distributed resource quick search and locating algorithm based on skip table mechanism is presented. The paper has designed and implemented a P2P VoD system based on skip table. Combined with other methods, such as the optimized hybrid schedule strategy, data pre-fetch mechanism, and the urgent download schedule algorithm, it can effectively improve the performance in play continuity and reduce the user's wait delay. In the end, the paper makes simulation and gives the test results.

articleTitle: Reserch of mine fire simulation technology based on computational experiments
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper puts forward an emergency dynamic simulation system based on computational experiments method and cellular automata modeling according to the features of mine fire emergency management. The system has characteristics of high performance, open and interact. The system sets initial environmental parameters to simulate fire, and records the fire parameters. Let the staff not only see the whole process of the fire spread and disaster degree of fire in specific environment, but also get fire severity assessment of every experiment. Observation of the whole process can help staff design the actual plan to solve problems, and provide the correct suggestions for promoting emergency capability to reduce casualties and economic loss.

articleTitle: Incomplete statistics in a completely open system based on incomplete entropy
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Within the framework of non-extensive and incomplete statistical physics, after a microscopic volume is introduced, the probability distribution function and thermodynamic formulas are derived in a completely open system with incomplete statistics based on incomplete entropy under assumption of the maximum entropy principle.

articleTitle: Tools for Mind Map and technology research: The method of presenting mind map online
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper briefly introduces the knowledge of Mind Map, compares various softwares for making mind map, and also compares several correlative technologies for presenting mind map online. It concretely introduces the usage of FreeMindFlashBrower and the method of displaying Chinese correctly in FreeMindFlashBrower. It finally provides a free tool chain which can make Chinese mind map and present them online.

articleTitle: The differences in coordination between children with ADHD and healthy children based on two-way ANOVA analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This study attempts to invest the differences in movement coordination between children with ADHD and healthy children using two-way ANOVA. The experimental tasks are divided into simple task and complex task. The goal of the experiments is to study the interaction in hand movements' rhythm, accuracy and error key response between task difficulty and subjects grouping while doing visual-motor integration tasks. The results show that: (1) There are no significant differences in all parameters except error number within group differences. (2) There are significant differences in all parameters except correct response time between group differences.

articleTitle: Application of intelligence optimization algorithm in curriculum schedule arranging of Phased teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Arranging of curriculum schedule is called timetable problem, which is a typical combination optimization problem and uncertain management problem, resolving the conflict of resource. It is a tough problem for university, which has been studied for several years. Courses Timetabling Problem has been proved a NP-completion problem in 1970's. It's easy to make mistake to arrange curriculum schedule by hands, so it should be done by computer. In recent year, there are some intelligence optimization algorithm have been applied to resolve problem. In this study, the advantages and disadvantages of various algorithms has been compared, in order to choose the properly effective algorithm to arrange the courses schedule, according to conditions. But, the study of arranging curriculum schedule for Phased teaching seldom is limited. Curriculum schedule of the special major, which contains Phased teaching course is been arranged by hand. An intelligence optimization algorithm has been applied to arrange the timetable of these special major.

articleTitle: The design of electronic sphygmomanometer with function of hemodynamic parameters detecting
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The electronic sphygmomanometer with function of hemodynamic parameters detecting is designed in this paper, it can not only measure systolic and diastolic blood pressure, but also calculate cardiovascular hemodynamic parameters. It adopts the C8051F020 single-chip microcomputer as the core of calculating and processing of the device. The method of oscillometric is used to get the mean arterial pressure, systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. The electronic sphygmomanometer with the function of hemodynamic parameters detecting can measure the systolic and diastolic blood pressure accurately, and it can also get the result of hemodynamic parameters from people. The systolic and diastolic blood pressure and the hemodynamic parameters can be got in the same time with the instrument which is designed in this paper, the instrument provides more reliable evidence for the diagnosis of disease, and it enriches the functionality of electronic sphygmomanometer, and expands the application scope of the electronic sphygmomanometer.

articleTitle: Role of the prefabricated chunks in the working memory of oral interpretation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A large number of studies have confirmed the universality and importance of the prefabricated chunks in the language. If interpreters master and reserve a large block of prefabricated language, higher efficiency of Information decoding and encoding involved in the process of working memory can be achieved and the capacity of short-term memory can be also increased significantly.

articleTitle: Application study of blind equalization method based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper firstly shows out the critical point in the application of the blind equalization method based on BP neural network according to the demand of its design, and then simulation is done to verify its characteristics. The paper gives the guiding opinions in the process of design, application and improvement of the blind equalizer based on BP neural network at last.

articleTitle: Pulse vaccination of a SIR epidemic model with distributed time delay
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a SIR epidemic model with distributed time delay was proposed. By using the theory of impulsive delay differential equation, we investigate the dynamics under pulse vaccination. We get the conditions for global attractivity of “infection-free” periodic solution and permanence of the “infection” depend on time delay and pulse vaccination.

articleTitle: Cooperation approach of multi-agent intelligent decision support system based on blackboard
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Multi-Agent Intelligent Decision Support System based on blackboard is designed that uses of blackboard system and Agent In the system, because the knowledge and problem-solving capability of an individual Agent are limited, finding cooperative Agents becomes a key issue to problem-solving so that interacts with other Agents to complete a task This paper proposes an approach of finding cooperative Agent based on the degree of commitment The system can help to cooperate in Multi-Agent about complicated works.

articleTitle: Study on preparation of copper matrix composites reinforced by SiC and Graphite particles
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The copper matrix composites reinforced by SiC and Graphite particle were fabricated by powder metallurgy. The density of the composite was tested by Archimedes theory, and the hardness were tested by FEM-700-type meter, and friction and wear properties of materials was tested by MG-2000 high-speed high temperature friction and wear tester. The results show that the copper matrix composites reinforced by SiC and Graphite particles are successfully fabricated by powder metallurgy, and the particle distribution is uniform, the hardness of composite materials decrease with the increasing of graphite content, and the hardness of composite materials increase with increasing of SiC content, the wear resistance of composite materials increases with the graphite content increase. This study not only extends theoretical scope of the study of the particle reinforced copper matrix composite, but also on application of practical significance of the copper matrix composites instead of copper and copper alloy.

articleTitle: The research on electronic tag anti-collision technology based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of RFID technology system structure and principle, then studies the two common anti-collision algorithm that they are the ALOHA algorithm and the binary search algorithm in RFID systems. Next, the throughput of pure ALOHA algorithm and slotted ALOHA algorithm is analyzed.

articleTitle: Comparing two classification methods based on the attribute hierarchy method and the DINA model
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cognitive diagnostic assessment (CDA) for education can be recognized as an effective data mining approach in education research. In CDA, one of the critical steps is how to classify correctly the examinee in the most probable of the attribute mastery patterns or classes. The article mainly discussed and compared two classification methods: method A based on the attribute hierarchy method and the maximum a posteriori estimation of the DINA model. The Monte Carlo simulation results showed that the DINA model outperforms the AHM in terms of the correct classification rate for the entire patterns; however, for some patterns with larger test information conditioned on associated abilities, AHM performs better. Further, a rule of combining the results of two methods was proposed. Thus, one can exploit their individual advantages in order to reach an overall better performance than could be achieved by using each of them separately.

articleTitle: Single FDCCII-based multifunction voltage-mode biquadratic filter
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A new single FDCCII-based multifunction voltage-mode biquadratic filter with single input and four outputs is proposed. The proposed configuration employs minimum active and passive components and can realize four generic filter signals without any inverting-type voltage input signals. The proposed circuit is constructed using a single fully differential current conveyor (FDCCII), two grounded capacitors and two resistors. The use of grounded capacitors is particularly attractive for integrated circuit implementation. The circuit can simultaneously realize voltage-mode lowpass, bandpass, highpass, and bandstop biquadratic filters from the four output terminals, respectively. All the passive and active sensitivities are low. Filters using a single active component and minimum number of passive elements have the advantages of lower cost and power dissipation. HSPICE and MATLAB simulations results are provided to demonstrate the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis for castellated steel columns with two different expansion ratio
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Some models are established by ANSYS in this paper. Finite-element analysis was used for these models, which include circular hole castellated columns with expansion ratio being 1.4 or 1.5, solid-web steel members without expansion. And then, buckling analysis for the models under axial compression is carried out. So the bearing capacity for compressive members are obtained and analyzed.

articleTitle: On the application of BP neural network based on Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm in the diagnosis of mental disorders
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Because of the traditional BP neural network's limitation, including easily falling into local minimum, slow convergence and iteration for a long time, we propose a diagnostic system of mental disorders based on Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. This article illustrates the basic principles of the neural network algorithm and establishes a mental diagnosis model based on L-M algorithm which uses common mental illness among college students as subjects. The outcome of the simulation illustrates the fact that it is effective to apply the neural network to establish a mental diagnostic system because it has reduced the training iterations and training period and it has high accuracy as well.

articleTitle: Equations of motion of a structure under multidimensional seismic excitations
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Equations of motion of a structure under multidimensional seismic excitations are established based on dynamics and kinematics. The seismic excitations considered include two translational components in horizontal and a rotational component about vertical. The dynamics of a structure under such excitations is much more profound than usual expectations sated by conventional theories; the new presented equations reveal the remarkable difference in the acceleration calculations of the super structure.
