The FPGA hardware architecture and the implementation algorithm are based on a proved software system, but improved a lot to achieve the realtime display effect. The experiment performances represent a sound result and can be improved to adapt to future SoC design and more complex 3DTV end to end system.

articleTitle: Modeling and function assessing with meditation training on brain functional memory network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Modeling on memory network is an important way to understand the memory mechanism in brain functional complex network. Function assessing is a necessary channel to verify the accuracy of the results that will be applied to the theory strengthening and practice conductions, also the clinical remedy. In order to get abstract memory model, we present the theoretical analysis method by the artificial neural network and experimental test method by the meditation training on the basis of the graph theory. Meanwhile we put forward our hypothesis about working memory existing before the experimental tasks. In terms of the behavior and functional analysis of memory characters on the fMRI data, the hypothesis was verified and the memory network was modeled with small-world characteristic. The results implied that the processing solution of the brain functional memory network was feasible and effective on the references and conductions to the brain memory clinical researches.

articleTitle: An effective RFID authentication protocol
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is an automatic identification system, which is widely used for industrial and individual applications. However, features of RFID systems present potential security and privacy problems. In an effort to resolve these problems and protect the users from tracing and also to support Low-cost RFID, in this paper, we propose an RFID security method that achieves all requirements based on a hash function and a symmetric key cryptosystem. In addition, our proposed method provides not only high-security but also high-efficiency.

articleTitle: A serial concatenated scheme for LDPC code to achieve better error correction performance
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Low Density Parity Check(LDPC) Codes is a class of approaching limits error correction codes which has gained widely application in communications. The excellent performance, however, is the result of a large number of repeatedly conducting iterative decoding algorithm, and is apt to be seriously affected by small girth in the parity check matrix. In this paper we present a novel serial concatenated scheme for LDPC codes which utilize much smaller generation matrix and the interleaver to reduce possibilities of girth, thus reducing the number of iterations in decoding. Simulation shows that the new codes have better performance while less requirement of iterations.

articleTitle: Machine-machine communications using relationships in social media
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a machine-machine communication model using human-human relationships in social media is presented, and a main feature of this model is that relationships between devices are extracted from social graphs of social network services. By using this method, devices are seamlessly interconnected according to users' relationships in their daily social lives.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy and comprehensive evaluation model for developing teaching evaluation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Aiming at problematic fact of the traditional teaching evaluation and imperfection of evaluating indicator system, this research designed and testified the validity of a developing teaching evaluation model based on Fuzzy and Comprehensive Evaluation. By domestic and international relevant research of teaching evaluation, the paper outlined the connotation, the essential features, the significance, the bases and the principle of developable teaching evaluation. Based on the principles of system engineering, it first established a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, according to the model, through an argumentation performed by experts and with the use of Delphi method the authors have set up a multi hierarchy comprehensive evaluation index system for teachers and students, and calculated the index weight by analytical hierarchy process (AHP) method, and the procedures and method for model comprehensive evaluation were also determined. In addition, it converted the initial evaluation composite index into a defined interval by the stand map method.

articleTitle: Collaborative filtering recommendation based on item rating and characteristic information prediction
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: To deal with the sparsity and expansibility of traditional collaborative filtering algorithm, a collaborative filtering algorithm based on item rating was proposed in this paper. The method can calculation the item ratings of project that have not rated based on the analysis of the item characteristic information, and use item-based collaborative filtering algorithm to find the similar items. Moreover, the paper puts forward a new formula to compute the rating values of the item that users have not rated. The experiment results demonstrate that the new algorithm could improve the accuracy of recommendation under the condition of the extreme sparsity of user rating data.

articleTitle: Android city tour guide system based on Web service
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The combination of the smart phone and the Internet service is the trend of the future information development and software applications. Mobile phones are the most commonly used communication tools. Using mobile phones to obtain information is not only quick, but also more convenient shortcut to improve people's lives. In the paper, we propose the software development architecture based on Web services. This framework introduces the three-layer architecture of Web development into mobile phone software development. Based on the three-layer architecture, the android based city tour guide system is developed. The android based city guide system can realize to query information for hotel, scenery, restaurant, traffic and so on. The android based city guide system has more practical significance.

articleTitle: Apply embedded openflow MPLS technology on wireless Openflow — OpenRoads
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Openflow is one of the most important and popular next generation internet structure and technology. Its thought of “software decide network” makes dispatch of controller and date layer. Controller uses the openflow protocol to communicate and control the openflow switch to generate flow table, thus to achieve the centralized control of the whole network. OpenRoads is the framework about the wireless Openflow environment. It successfully apply the thought of SDN on the wireless mobile environment. As a propose to improve the performance and quality of the OpenRoads, The new embedded Openflow-MPLS(EOF-MPLS) is presented. An important technology key point is that both traditional MPLS and Openflow support the thought of separation between controller and date layer which makes a solid foundation for the new EOF-MPLS. EOF-MPLS offered forward equal class(FEC), Label distribute Protocol(LDP) to improve the efficiency of the nodes forward. It makes tight coupling with Openflow structure and support the QoS and traffic engineering. At last an entropy is came up with to assess the communication effectiveness of the EOF-MPLS to the OpenRoads.

articleTitle: The application of modern information technology in communication theory teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Communication theory is an important major course of communication engineering which introduces the basic theory of this course. The paper firstly discusses some problems in course of traditional teaching. Secondly, a new teaching method called “three-dimensional method” is brought forward in order to solve the problems. Finally, the application of “three-dimensional method” is narrated.

articleTitle: Optimal secondary user selection scheme for primary users in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) is considered as one of the most promising solutions to the problem of overcrowded spectrum by allowing secondary users (SUs) to access the spectrum dynamically. Most related previous work on CR networks with primary users' (PUs') participation ignores the SU selection scheme when the spectrum holes cannot satisfy the requirements of all SUs. In this paper, we propose an optimal SU selection scheme with the optimization goals of maximizing the PU's reward, which is defined as the summation of rent collected from the SUs. To solve this problem, a restless bandit approach is used, which dramatically simplifies the computational complexity. Furthermore, extensive simulation results are presented to show the significant performance improvement of the proposed scheme compared to the existing ones.

articleTitle: Research of cloud computing data security technology
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With cloud computing applications and research at home and abroad continue to advance cloud computing platform for users and data exchange between the greater the amount of user data transmission and storage a security threat, a cloud computing security is an important issue to be resolved. In this paper, all with state of encryption technology, presents a cloud computing data security solutions, both to ensure safe transmission of data to ensure the security of static data.

articleTitle: Logistics information management system based on Google cloud computing platform
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cloud computing can appeal for applications with a high degree of computational complexity and dynamics. And it can help users decrease their investments for their own IT infrastructure. So it is good for small and medium enterprises. In this paper, we propose to design and implement a logistics information management system based on Google cloud computing platform. It runs with Google App Engine and datastore. This system is designed with MVC architecture. Enterprises can buy this system as service, and no need to buy their own IT infrastructure.

articleTitle: Electric bus battery-swapping system based on robots
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Electric Vehicle which could save energy and protect environment, is an important part of strong smart grid and will be the trend of automotive industry in the future. Nowadays, battery-swapping is the main method of EV charging. In this paper, electric bus battery-swapping system based on robots which includes cartesian robot, stacker and battery charging bay, is introduced considering mechanical parts and control system. At the same time, the experimental data and advanced techniques of the battery swap system are introduced finally.

articleTitle: Energy-saving improvements of hydraulic system for loader's working device
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper first introduces the working principle of the hydraulic system on the loader, followed by a detailed analysis of reasons for the energy loss caused by its moving arm working process of hydraulic system, and thus anglicizing the pressure loss of the original system, especially the throttling losses when the oil go through the reversing valve, and puts forward some system improvements for the energy loss of the original system. By the analysis of energy loss on the new system, it is found that the new system lost much less pressure than the original system when moving arm down, but also come to improve the reliability of the system through the analysis of the rate of descend.

articleTitle: The security analysis of WPA encryption in wireless network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper discusses the security problems existing in the encryption methods of WPA/WPA2 in wireless network and analyses the cracking method of WPA/WPA2 encryption. BackTrack5 that was lately issued is adopted to capture the 4-way handshake package in Linux System. Then, the handshake packets are copied to Win7 and cracked by EWSA-GPU. The comparison and analysis of data via this method with that of via cracking WPA/WPA2 by BackTrack4 prove that this method can greatly improve the cracking speed. Finally some encrypted strategies that against the new cracking methods are disposed.

articleTitle: An improved object tracking method based on particle filter
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The conventional particle filter uses system transition as the proposal distribution. In order to improve the performance of particle filter for target tracking, Ensemble kalman filter is proposed to construct proposal distribution for sampling particle. In the tracking process, color model and shape model are combined and updated adaptively. Experimental results show the proposed algorithm improves the stability of the object tracking and enhances the estimation accuracy compared to conventional filters.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of student registration system for universities
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Student Registration System for Universities (SRSU) as a kind of management information system can not only record the information for student registration each term quickly and efficiently, but also do statistics on the students' basic information, registration information, and payment information and give results of the analysis. The background of the subject is analyzed in the paper firstly, and the technologies used in the development are introduced. Then the implementation of the system is given in detail. The upgrade and expansion of the system are prospected in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Semantic Web service discovery method based on user preference and QoS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: How to find and choose the appropriate service quickly and accurately is a hot issue in Web service research. In order to solve this problem, by analyzing the user, get conclusion that user's need are different and diversity, and if we provide the user with the service according to their preference will increase the user satisfy degree. This article presents a semantic Web service discovery method based on the user preference and QoS. The method has three layers matching strategy which user can choose the QoS attributes and set the weight to realize the user personalized choices. Experimental results showed that this method is able to improve the efficiency and ensure the QoS.

articleTitle: A modified fourth-order time-frequency distribution with complex-lag argument and its counterpart L-form
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The 4th-order cross-term reduced time-frequency distribution with complex-lag argument (CTD) is analyzed and its frequency scale problem is pointed out. The conventional solutions to the problem are oversampling the signal or applying interpolation to the signal after it has been sampled, as they have been done in Wigner-Ville distribution (WVD). However, oversampling or interpolation results in excessive calculation amount. Therefore, a modified version of 4th-order cross-term reduced CTD (MCTD4) is proposed in this paper. The modifications include compressing the core function of CTD and making a periodic extension of the result. Because MCTD4 doesn't have the frequency scale problem, oversampling or interpolation is not necessary. The counterpart L-form of MCTD4 is also included. It increases the time-frequency resolution of MCTD4. Effectiveness of the method is illustrated by examples.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent home appliance control system based on ARM and ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper introduces the intelligent home appliance control system, the system is developed through ARM microprocessor, embedded Linux operating system, ZigBee wireless communication technology and network technology. It gives the overall framework of hardware and software design, and describes ways to implement the system. User can control appliances through hand-held mobile terminal.

articleTitle: Research of EtherNet/IP and development of its network node
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: EtherNet/IP network node was developed on field bus for the upper EtherNet-EtherNet/IP on the NetLinx system of Rockwell Automation to be achieved. EtherNet/IP and its structure and encapsulation format were analyzed, and CIP and its model and object model were explained. The method and process of UDP multicast network programming were given and illustrated under linux, and some actual problems in using UDP socket programming encountered were explained and the corresponding solutions were given. EtherNet/IP network data was collected by using CIPAlyzrODVA and Ethernet TCP/UDP network packets were captured and analyzed by using TCP DUMP, and the problems should be paid attention to in process of actual network data collectted. The elements of network node developed were explained and software design flow charts of network node achieved were illustrated. On this basis, EtherNet/IP network node was developed by using Socket programming and C language in a PC under Linux on EtherNet/IP network. The results show that the developed network node is Capable of network communication and EtherNet/IP is achieved. The process and results of EtherNet/IP network node developed show that the method in which EtherNet/IP network node was developed on field bus in this development can overcome the limitations of development and debugging in the embedded microprocessor in the process of EtherNet/IP network node developed or EtherNet/IP achieved.

articleTitle: On the security of ID-based multi-receiver threshold signcryption scheme
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Identity-based Public Key is an important public key systems. It removes certificate management and certificate update of traditional PKC. Threshold cryptography is an important method to solve key leakage. Recently, Qin etal. proposed an ID-based multi-receiver threshold signcryption scheme and Claimed that their scheme was secure. However, in this paper, we analyze the security of Qin etal's. multi-receiver threshold signcryption scheme, and show that the signcryption scheme are insecure though the schemes was proven to be secure under the random oracle model in [17], the schem doesn't satisfy confidentiality and unforgeability of signcryption. Finally, we give the corresponding attack, and to overcome the above flaws, we also discuss the corresponding improved method.

articleTitle: Research of coal mine production safety and risk management system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This article sets out from the angle of systemic risk assessment, identification and control. Based on the deep research on coupling warning technology of multi-source information in weighty disasters, combined index system of weighty gas disasters in coal mines has been established, and the method of abnormal risk positioning of time and space combined with control chart and histogram has been put forward. Based on the coal mine safety risk, the article establishes risk management models of technology guarantee mechanism, organization guarantee mechanism, education training mechanism, safety culture mechanism. Comprehensive warning system of multi-source have been developed about great coal mine gas disasters, and the system integrates 6 kinds of security risk analysis and assessment methods as well as 5 kinds of prediction methods in regional or working face coal and gas outburst risk. Industrial application shows that the risk assessment system can improve the systematization and accuracy of weighty gas disasters in coal mine, and has an important significance in gas disasters prevention and control.

articleTitle: A new spectrum sensing method for OFDM-based cognitive radios
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Spectrum sensing is one of the most important technologies for Cognitive Radio communications. Motivated by the infeasibility of synchronization, a spectrum sensing method based on the pilot for Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is proposed. The proposed spectrum sensing method estimates the pilot utilizing its periodicity and Central Limit Theorem (CLT). After that we use an optimal test to detect the signal based on the Neyman-Pearson (NP) Criterion. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain higher detection probability than the algorithms in the literature under a constant false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Optimization of spraying path overlap rate based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When painting with the high speed electrostatic rotation bell, on the surface of object being painted, many kinds of deposition models will be formed by the atomized painting particles. Based on the analysis of those deposition models, the β-distributed deposition model is studied adequately, and the coating thickness deposition function, which includes the paint flow bottom radius R, adjustment coefficient k, spraying gun's moving speed v and spraying flow-rate Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>, is derived. Based on the coating thickness deposition function, the overlap distance between two adjacent spray pathes is optimized with MATLAB program, and those works could be the basis of path planning and designing for the spraying painting robots.

articleTitle: The study of MIMO channel modeling and simulation based on 3GPP LTE
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper analyzes the basic principles of the MIMO channel antenna system, meanwhile it researches the MIMO channel modeling steps and simulation process based on 3GPP LTE, then it makes a simulation for MIMO channel model through MATLAB, the simulation results show that the simulation value and theoretical value have very good consistency, it proved that established channel model in this paper is correct. This channel simulation platform can be used to evaluate various processing algorithms and performance.

articleTitle: A speech information hiding algorithm based on the energy difference between the frequency band
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper presents an information hiding algorithm which can effectively resist compression attack in the encoding of speech communications. Experiments show that the algorithm can effectively resist the PCMA, PCMU, G722 voice compression coding and filtering operation, the audio remains strong robustness, carrying secret voice segment average SNR is close to 40dB, which has reach the transparency requirements. This algorithm is based on the energy difference between the band to hide the information. The algorithm has great practicality, which is simple and based on blind detection. The hidden capacity is 30bit/s. Embedded real-time adjustments to expressly speech in the process of embedding strength, to get the effect of hidden effects and decoding. In the process of embedding, through realtime adjustment of embedding strength for clear voice to gain good hiding and perfect decoding effects, Which can be good used in hidding some information in the wireless communications.

articleTitle: The parameters identification of PMSM based on model reference adaptive
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Propose a method of permanent magnet synchronous motor stator resistance, straight, cross-axis inductance, inertia and other parameters identification based on the model reference adaptive. Applying Popov's hyperstability theory build the model reference adaptive system. And used MATLAB/SIMULINK to simulate, Simulation results show that the parameters identification accuracy to meet the requirements of the system control.

articleTitle: Research on channel estimation based on adaptive filtering for LTE uplink
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Long Term Evolution (LTE) is designed for high speed data rate, higher spectral efficiency, and lower latency. LTE implements Single Carrier Frequency Division Multiple Access (SC-FDMA) for its uplink. A main challenge for the terminal implementation of LTE uplink is efficient realization of channel estimation. A Wiener filter-type estimator based on pilot symbols is often used to solve the problem. However, this estimator requires statistic prior knowledge of channel and noise that is not easily obtained. In this paper, adaptive channel estimators based on the normalized least mean square (NLMS) algorithm and recursive least square (RLS) algorithm are presented for LTE uplink. The estimators update coefficients continually and do not need prior knowledge. Simulation results show that the adaptive estimators have excellent performance measured in terms of the normalized mean square error (NMSE) in different channel environment.

articleTitle: Online detection of glass bottle crack based on evolutionary neural network and computer vision
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Glass bottle detection is a key job of glass enterprises, and crack detection is one of its important aspects. In this study, evolutionary neural network is combined with computer vision and used in online detection of glass bottle crack An online crack detection method for glass bottle based on evolutionary neural network and computer vision is proposed. The detection system includes image collecting module, image processing module, system controlling module, neural network detecting module, machine-electricity performing module and person-machine alternating module. Its ability to learn itself and adapt itself is very powerful due to the application of evolutionary neural network. We can realize a quick and exact online detection of glass bottle crack successfully by this system.

articleTitle: Secondary development of the workshop rapid simulation system based on AutoCAD
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, according to the current development situation of enterprise, use the VC environment Object ARX development of methods for plant simulation system. The establishment of an information storage layer, middle layer and the business client three-tier structure, and system workflow are described. Research model and factory workshop equipment parametric design methods, the AutoCAD MOVE command has been improved and developed Mate command to improve design efficiency. On this basis of the completion of the workshop on the fast simulation system designers can reduce the intensity of the work, shorten the design cycle, improved the reliability of design results.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of the interface a data collection management
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to the requirement of equipment data acquisition of semiconductor manufacturing equipment in the factory automation, this paper presents a new method to acquire the equipment data, which is based on the SEMI Interface A for data collection management. The method defines how to collect the information which we need through the use of a named data collection plan. The testing results show that the method meets the requirement of equipment data acquisition in the factory automation.

articleTitle: Reseach on LT-based communication between peers in BT system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new communication protocol between peers in BitTorrent (BT) system based on the Luby-Transform (LT) code. Being different from standard BT, our protocol has three special strategies: peers transmitting coded block, REQUEST and PIECE messages processing that is based on the state of piece, and Rarest First algorithm taking uncompleted pieces into account. Then we simulate our protocol in peersim simulator. The results show that our system has a 26% increase on average in 50M-sized files compared with BT.

articleTitle: Analysis on spatial-temporal characteristics and driving forces of the urban industrial sites replacement in the period of rapid system transformation in Fuzhou based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: It is necessary to study replacement of urban industrial sites during urbanization in China. Taking Fuzhou, the central city of the Economic Zone on the West Coast of Taiwan Straits as example, this paper probes into the spatial-temporal characteristics of urban industrial sites replacement based on GIS. On the base of illustrating the macro background of replacement of industrial sites, this paper analyses the driving forces of replacement of urban industrial sites from view of stakeholders. The conclusion of this research indicates that, firstly, the spatial structure of Fuzhou urban area takes on centralization-decentralization-balanced type of developmental sequence and a clear circle structure. Secondly, national reform of land-use system and adjustment of industrial structure provide a profound social background for replacement of industrial land in Fuzhou city. Thirdly, the request for interests from local government, land developers, the moved industrial enterprises and social public are main driving forces for industrial land replacement in Fuzhou city, while the government policies take a great driving effect during the replacement of industrial land.

articleTitle: A 100MHz S/s, 7 bit VCO-based ADC which is used in time interleaved ADC architectures
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, principles of time interleaved ADC and VCO-based ADC architectures are introduced. A design of VCO-based ADC which is suitable to be used in time interleaved ADC architectures is presented. In the design, a high speed sample and hold circuit is realized for wideband input, multi phase ring oscillator is adopted in order to increase time resolution, multi phase edge counter is used to complete the quantization process. The proposed ADC is designed in UMC 0.18μm technology. Simulation results show the proposed architecture can reach 7 bit output resolution at 100MHz speed of sample per second when a 1.037GHz input signal is applied. The proposed VCO-based ADC architecture is technology friendly for low power consumption compared to OPAMP-based ADC architectures at similar speed. This merit enables VCO-based ADC compatible to be used in time interleaved ADC architectures as technology proceeds.

articleTitle: Application of agile method in the enterprise website backstage management system: Practices for extreme programming
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: When the traditional method lacking in adapting requirement variety, some agile software development methods appears, which flexible development mechanism could control the risk that requirement variety brings. Taking Extreme Programming as an example, this paper introduces ideas, values and process practice rules of agile methods. Extreme Programming is a software development methodology that is agile and based on practice. This paper introduces the features of Extreme Programming and how to practice Extreme Programming in developing management information system, also discuss and study the advantages and disadvantages when applying Extreme Programming in small or middle sized projects with inconstant requirements.

articleTitle: Decision support systems and its application in military command
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper defined the Decision Support System(DSS), described the framework of it and gave a respective expatiation on the subsystems of database, model base, man-machine conversation and situation-evaluation. Grounded on that, its application in field of military command was presented: in Intelligent Decision Support System, DSS works together with Expert System; in Integrated Decision Support System, DSS works together with Neural Network. The DDS would simplify the command process and optimize its effectiveness, satisfying the demand of modern warfares.

articleTitle: A new envelope tracking technique for concurrent duan-band PAs
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a new envelope tracking (ET) technique is proposed for concurrent dual-band power amplifiers (PAs). By combining the envelopes of two input signals of PAs at different frequency bands with proper weights, the ET technique realizes an enhancement in the total efficiency. The bandwidth of the synthesized envelope is analyzed. The result shows that the proposed ET technique does not increase the band width of the signal, which will alleviate the bandwidth burden of the envelope amplifier.

articleTitle: A novel subspace-based carrier frequency offset estimator for OFDM-based WLANs with DC offset
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) has been considered as a promising candidate technology for high speed wireless communication systems. However, the orthogonality between subcarriers is destroyed in the presence of carrier frequency offset (CFO), which results in system performance degradation. This problem is further complicated by the presence of direct current offset (DCO) in direct conversion receivers (DCRs). In this paper, we propose a novel method to efficiently estimate both the CFO and the DCO for the OFDM-based wireless local area networks (WLANs). In this method, we utilize the periodicity and correlation of the training symbols in the preamble and design a null space separation method to decouple the CFO and the DCO variables. After the CFO estimation is obtained, the DCO can be easily estimated. Simulation results show that compared to previously published methods, the proposed method achieves near Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRB) with high efficiency.

articleTitle: An efficient block diagonalization method for multiuser MIMO downlink
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Block diagonalization (BD) based on singular value decomposition (SVD) is a well-known precoding method that eliminates interuser interference in multiuser multi-input multi-output (MIMO) broadcast channels, but it is computationally inefficient. In this paper, we propose an alternative method replacing SVD to obtain the precoding matrix in the BD scheme. Analysis and simulation results show that our proposal has lower complexity than the conventional BD method, while there is no any degradation in sum throughput.

articleTitle: A general clock synchronization method based on Kalman Filter model in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have limited power and bandwidth, low precision oscillators and random factors, which makes it difficult to get the accurate clock synchronization. Taking into account nature of the clock, we give a new adaptive synchronization method, build a general clock model which describes the clock offset in terms of the oscillators and design a kind of basic Kalman Filter model to achieve clock synchronization. To estimate the parameters of the Kalman Filter model adaptively, we propose a recursion method based on the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm. Finally, we test the performance of our method through experiments.

articleTitle: Multiple video Zero-Watermarking based on 3D DFT to resist geometric attacks
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a multiple watermarks technique for video sequences. The proposed algorithm is based on the three-dimensional discrete Fourier transform (3D DFT). The video sequences are divided into different shots and key frames are selected from those shots. The 3D DFT is performed on these key frames and the coefficients of the 3D DFT are got. The sign sequence of 3D DFT coefficients is used as feature vector. Then three binary sequences are used as the watermarks and combining the concept of third-party, we describe how to embed and extract the watermarks. Experimental results show that the algorithm bears desirable robustness on geometric attacks.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on fluctuation of pork price in China
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper analyzes on fluctuation of pork price by presenting the VAR model and Impulse Response Function based on monthly data of the pork market from 2007 to 2011 in China. We impose our own interpretations on this problem and draw conclusions as follows: The fluctuation of pork price is not caused by the cost of pig breeding and circulation. External shocks especially epidemic outbreaks are the main reason. And the low degree of pig breeding organization has exacerbated the fluctuation of pork price. Therefore, in order to stabilize the supply of hogs to prevent large fluctuation of pork price, the government should pay special attention to epidemic surveillance and perfect the agricultural insurance system. With the long-term sight, the degree of organization of the pig breeding must be increased through encouraging large-scale breeding and promoting co-operative development of backyard farmers.

articleTitle: Broadband power divider with phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to improve the bandwidth of the circle polarization microstrip antenna, a broadband power divider with phase shift of 90° is presented in this paper. The power divider with phase shifter designed by lumped capacitance and inductance based on the phase characteristic of Composite Right/Left-handed Transmission Lines (CRLH-TLs). The simulation and measurement results show that the power divider with phase shifter is absolutely stable with in the band range of 1.1GHz~1.7GHz, the return loss are less than -12dB; the insert loss is -6dB to achieve the equal output power; the phase difference of the two outputs is 90 ° and the phase offset is less than ±3°.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive assessment of network environment and learning quality combined with the Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The main body awareness and involvement of students, alongside the Internet environment and Internet resources, are considered to be the key factors that influence the Internet learning quality. This article sets up an assessment index system for the Internet learning quality and formulates a fuzzy comprehensive assessment model for Internet learning quality. Finally, it makes a comprehensive assessment mathematical calculation through case study questionnaires, analyses the calculation results and the consistence in actual teaching situations, and verifies the practical value of the model.

articleTitle: Compact branch-line coupler using composite right/left-handed transmission lines with novel CSSRR
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a novel compact-size branch-line coupler using composite right/left-handed transmission lines is proposed. In order to obtain miniaturization, composite right/left-handed transmission lines with novel complementary split single ring resonators which are realized by loading a pair of meander-shaped-slots in the split of the ring are designed. This novel coupler occupies only 22.8% of the area of the conventional approach at 0.7 GHz. The proposed coupler can be implemented by using the standard printed-circuit-board etching processes without any implementation of lumped elements and via-holes, making it very useful for wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Based on the rf ROF technology in the property of the wireless network
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper studied the technology of the wireless local area network ROF optical fiber transmission system, around the wireless local area network OFDM the characteristics of signals and optical fiber transmission link nonlinear influences on the deep analysis of the wireless signal transmission of the fiber optic link performance.

articleTitle: Study of control for induction heating power supply with LLC resonant load based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of power supply, the method of electrostatic coupling is applied to design LLC resonant load for implementing load matching<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. In this paper, the characteristics of LLC resonant load and the selection of control variables for induction heating power supply are analyzed. In addition, a method for implementing the Digital Phase Locked Loop (DPLL) applied to induction-heating power supply and phase-shifted PWM are put forward in the paper. The process of implementing this method using DSP is presented also. The phase-shifted PWM is realized for the system. And the system promoted the digital control level of the induction heating.

articleTitle: The simulation study of direct current control technique for permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The paper introduces the mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) in the dq coordinate system and αβ coordinate system, and investigates two direct current control strategy of AC current tracking and dq current control technology. The paper analyzes detailed the operating principle of two control strategies, and makes simulation experiments in Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that PMSM has good dynamic and static performance under two direct current control method. Compared with AC current tracking method, PMSM in dq current control method has better steady-state characteristics, and current ripple and torque ripple is smaller when the motor speed is changed suddenly.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of Android phone based group communication and navigation system
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet technology and the widespread use of smart phones, more and more attentions have paid on network access and interactive applications through mobile phones. Android becomes the most favorite smart phone by the people and programmers because of its open-source, easy to use and biggest global market share and has broad prospects for development. This article describes the design and implementation of Android mobile operating system based group communication and navigation system. The system provides a friendly group communication platform between friends in order to timely communicate and a real-time positioning, navigation and path planning capabilities with the help of GPS.

articleTitle: P2P Botnets detection based on user behavior sociality and traffic entropy function
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Monitoring data of recent years from Symantec Company shows Botnet is becoming the base of all network crime. As P2P is being more widely used these days, some new Bots use P2P protocols to construct command and control system. This paper introduces Botnet detection methods, studies detection mechanism towards P2P Botnets based on user behavior, and proposes a new case to identify P2P Botnet. To test and verify function of the method we provide, a simple experiment platform is designed and implemented.

articleTitle: The research of fingerprint image segmentation method
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: The technology of fingerprint recognition is an active subject in the area of Pattern recognition, it has board application. The fingerprint image preprocessing is the first step of fingerprint identification system, the quality of the fingerprint image preprocessing affects directly the result of identification system. This paper investigates the theory and methods of fingerprint image segmentation-one of the important steps of the fingerprint image preprocessing. Some of the segmentation methods are discussed and classified and basing on these methods some improved methods are presented aiming at the status now in this field.

articleTitle: Service control algorithm of providing efficient video-on-demand service using hybrid mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: According to 3GPP/LTE standard service control is one of the key problems in eMBMS service in broadband wireless access network. The service control algorithm has to be performed on Fast, Pyramid and Reverse Fast broadcasting schemes. In this paper we have provided performance analysis of mobile IPTV service control algorithm for 3GPP/LTE. This paper is proposed new algorithm to providing hybrid mechanism for efficient video-on-demand service.

articleTitle: The analysis and design of three-port microstrip power-divider
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband three-port microstrip power-divider 1 is discussed with the central frequency of 2.45GHz. The electromagnetic simulation software HFSS is used to analyze the side-fed and probe-fed equal power-divider and the 2:1 unequal power-divider in the L and S-bands. The simulation results show that the minimum of the imports' VSWR can reach 1.04 and the performance of S-parameter is preferable. This power-divider can be used to compose the feed network of antenna array.

articleTitle: A VM migration and service network bandwidth analysis model in IaaS
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Virtual machine(VM) live migration is the key technology for next generation of IaaS cloud services. There exists some tradeoff between minimizing the copy phase duration and maintaining an acceptable quality of service. In this paper, a network bandwidth cost function model is built between migration and service based on queuing theory. From the experimental results, the model has a perfect fitting with the actual measurements.

articleTitle: The study of ZigBee network routing algorithm based on adjacent relation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: Cluster-Tree routing algorithm of ZigBee network is considered as a parent-child relationship to route. For the networks which have large depth, the forward of data packet makes the energy loss of parent node increase sharply, that will take great risks and low the routing efficiency. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an improved Cluster-Tree routing algorithm. On the basis of analyze Cluster-Tree routing algorithm, we bring limited adjacency relation node into the new algorithm. The main idea of the new algorithm is to judge whether the destination address is the adjacent nodes' address of the current node or children nodes' address of the adjacent node, and complete the routing choice in routing process. Statistical simulation results show that the improved routing algorithm not only improves routing efficiency, but also greatly reduces network risk due to forwarding packets.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm of multipath parameter estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: A transmitted signal can arrive at a receiver via several refracted Fermat paths. If the paths are independent in the Fresnel sense, then the received signal can be modeled as the sum of amplitude scaled and time shifted copies of a predetermined replica plus white Gaussian noise. For this model, a joint improved algorithm of multipath parameter estimation based on matched filtering and least squares method is proposed in this paper. First, according to the principle of matched filtering and mode of operation of communication system, the number of paths and the time shifts of each path are estimated using the Linear Frequency Modulated (LMF) signal (Chirp) or m sequence; Second, the amplitudes of each path are estimated by the above estimates and least squares method. Besides, theoretical analysis about the resolution of multipath time shifts is done in this paper. Simulation results are shown in order to verify the validity of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A dynamic slice algorithm based on program dependence diagram
publicationTitle: 2012 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks (CECNet)
abstract: This paper discussed the basic conception of dynamic slicing. It put forward a dynamic slice algorithm based on program dependence diagram, and discussed the application of dynamic slice to program debugging and software testing. The result indicated that the algorithm reduced the range of program analysis and boosted the test accuracy.
